# Chapter 12

We have prepared the arrangement for the **Crown** <term>Crown: Keter, the highest Sefirah, representing the primordial Divine Will that is almost entirely hidden from human understanding.</term> which desires the mind, the **Supreme Crown**, and to bring our heights into its beginning. Matter lacks its measure and we have prepared to praise it and to draw everything toward the **Supreme Crown** to praise it. It is not written that "matter is lacking" its measure, meaning that the source shall emerge and everything shall be rectified. Everything is the **Crown** for the sake of bringing out everything and rectifying it. All is like the powers surrounding the mystery of the established and open word. There is no portion and no standing—the reasons are known to Moses. Everything and the word were straight, not explained as a portion or a standing, and the reasons were left for Moses to know. The spirit of the established and open word—open and revealed—is that which was not known to the inhabitants of the world, even the God of Gods.

Behold, the **Holy Light** <note>original: "המאור הקדוש" — likely referring to the Zohar or Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai</note> explained that He revealed Himself to Moses with the secret of the Great Name. He said: **"I Am That I Am"** <note>original: "אהיה אשר אהיה" (Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh), the name revealed at the Burning Bush in Exodus 3:14.</note> is open within the spring, showing the flow toward the end. And the word "That" <note>original: "אשר" (Asher)</note> signifies that everything was sealed from its foundation in **Supreme Wisdom** <term>Wisdom: Hokhmah, the second Sefirah, the first point of conscious revelation.</term>, which is in every intellect and was hidden in the **Crown**. Regarding this, He said to him: **"I Am"** <note>original: "אהיה" (Ehyeh)</note> is open, including all the emanations and all created beings, and in everything hidden it is included. As it was said: "It is a window and a grace," and they already said "a hidden artisan." A concealed artisan.

The intention refers to the **Wisdom of God**, where everything was open and in secret, and was the totality of all. Its totality was everything, still in the hiding of the **Ancient Light**, and there is no reward in His glory until the spring turned over and this hidden inner essence was revealed. Yet it was still covered and hidden, even though it was ready and more to be revealed and to extend into Man and his surroundings. This is what is meant by **"That I Am"**, which is the hidden world of the gathering, like the reception of all and Wisdom. There, everything was prepared to be drawn out in detail, yet everything was still established and slightly in the way of the direct path, though it was more ready there to be revealed and to flow according to the nature of the **Simple Will**. It was moved to be revealed and to flow in the diminishments of the hiddenness of **"I Am That I Am"**, meaning: "Now everything shall be drawn out and rectified through the hiddenness of the Great Name."

For this reason, He did not say "That" <note>Asher</note> at the beginning, for the rectification and the garment had not yet reached it. Rather, they are only **"I Am"**, and everything is in everything until the completion of the Thought and the Great Names for the rectification of existence. Therefore, the Holy One, Blessed be He, explained to Moses and said to him: **"Thus shall you say to the children of Israel: 'I Am' [Ehyeh] has sent me to you"** (Exodus 3:14). This is the King, the spring in particular, and then he would know and stand upon the secret of the Name in the **Crown**, revealed in the gate while being sealed and elevated in **Wisdom**, an open totality ready to flow into **Understanding** <term>Understanding: Binah, the third Sefirah, where the seeds of Wisdom are developed into structured concepts.</term>. This is the existence of the intellect in the **Crown**, still in the totality of the gate from the source, everything in detail until the end of the Thought. For before everything breathed into **Wisdom**, it was impossible to create anything or sustain it, for there was nothing there. From here we see that the intellect was hidden, and therefore it was necessary to draw from them. Thus, He prepared a vessel and a place for the creation of existing things and for their survival, which is **Understanding**. Yet the intellect was still in a balanced hiddenness, and survival was not possible until everything was received in detail; only then was survival possible. The intention is that from the lack of any revelation of the "Building" <note>The six Sefirot from Hesed to Yesod</note>, the world was created from there and above. Everything is in secret; there is no existence and no gaze upon it. This is the brevity to show the branch, for they are the Days of Creation, and the end was the totalities of the world. He established ten, for He established ten utterances in the creation of the world. If so, the intention was that from here it arises, and also for the need of the world that was prepared. This is the secret of the Ten Commandments whose dwelling place is the end.

It has already been explained that according to the variation of powers and actions and their order, the names vary. As they said in the statement we brought above: **"According to my deeds, I am called"** etc. When I judge these creatures, I am called **Elohim** <term>Elohim: A name of God associated with Justice (Din) and the natural order.</term>. It is known to the receivers of truth <note>The Kabbalists</note> that the name **Elohim** mentioned everywhere in the Torah sometimes indicates the **Attribute of Harsh Judgment**, the secret of the "Fear of Isaac," and sometimes it refers to the **Kingdom of the House of David**, the secret of the **Attribute of Soft Judgment**. Sometimes it comes from Judgment to Will and to satisfaction through the Attribute of Mercy, or Harsh Judgment according to the evil of their deeds. Sometimes it comes from Judgment to seek the Attribute of Soft Judgment. In all these words, behold, both were necessary. Furthermore, two attributes were needed to wage war against the wicked, and they have merit from above in everything. And He said: **"When I wage war against the wicked, I am called Tzevaot"** <term>Tzevaot: "Hosts," a name associated with God as a divine warrior or leader of heavenly armies.</term>. We also mentioned the word "Love" to be revealed despite the sins of man, for there is hope for him to return, and this is without doubt—

<column-break/>

# Chapter 13

—it must be that the power of the Holy One, Blessed be He, is the matter of the end of them all, the purpose as the actor of all actions, His being encompassing everything without end, and from all fear without end. In His totality, there will be two intentions: the first divided and unlimited, and the second limited matter from which the limited actions arise. Thus did the sages of the Kabbalah explain this statement. The chosen path is thus in the language of our Master: regarding His **Crown**, His essence is more than any essence. He is simple in the ultimate simplicity and there is no multiplicity in Him. He is the potential for all that is in the power of the written "The Lord’s actions are in His powers." They are from all the chosen ones, and this is the name of what is created, which is the spreading of the **Sefirot**, limited in their mentioned quantity, even though the reality of their essence and His are one thing in the power.

In the Midrash of **Rabbi Nehunia ben ha-Kanah** <note>The Sefer ha-Bahir, one of the earliest Kabbalistic texts.</note>, they said: "A certain *Palmoni* <note>original: "פלמוני" — a term for an anonymous or wonderful person/angel.</note> spoke..." and He took the meal of the creation, which are the **Ten Utterances** for ten kings. And these could not be counted except for one who said: "The words of the wise are written, and in all is the **Crown**." Thus far. Behold, they explained for the **Supreme Crown** and made these in unity for whoever this is. These are the Six Commandments, and they correspond to the ten kings, from them seventy-five <note>numerical value</note> and four commands are included. Therefore, they are all hinted at in the language, and it is like the measure of the wise to show the divisions and the **Sefirot** as mentioned, in their quantity and as we have written.

# Chapter 13 <note>The OCR repeats the chapter number.</note>

Moses, regarding his essence, was told then: "They shall be divided." "Then, what is His name? What shall I say to them?" At that hour, Moses was seeking that the Holy One, Blessed be He, should make known to him the great explanation. God said to Moses: "Do not come [unclear: closer]." The Holy One, Blessed be He, said to Moses: "You seek to know My name? **According to My deeds, I am called.** Sometimes I am called **Elohim**, sometimes **El Shaddai**, **Tzevaot**, **Elohim**, **YHWH**, **My King**. When I judge the creatures, I am called **Elohim**. When I wage war against the wicked, I am called **Tzevaot**. When I suspend [punishment] for the sins of man, I am called **El Shaddai**. And when I have mercy upon My world, I am called **YHWH**, for **YHWH** is nothing but the Attribute of Mercy, as it is written: 'YHWH, YHWH, a God merciful and gracious.' Thus, for 'I Am That I Am,' I am called according to My deeds." Thus far.

Behold, this hints to us how much His words are very necessary and wondrous in the knowledge of the **Unity** and in the "Hard Elohim"—the first and its branches, which will be explained clearly in the previous chapter. For the Lord is One in ultimate unity, and though there are changes in the perspective of the divided changes according to His actions in the created beings, they are called by divided names according to the variation of the powers and actions, even though His essence is One. He said: "This is the foundation of all," as we wrote its explanation in the variation above regarding power.

And the second: just as we found the turning of Divinity into names that change according to the division of powers and actions, so too His commands and the reason for the division of the Attributes, which are the "Fathers" and the opening to the connection. They are exactly **Ten**, no less and no more, as they understood in the **Sefer Yetzirah**: **"Ten and not nine; ten and not eleven."** This is what they meant when they said the Holy One, Blessed be He, revealed the great explanation.

And in the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, they said: "A certain *Palmoni* spoke..." for it was for the "Father" <term>Father: Abba, often associated with the Sefirah of Hokhmah (Wisdom).</term> and he is the one who rises in his power. It is written for the caller: "These connected to another," they call but do not grasp it. These are exempt without the letters of creation, and their name is in the word *El* [God]. The connection is without spirit to the word, for he is **"I Am"** [Ehyeh]... ready and not divided. All this is in another *El* to call every thing that was revealed... the **Crown** to provide for its many [aspects]. The **Crown** gave drink to the transition for the flow, without "that" [Asher] which is **"I Am"** [Ehyeh]. That is to say: until here "I Am" was ready for the flow and for the showing, without these being opened. But it is a totality without detail, **"That I Am"** [Asher Ehyeh] to be conceived as one and ready for the reception of its details in its checking, and to bring out His name to the world. To the **Crown** at the time, and this is to draw it out. Thus far.

These are for the word "these" regarding the flow, and he said "He will be" [Yihyeh] to her in detail. And behold, it is not written **"Asher Ehyeh"** [That I Am]. **"Eh-He-Yeh"** [I-Am] in the word of a pearl... somewhat to Moses in His creations. **"Ehyeh"** in her, the Father is open to her to be revealed in the name... and ready. **"Ehyeh"**... and it is written: "He did not know."

# Chapter 15 — The Section of Unity — Chapter 16

The superior unity <note>original: "יחודא עלאה" (Yichuda Ila’ah) — a Zoharic term for the highest level of divine integration within the world of Atzilut.</note> does not possess endearment <note>original: "חביבותא" (Chavivuta) — often used in mystical texts to describe the intimate connection or "glow" between divine levels.</note> except through that which is blessed and strong to behold the glory of the Torah. This is so it may be revealed that it is a simple, extended essence, yet unknown. Regarding the five "necks" or crowns, the **Unique Name** <term>Unique Name: Hashem HaMeyuchad, referring to the four-letter Tetragrammaton (YHWH), considered the most sacred and essential name of God.</term> exists within the "wings of our vitality." However, within it lies all the affection, for it is the very essence of endearment. The conclusion of this gravity belongs to my specific Name, and the writing is a specific voice. All endearment follows this path: to be a debt that shall be blessed by a voice from above.

Thus, it is for me to instruct upon the "Head of Endearment," which is the height of the level and the **Wisdom of God** <term>Wisdom: Hokhmah, the Sefirah representing the first flash of intuition or the "Father" principle.</term> and so on, with a treatise for every specific investigation. This involves the descending tablets, the packages of light from the **Supreme Light** to the lives of those below. There is a totality beyond measure, and for this reason, the dwelling of the **Form** <note>original: "התמונה" (Ha-Tmunah) — refers to the mystic shape or configuration of the divine letters.</note> was established. Further, the fountain flows, and in the totality, there are even more "packages" at a distance and with greater feeling. The value of the "circles" remains until she is hidden—she is the life of "Your Mercies."

The end of this matter concerns the Name of names, for these endearments suffice for all the rest, as they are the totality of everything. The second part indicates the "place of His rest," and the end is the voice of His world. The indwelling of the **Mercy** <note>original: "ה"ר רחמיכם" — likely an abbreviation or a specific permutation related to the five levels of Kindness/Mercy.</note> follows the hidden number. As it is said regarding the **Form**, the first "Voice" is the first indwelling of the Name. The conclusion of the Form's indwelling is also the letter *He* <note>The second and fourth letter of the Tetragrammaton.</note> to indicate that the benefit is a great voice. For the Name is within it, and its voice is the nest of the "upper and lower" acquisitions. The end is the final voice, which is the **Tenth** <term>Tenth: Referring to Malchut (Kingdom), the tenth and final Sefirah that manifests divine energy in the physical world.</term>.

Therefore, in the calculation of the ten, it is called "Your Mercies." This indicates that the fountain flows and contains the "nest" of the Form. They did not separate from it. Forever, the dwelling of the Form is the letter *He*, to instruct upon the "rectification" through them, just as it is uniquely found in its fullness. It shines with its intention, being the letter *He* to show that He is unique. Further, the fountain and the "packages" extend to the tenth, which is the final *He*. This is the letter *He* and the letter *Dalet* <note>The letter Dalet (ד) has the numerical value of 4, often representing the four directions or the four letters of the Name.</note> to show that its portions and its totality are the "Two Tablets." His uniqueness is found within it specifically.

Because the **Holy Name** is within the wings of our vitality, it indicates the unity of affection, which is the crown of the **Unique Name**. It is unique in its essence and unique in its form. Ultimately, it will be clarified that this Name is the **Source** for all other Holy Names in their places, for they all branch out from it. It is the root, and they are all included within it. Understand this well.

Another chapter regarding this appointed matter: Every man is moved to learn the "Act of the Writing" and its explanation. A man took four pens <note>original: "קולמוסין" (Kulmosin)</note> between four fingers and wrote the Name as four letters at once with great wisdom. Regarding this, it was said that writing in this manner was to awaken the unity of the Great Name. Because they wrote it in one stroke, and because people were unable to learn this, they said of it: "It is a path of the heavens." The manner of writing in which he would write the Name with four pens at once was a secret hidden from Israel, and no one reached it. It was known to the sages, but not in practice. If it were only the physical act of writing without further wisdom, the sages would not have been so meticulous about it or mentioned it specifically. But the intention was the absolute perfection and wholeness of writing it all at once. The way he wrote it was a visual teaching on Unity.

I have found this language among the **Sages of Truth** <term>Sages of Truth: Hakhmei Ha-Emet, a common traditional term for Kabbalists.</term>. Its meaning was: "He shall add, and behold..." In his language, he was poor in his writing and his reading. Therefore, there were thirty letters... one letter... therefore, it says "four and forty." This comes to teach the "Act of the Writing." In its beginning, He was King; in His testing, He was King; and in His end, He was King. This is what is said: the matter is balanced in its beginning, and its beginning is in its end. The beginning is attached to the end, and the end to the beginning. It is impossible to place one letter before the other <note>This refers to the "Unity" of the Name—it exists outside of time and sequence.</note>. Writing in this manner requires reception <note>original: "קבל" (Kabel) — oral tradition or Kabbalistic transmission.</note>.

<column-break/>

One must write the Name in a way that indicates the **Unity** as much as possible. It had a far-reaching purpose: to prepare the "Beginning of the Light" within the Name. In this way, the light is above, and afterward, he writes the *Yod* <note>The first letter of the Tetragrammaton.</note> specifically with intention, to indicate the "Height of the Level" and **Wisdom**. Afterward, he writes the "Form" to indicate the Name which is concealed within them. Then, one should intend in the writing of the Name what we have written above.

As stated in the Midrash of **Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai** <note>original: "רשב"י" (Rashbi) — the traditional author of the Zohar.</note> in *Vayikra* <note>Leviticus</note>, page 18, at the end of the passage: "So must a man unify the Holy Name, to write the Holy Name in its proper manner." This is what we explained above. If one does not do so, it is not called the "Holy Name." Worthy is the one who "unifies" the Holy Name.

Because of the greatness of this Name, its holiness, and its high level, it is not recognized in writing at all, except in the place which is its "House" <note>Referring to the Holy Temple in Jerusalem.</note> and through the **Priests** <term>Priests: Kohanim, the descendants of Aaron who performed the Temple service.</term> who enter it. They pronounce it exactly as it is written, with the letters *Yod-He-Vav-He*. It is said in the chapter "These are the things that are said": In the Temple, the Name is pronounced as it is written, but in the provinces <note>outside the Temple</note>, it is pronounced by its substitute <note>original: "בכנויו" (be-khinnuyu) — referring to the name Adonai (Lord).</note>.

Understand that the **Unique Name** is His specific name in which He dwells, and through it, He is revealed and known. It is impossible to "enter" unto Him except by way of the "Substitute" <term>Substitute: The name Adonai (Aleph-Dalet-Nun-Yod), which serves as the gateway to the hidden Tetragrammaton.</term>. This is the "Gate." As it is written: "This is the Gate of the Lord." The Unique Name is holy, and the Gate is the path to existence and the divinity of the "Outer Unity." Without it, it is impossible to know. This is the secret: "He unifies His Unique Name through the *Aleph-Dalet-Nun-Yod*." Without the Substitute, it is impossible to grasp Him or know Him at all.

Through this Gate, the letters of the Priests would testify in the "Circle" <note>likely referring to the breastplate or the celestial spheres</note> concerning all events. The letter *Aleph* indicates the Ancient Name. In my writing, I have indicated all the "square" names. Blessed be the Name. The "Light" within it indicates the "Internal Unique Name." Thus, the Unique Name is known and revealed through it. Therefore, it is not read as it is written, except in the Temple. In the chapter "Those who pass," it says: "Not like I am written am I read. I am written with *Yod-He*, but I am read as *Aleph-Dalet*."

This Name was sanctified by **Adam the First Man** <term>Adam the First Man: Adam HaRishon, the biblical first human.</term>. The Midrash says: The Holy One, blessed be He, showed him... He said to him, "I am the Lord, that is My Name." What is My Name? The Name that Adam called Me. Rabbi Aha said: "I am the Lord, that is My Name"—the name that Adam called Me. It will be further clarified that the "Substitute" by which He is called depends on the perception of the creatures. This is why it says: "A Name for all Your creatures." It was revealed to him through the "writing" to indicate this level of perception. In this world, He is known to all His creatures through the Substitute, and He is revealed and famous to all. But in the aspect of this Name—in His essence and His unity—the end of the matter is that only the *Yod-He* testifies to it. It is read as it is written only in the place that is His "Holy House" and by specific, holy men who are the **Priests of the Lord**. Then He is known and revealed in His intended dwelling, just as He was known and revealed in the "Temple of the Worlds." Therefore, the servant, in his existence, mentions the Name with his mouth, but remembers Him through His substitute. In his heart, he should intend toward the Name as it is written. With this intention, he unifies the Unique Name, and that is the ultimate goal for which man was created.

### Chapter 17

The **Sages of Truth** have received that after the first **Emanation** <term>Emanation: Atzilut, the process by which divine light flows from the Infinite into structured existence.</term> and the "chaining down" of the **Kingdom** <term>Kingdom: Malchut, the final Sefirah.</term>, every "Thousand" and every measure of its actions... another level descends beneath the "First Earth." That first unity is complete compared to the "Supreme," which is the **Crown** <term>Crown: Keter, the highest Sefirah.</term>. As it is written, the "Pomegranate" was for eating in the name of the "Recipient." I have seen this detail from the Sages of the West <note>often referring to the scholars of Spain or North Africa</note> regarding "Choice." It is mentioned in the "Book of Blessings." They said there: Rabbi Ishmael ben Elisha <note>A famous Tanna and High Priest often featured in mystical "Hekhalot" literature.</note> said, "Once I entered to offer the **Incense** <term>Incense: Ketoret, the aromatic offering in the Temple, considered in Kabbalah to have great power to bind the physical and spiritual worlds.</term>, and I saw **Katheriel** <note>An angel whose name means "Crown of God."</note> Jah, the Lord of Hosts..." This refers to the vision of this Holy Sage through the hidden paths.

<meta>This page continues the discussion on the unity of the Divine emanations, moving from the specific qualities of the "Unique Name" to the structural relationship between Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge. # Chapter 14

In Understanding and Knowledge <note>original: "תבונה ובדעת" (Tevunah u-Da'at)</note> there is no difference between them, for the end is wedded to the beginning and the beginning to the end. Wisdom is like a flowing stream, as it is written in the "Offering of God" <note>original: "מנחת יה" (Minchat Yah) — likely referring to a specific kabbalistic commentary or liturgical piece</note>; that is to say, their intelligence sustains all, and it is the Sustainer that establishes them in their proper place. All of them are rooted in a single principle. From all this, it will become clear that they are all one power founded in the Infinite <note>original: "אין סוף" (Ein Sof) — the boundless, unknowable aspect of God prior to self-manifestation</note>. If we call one "Wisdom" and another "Understanding," it is not, Heaven forbid, to create a separation, for all are directed toward unity and are hidden within one another. All exist in the "Land of Unity" in a single state of equality. Therefore, it is correct to say that Wisdom is Understanding and Understanding is Wisdom, for their essence is one, and in their source, they are hidden and concealed within each other.

So too it is said in the *Book of Attributes* <note>original: "ספר המדות" (Sefer Ha-Middot)</note> that within Understanding are the six extremities <note>original: "שש קצוות" (Shesh Ketzavot) — referring to the six emotional Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</note> hidden within one another. Even though Understanding contains these six extremities in a latent and hidden state, there is no difference between them except from the perspective of action and revelation. This is why it says there is no "separation" <note>original: "פרור" (perur) — literally a crumb or fragment</note> between them, meaning they are complete within their "vessels" in the hidden world. Unlike divisions where something is or is not, here each essence is within its vessel. This was the subtle nature of Wisdom, which contains everything within its vessel but remains in the concealment of the "Kingdom." Therefore, they are the essence of unity and all exist in perfect integrity, for all "bread" <note>metaphor for divine sustenance</note> is intentionally directed.

When it is good for a man to use this language of "God" <note>original: "אל אלהים" (El Elohim)</note>, it is because he mentions the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He, to teach you that with these Names, He built His world corresponding to the three attributes by which the world was created: Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge. As it is written: "By **Wisdom** He founded the earth, by **Understanding** He established the heavens, and by His **Knowledge** the depths were broken up." It also says, "For the Lord is your portion," which corresponds to the three pillars upon which the world rests.

On this, the sage Rabbi Bahya <note>Rabbi Bahya ben Asher (13th century), a famous Spanish commentator and kabbalist</note>, of blessed memory, wrote: "Behold, He is the God, He is the Vessel, and He is the Knower of Himself. Within the secret of this totality is His essence and His wrath <note>likely a scribal error for "His Wisdom" (Hokhmato)</note>, and He is His own Wisdom, He is His own Understanding, and He is His own Knowledge." It is not that one thing is distinct from another, as it is with flesh-and-blood creatures where the imaginer, the anger, and the knower are separate. This is the difference between our nature and His.

<meta>catchword: after it</meta>

<column-break/>

...after it. For the language implies that if there are Ten <note>referring to the Ten Sefirot</note> according to the value they have in relation to the world—in terms of how He is revealed to punish or reward—then from their own perspective, they are one. One should not assign them a measure of equality with the Infinite Power except in relation to created beings. It was further said of their measure "Ten..." meaning, do not say they have no end or beginning. They do have a beginning and an end, as it is said: "A depth of beginning and a depth of end" <note>A quote from Sefer Yetzirah 1:5 describing the dimensions of the Sefirot</note>. However, these are understood by where they are revealed. The attributes within Understanding are hidden from the Infinite, which has no beginning or purpose. Thus, even though their measure is "Ten" and they have a beginning and an end, they all emerged from the "Nothingness" <note>original: "איין" (Ayin) — the void or Nothingness from which emanation begins</note> which has no end or limit.

It has already been explained that the integration and blending of the unity of the Attributes is for the purpose of bringing existence into being under the providence of the "Single Master." If there had been any separation at the start of existence, no living being could endure. Because they are unified, we know that the Unity is revealed; how much more so must we not question the hidden Unity. So too did the sage Rabbi Ezra <note>likely R' Ezra of Gerona</note> receive from the mouth of the "Master of Transmission" regarding the *Book of Creation* <note>Sefer Yetzirah</note>. I have considered this matter and explained it: the matter was revealed so that one might look into it, speak of it, and investigate it, rather than it being withheld from us. From the power of the thing called by the Name, one can deduce that in the hidden realm, there is nothing but absolute Unity.

In the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>The Zohar</note>, peace be upon him, they said the following regarding the verse: "King Solomon made himself a palanquin <note>original: "אפריון" (Appiryon)</note> of the wood of Lebanon." This palanquin is the Torah and the lower world, which is supported by its pillars. The Holy One, blessed be He, did not create His world until He and His Name were one. A king does not stand until he has subjects. He thought to establish everything, to create the world, but it did not stand until He wrapped Himself in a "Garment of Supreme Glory" <note>original: "עטוף דיקורא עילאה"</note> of Thought and created the world. He brought forth "Mighty Cedars" <note>metaphor for the Sefirot</note> from the Supreme Splendor. And there were twenty-two "Cedars of the Heavens" <note>referring to the 22 letters of the Hebrew alphabet</note>... As it is written: "God, in His wisdom, created..." This suggests that the heavens and earth were created only so that "They may know that You alone are Your Name."

The explanation of this is: the King to whom peace belongs <note>A common pun on "Solomon" (Shlomo) and "Peace" (Shalom)</note> made Himself a "palanquin," which is the Torah in the world of action, which He made with seven natures from the upper world. Before all this, before the Holy One created the world, He and His Name were one alone. This is what the Midrash means by saying "The Name was the heaven-maker." All the world was a single structure, hidden within the Infinite. He alone existed, and it arose in His thought to bring everything into existence. This was to provide a reason and necessity for the Emanation <note>original: "האצילו" (Atzilo) — the process of divine outflowing</note>, to make known that He intended to create, even if it did not yet "stand." He wrapped Himself in light to provide the source for the unity of all generations and their preservation. This is the secret of the Emanations... as it is written: "And they shall know that You, Your Name [is alone]." Even though the Emanations are divided into "Wisdom..."

# Chapter 15

The Sanctified Name <note>The Tetragrammaton: Y-H-W-H</note> which is written with Yod and Heh, and there is no <gloss>doubt</gloss> in this, is called the **Explicit Name** <term>Explicit Name: Shem HaMeforash, the fully articulated or "unfolded" name of God, often associated with miraculous power.</term> and the **Foundational Name**. This is the intent of the Sages in the *Sifrei* on the portion "And He shall judge": "Thus shall you bless... with the Explicit Name." You might ask, "Is it with the Explicit Name or a substitute name <note>original: "כנוי" (kinnuy)</note>?" It says: "They shall put My Name"—the Name unique to Him.

The sage <note>likely R' Bahya again</note> wrote in the *Book of Unity*: "These four letters are called the 'Straight Name,' the 'Explicit Name' that explains all the Sefirot. They indicate the spirits of the Foundation which the Creator brought into being at the beginning of His powers, to give life to all beings that were and are to be."

The sage Rabbi Azriel <note>Azriel of Gerona, a pivotal 13th-century kabbalist</note>, according to the traditions in the *Treatise of the Pious*, said: "Know that all the foundations of the true Kabbalah and all the hidden 'stones' are established upon this Great and Holy Name. Its inquiry is explained in three parts, and until here it is called the 'Explicit Name,' meaning it is self-explanatory and unfolds through its internal powers and its wisdom within the branch of His holy and lovely Unity." It has already been explained that because Wisdom is in the Kingdom in total unity, blended within it, so too these four letters are a unique unity, for "He and His Name" are one and shall not be separated. The Explicit Name is the foundation of all Emanation, called so because it explains and reveals the Emanation of the Unique Master. It is not that it is "explicit" to show something separate, but it points to the **Beauty** <note>Tiferet</note> and the secret of the Torah. It is called a "power" because it tells and reveals what the Name was. See the life-teachings of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai...

# Chapter 18 | Part of Unity | Chapter 17

They established and wrote, and Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>original: "רכפ"י" (Rashbi)</note>, of blessed memory, said that the secret of all those called by My name is: **"For my glory I have created him, I have formed him; yea, I have made him"** <note>Isaiah 43:7</note>. "For my glory I have created him" refers to the Foundation <note>original: "ליסוד" (Yesod)</note>. And "for my glory I have created him" is why I have given glory as a gift, as it is known.

Everything was established for the world. My heart's desire answered all those children of flesh and life, who know how to perform the **Repairs** <note>original: "תיקוני" (Tikunim) — kabbalistic actions intended to restore cosmic balance</note>. "For my glory I have created him" refers to a structure that is a "Glory" to be engraved within its strong central pillar through its repair and its truth. Below, it is a structure for the "Glory" of the one who repairs it with preciousness and according to its image. For on the earth, such a building I have created as a garment for the glory of humility, for its repair. Within it is the **Covenant** <note>original: "ברית" (Brit)</note>, on the side of purity, dwelling in the hidden and prepared place. As it is said: "And the light and the glory of humility shall be revealed in its paths," as if to say, "I am the Lord, I dwell in all these." And it is written: "He makes peace and creates evil" <note>Isaiah 45:7</note>. And it is written: "He makes peace in His high places." Regarding this, it says "I have created him, I have formed him, yea I have made him" in a perfected repair.

And concerning this, "And God created Man on the earth" <note>Genesis 1:27</note>, and gave him the power to repair that Glory through the "Repairs" for the Supernal Glory. In this, there is also the secret of the "Creation" <note>original: "בריאה" (Beriyah)</note>, and concerning this it says "I have created him." When that Glory is within the "Formation" <note>original: "יצירה" (Yitzirah)</note>, it says "I have formed him." And when that Glory is within the "Action" <note>original: "עשיה" (Asiyah)</note>, it says "I have made him." All this was given so that man would have the power to show his hidden structure for the sake of the Supernal Glory, to repair it, as is necessary for the Lower Glory.

And from where do we know that this Glory of Man contains these aspects? For it is written: "And the light and the glory are drawn out, He makes peace." "And the light"—this is "He formed." "And the glory"—this is "He created." "He makes peace"—this is "He made." And thus, the Higher Glory is the one that blesses and provides all the blessings to the Lower Glory. In the same way that Man is on the earth, the Glory of Man's repair is beneath the [Divine] Eyes. And if he is below, he contains these aspects. For a person can merit through his deeds to be in the image of the Cloud <note>original: "עב" (Av) — often a reference to the divine presence or a specific numerical value of God's name</note>.

Thus, it will be clarified from his words, of blessed memory, in full, what we have endeavored to explain in this chapter: that the existence of Man is made and repaired in the likeness and repair of the Supernal Glory. This is why he was created. The reason for this is to repair the **Glory** <note>original: "הכבוד" (Ha-Kavod)</note> in its entirety, just as "The Glory of the Lord filled the Tabernacle," as we explained regarding the matter of the Kingdom <note>original: "מלכות" (Malchut)</note>. Its repair above is so that it may be included and repaired from every side, for it is the source of blessings and the end of the levels mentioned. The lack of this would be a lack for all life. This is the secret of what is said at the "End of the matter, all has been heard: Fear God and keep His commandments, for this is the whole of Man" <note>Ecclesiastes 12:13</note>.

When they said "the end of the matter," the intention was "for this is the whole of Man," for he is the brain <note>original: "מוח" (Moach)</note> of all that was made in the six days of creation, and he is the purpose of every single thing. "All has been heard" <note>original: "הכל נשמע" (Ha-kol nishma)</note> is from the language of "And the king heard the people," which includes all the levels gathered within it. It is connected and included from everything, and everything is included and clarified within it. "Fear God and keep His commandments"—this means that the intention of his being made in the Supernal likeness was to fulfill the commandments, both the positive and the negative. All of them are hinted at in the phrase "Fear God and keep His commandments," for the Supernal Repair, for whose sake he was created, depends on this. This is his glory, and thus they said: "For this is the whole of Man."

# Chapter 18
### The Formation of the Lower World, Called the Microcosm <note>original: "עולם קטן" (Olam Katan)</note>
### Which is in the Pattern of the Macrocosm <note>original: "אדם הגדול" (Adam Ha-Gadol)</note>, as We Have Explained.

In this begins the first **Chariot** <note>original: "המרכבה" (Ha-Merkavah) — the visionary structure of the divine realm</note>, which is a Chariot for the universal knowledge of all the words. It was hinted at in the "Head," in the secret of the "Joints of the Chariot" <note>original: "פרקי המרכבה" (Pirkei Ha-Merkavah)</note>. These are **Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge** <note>original: "חכמה ובינה ודעת" (Chochmah, Binah, Da'at)</note>. And in the measure of Man, these are the brain, the skull, and the tongue. **Kindness and Strength** <note>original: "הגדולה והגבורה" (Ha-Gedulah ve-ha-Gevurah)</note> are represented by the two arms. As we learned from Rabbi [Joshua] who said: From the navel and upwards... except for his heart and his lungs... because of his mercy. And it begins to return to the body, which is the "World of Time" in the parable of the spinal cord that extends from the head. "Beauty" <note>original: "תפארת" (Tiferet)</note> is represented by the torso. The **Foundation of the World** <note>original: "יסוד עולם" (Yesod Olam)</note> is the place of the procreative organ, and within it is the secret of the **Covenant** <note>original: "סוד הברית" (Sod Ha-Brit)</note>, which shall not depart. It is the teacher that sows in the center of all the parts, throwing his lightning bolts. The whole man is in a complete image, clinging to the center between

<column-break/>

his spread parts, which are hidden and covered.

# Chapter 17

**1.** Just as the Simple Will and Desire arose in the pure thought to bring forth and emanate the **Light of the Glory of Emanation** <note>original: "אור הכבוד האצילות" (Or Ha-Kavod Ha-Atzilut)</note>, to guide and provide through commandments and sanctifications, and to judge as the Unique One over the creatures, in the matter explained at the beginning of the chapter. For it was the Simple Will to create a single, perfected creature, included in "Action" <note>original: "עשיה" (Asiyah)</note> alone, and to count it among the honorable things. The Supernal Tabernacle is the sanctified one in its honorable window called the "Holy of Holies."

In the secret and the known Glory of **Kindness** <note>original: "חסד" (Chesed)</note>, and in it are ornaments. Concerning this it is said: "He plotted evil in his heart" <note>meaning the intentionality of creation</note>. It is in His likeness. They have already spoken in this language, as the king Rabbi Joshua said in the name of Rabbi Levi: "Why, in the work of the Heavens and the Earth, is 'The King' mentioned?" A parable of a king who had a ledger <note>original: "טבי בכספריטין" — likely a corruption of the Greek 'pinax' or 'diptych', meaning account books or tablets</note> and he was not occupied with anything except his own mind. Rabbi Samuel bar Nachman said: "In the work of each and every day, like a king." A parable of a king who had tablets <note>original: "פנקפירין" (pinakidion)</note> and was not occupied with anything except his own mind. Rabbi Levi said: "Like a king who built his palace through architects <note>original: "פחדריכס" (paedarchos)</note>, meaning children." It was pleasing to him until the waters of the sea etc. It was not settled upon the architects, but upon "And He was grieved in His heart" <note>Genesis 6:6</note>.

And in Chapter 18 of the *Chapters of Rabbi Eliezer* <note>original: "פרקי ר' אליעזר" (Pirkei De-Rabbi Eliezer)</note>: Immediately the Holy One, Blessed be He, returned to make the world etc. and he consulted His heart. All these teach us of the powers of the Holy One, Blessed be He, for the King consulted nothing outside of Himself. For the mention of "the work of the Heavens and the Earth" hints at the known active powers, and the mention of "the work of each and every day" hints at the Supernal forms.

And they said in the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>the Zohar</note>: In the patterns of the world’s creation like the days. And they compared it with assistance, for worlds were prepared and then destroyed to arrange them all, for seven days correspond to the ten hidden powers. And the mention of "in the heart" with intention—the "Pure Heart" was the inclusive principle of all the inner letters, and its end is the "Extra He" <note>original: "ה"יא היתרה" — referring to the letter He in the Hebrew name of God</note>. From this matter, "He plotted in His heart" and included it with Him in the pattern of the hidden things, as has been explained.

The hidden reason is so that he too would be awakened to the investigations of the Unique Branch and the spreading of the levels of Emanation included in the whole. In the word "World" <note>original: "העולם" (Ha-Olam)</note> which is repeated in all of them, the image of the "Living Creature" <note>original: "חית" (Chayyat)</note> awakens and publicizes the inclusion and the revelation. And its logic is created in all of them. As it says in Chapter 18 of *Pirkei De-Rabbi Eliezer*: "He stood on his feet and was glorified in the image of the High Priest." The creatures saw his face and his eyes, which were clear. For this secret, the image is called "Diyukan" <note>original: "דיוקן" — Likeness/Icon</note>. All forms are called thus along with the form of Man.

As we wrote in the great chapter: Look, there is no likeness before Him like his Likeness. Because the form of Man is fixed and established in a way that no other form is. As it is written: "In the heart of God they established the Shadow and the Judgment." Like two faces, like a canopy, for he was dreamed in the likeness of his Creator. This was placed there to show the inclusion of the Supernal dwellings. It says there "Inclusion," in the secret of the Inclusive Name. When he was drawn into the houses, they returned to the purpose of the hint of his image, as a branch that does not mingle. Every master of the worlds, his image I have placed in them, but the "Inclusive Structure" I created in his Likeness. Then, when he was included from the levels, made in the pattern of the Tabernacle, he would have the power and the capacity to unify and repair the Glory. For this was the primary intention above all this: the assistance of the Glory with everything called by My name—"For my glory I have created him, I have formed him; yea, I have made him."

And the statement that the whole intention is for Man—it is because he is included from all the levels and all the Wisdoms. Within him is clarified the expression "All," for he includes everything, and everything is in him. And the phrase "called by My name" is an expression of calling, like "calling the creation" so they should turn and return together. The intention is that he was created like His crown, which is the Emanation which is His name. And the phrase "For my glory I have created him" etc. points to the purpose for which the secret was created. For it was for the measure and the revelation of His attributes and His foundation, and to repair it properly. For this, it was repaired and made in His likeness. For in the Supernal Glory there are aspects, and in Humility there are also these. Within him, all this exists, and thus he said: "I have created him, I have formed him, yea I have made him." By the assistance of his inclusion from Him, being made in his repair, he shall have the power and the capacity to unify and repair.

# Part
### Chapter 16

The **Tongue**—the Sages of the Kabbalah taught that it is the "Crown of Kingship" <note>original: "עטרת מלכות" (Ateret Malchut)</note> in the innermost sanctum, etc. The word **Crown** <note>original: "כתר" (Keter)</note> is written within the words of some Kabbalists, and I have received the tradition that this is its name. I have also seen it written in the words of certain Kabbalists, both the famous ones and the ancients, that it is "closed and included." Therefore, he associated it with **Yah** <note>The two-letter Divine Name YH</note> and with them. It refers to several hints and includes several powers.

In the words of Isaiah: "The arm of the Lord was not weary" <note>A paraphrase of Isaiah 51 or 59</note>, to strengthen the "all the more so" argument and to merit **Katri’el** <note>An angelic name derived from 'Keter' (Crown) and 'El' (God)</note>. He too did not divide the end, for Katri’el is a "portion." Know that there is a power above it and a glory above all glory.

This is what the Sages of Truth call **Metatron the Great** <note>The supreme angel and celestial scribe in Jewish mysticism</note>, and he is called **Kingship** <note>Malchut</note> after the name of the Divine Kingship. From him, the "Outer Kingship" begins to be carved out, and his words are called "Great." This is a decree from the assembly of the "Included Whole." He is like the power of **Mercy** <note>Rachamim</note> that covers, and he is the master of "Inspection" and the "Ewe." He is called **Atiri’el** after the "Great Crown" <note>Ateret</note>, which is like the appearance of gold used for the **Attribute of Judgment** <note>Middat Ha-Din</note>.

From this, the "Middle Pillar" was refined and prepared. He is called **Kachri’el** <note>likely a variant of Katri’el</note> after the "Failures" <note>an obscure reference, possibly to spiritual tests</note> which are "Masteries." He is called "the garment of His covering" in the manner of "the honor of the children of God in mercy." This comes from the language of "the falling tree" whose roots are marked.

Thus, the "Deciders" <note>mediating spiritual forces</note> incline toward merit, just as in a craft, if one gathers children into a hidden place. A "small city" <note>referencing Ecclesiastes 9:14</note> relies on their faithfulness. This is for the "pure heart" that leans upon its beloved. It is renewed in the bond of the "Ten." This is called the "Land of Israel" <note>spiritually representing the destination of holiness</note>, corresponding to the "Supernal Mother." In the "Book of Life," everything is recorded. It is said that the "Upper Earths" are built in the Name. These are called the **Holy of Holies**. Their rule is through freedom and Kingship, holy from the attribute of Kingship.

The "Holy Ones" are moved by their brilliance to speak according to their strength, as the Masters of Divine Service said according to their tradition of piety. All these voices are within the "Feast" itself, drawing from the "Single Attribute," for all divisions are aimed toward it. Therefore, the one who unifies <note>during prayer</note> ascends through the verse **"The Lord is One"** <note>Deuteronomy 6:4</note>.

Our tradition here is that these are the "Words of Mercy." Therefore, the Sages of Kabbalah said that the names mentioned in the **Crown of Kingship** are messengers and prepared to see and to despise sins and transgressions, which are the "Rebellions" and "Distortions." These names are included in one Name because of their causal relationship. This is the secret of "removing the sin immediately," so that the Lord may turn from His burning anger, and forgive and have mercy on the "Sons of Transgression." This refers to **Phinehas**, who represents the "Six Supernal Extremities." Regarding this, it is said that he is worthy of the "Cheeks" <note>a reference to sacrificial portions or divine favor</note>. Therefore, he is crowned because of the removal of anger.

Furthermore, they said: "Without the Crown of Kingship, there is no image of Jacob." If so, what is the place of the "Lower Ladder" corresponding to the "Upper Dew"? This is the comfort of the "Seventy" <note>referencing the 70 souls of Jacob's house or 70 nations</note> and Jacob. "Heaven and Earth were finished" <note>Genesis 2:1</note>, for the Lord did His will for Jacob. Heaven forbid that his will should ascend to "Strife," for strife comes from the attribute of "Might" <note>Gevurah</note> which is hidden. The "Footsteps of the Workers" shall pass through, and Wisdom and Understanding are the offspring.

If you are wise, there is none to answer the Truth of the **Beginner**, who knows the "End of his Search." If there is a "Shield of Unity" over everything, it is Wisdom and Understanding from the "Primordial Thought." All this is a solid foundation for the choice of the "Deep Ones," the receivers of Truth. There is also a "Direction for Love" to be in the "Residing of the Lord God," and the "Ways of Pleasantness" according to what is engraved.

The Sages of Kabbalah understand the **Glory** called **Metatron the Great** to be in the "Chariot." Below him, in the "Middle Path," is **Michael the Great** <note>The archangel Michael, protector of Israel</note>. Thus, he answered: "Glory is like a garment," and to others, a "Crown." This comes from the inner brilliance. Below it are seven "Inner Emanations" which are the "Wombs of Kingship." They are called "Girders of Strength" and "Thousands," named after the fact that they were created from the strength of the "Great Secret" called by the Sages of the Chariot <note>Ma'aseh Merkavah</note> "The Many-Eyed." One can learn of this from the verse: "His eyes are like doves" <note>Song of Songs 5:12</note>.

It is called so because it divides into four branches, etc. These branches are intended for "Simple Work," and they stand before the "Place of the One" in the Throne of Glory. This is so there are not "Four Priests" there, looking at their sister. Regarding them, it is said: "Seven are the eyes of the Lord" <note>Zechariah 4:10</note>. They are not called "eyes" except to illustrate that they "consume" <note>oversee</note>, as it is written: "For the Lord your God is a consuming fire" <note>Deuteronomy 4:24</note>.

# The Unity
### Chapter 16

This is the "Gift of the Sages" in great comfort. They stand before the Holy One, blessed be He, above in all His glory and clarity. Just as the **Seraphim** stand "above Him" <note>Isaiah 6:2</note>, etc. These are their names: **Lulkhosoh, Tanazal, Lalkha'el, Phlaki'el, Katri'el, Kaslala'el, Kuzal**. <note>These are protective angelic names, often formed via mystical permutations</note>. These are the "Seven Inner Glories of the Structure" and the "Seven Names" included in **Bezalel** <note>the architect of the Tabernacle</note>. This is the secret of the seven structural Sefirot and the secret of the seven names within "Bezalel"—keep this and increase it.

At the head of these is **Remon**, the Great **Archistratigos** <note>Greek term for "Chief General/Commander," often used for Michael</note>, who is "divided," as it is said: "Seven angels were given to him as a gift, starting from **Metatron** <note>here spelled 'Mataltos'</note>, to enter within the **Parochet**" <note>The Veil of the Temple, used here as the celestial "Pargod" or cosmic curtain</note>. This is what is called the **Pargod** <note>term for the veil that separates the Divine from the lower worlds</note>.

Below it is the "Firmament" mentioned on the second day of creation. Concerning this, **Rabbi Eliezer** said: "The firmament is above the heads of the Living Creatures <note>Chayot</note>, sparkling like ice." "And the likeness above the heads of the Living Creatures was a firmament" <note>Ezekiel 1:22</note>. This is what is called the **Pargod**. From here comes the "Flow" that separates into the "World of Disconnected Beings." Therefore, it is said in the *Chapters of Rabbi Eliezer* <note>Pirkei De-Rabbi Eliezer</note> that the "Secret of the World" was swallowed by the waters that are above it and the waters below it. It "divides between water and water." This is the meaning of "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters," etc., for on the second day, the "Pillar of Change" was completed.

The Sages of Kabbalah taught that the "Supernal Holy Existences" are inner, called the "Causers of Causes." For these were not created like those creatures created from the "Upper Water" and "Flowing Water." They are not "Primordial Substances." They are the "End of the Firmament," and below them is the "Likeness." This is the secret of the two "Divine Powers": **Metatron** and **Sandalphon**. As the liturgical poet said: "The ones who stand on high," who draw down the "Flow" lower and lower.

The explanation of **Metatron** <note>original: "מטטרו"ן"</note> is a "Compound Word" <note>noting the word structure</note> indicating "Matter" and "Form" <note>Gomer and Tzurah - Aristotelian concepts used in Kabbalah</note>. He is divided into "Man" <note>Ish</note>, for every "Sin" <note>Avon</note> and "Refinement" <note>Tzeruf</note> indicates "Matter." As said in the *Book of Jonah*: "The side of the dead becomes a transition for every mouth of the Academy of Matter without Form." And "Met" <note>Dead/Matter</note> indicates the "Matter" which is inside the world and its hiddenness. And "Tron" <note>throne/rule</note> indicates his action, which is the "Intelligence of Matter and Form," for he draws "Fruits" from the spiritual world and bestows them upon "Matter."

Below is the **Palace of the Will** <note>Hechal Ha-Ratzon</note>, corresponding to the "Choice." This is the **Sixth Palace** in the "Kingship of Understanding" <note>Malchut Ha-Binah</note>. It is the "Living Creature of the Seats," as is known from the words of the Unity of **Rabbi Moshe** <note>likely Maimonides or a later Kabbalist</note> regarding his palaces.

Below it is the **Palace of the Book** <note>Hechal Ha-Sefer</note>, corresponding to the "Crown" <note>Keter</note>. It is "Radiance to the High" in the "Throne of God." The Sages of Kabbalah said that it is the "End of the Supernal Work" and the "Beginning of the Lower Work." This is the palace called **Metatron of the Interior** <note>Metatron of the Presence</note>, whose name is like the name of his Master, the Supernal One called "Metatron the Great." This is called the "Acting Intelligence" by the Sages of Kabbalah.

Below it is the **Palace of Merit** <note>Hechal Zechut</note>, corresponding to "Fear" <note>Pachad/Gevurah</note> and "His Inheritance." Concerning this, they said: "In my life and my intention, a 'L' for merit, an enlightened man in his Torah, and a spirit from the Living Creatures." This is the "Great Power," the "Secret of Speech."

### Chapter 18

# Chapter 18: The Section on Unity

### Chapter 18
**The Signature: Ha-Kaf-He**

The good regarding the matter of the Unity that You have shown us, and regarding the physical matter: for the <term>Sefirah of Malchut<note>The tenth and final divine emanation, representing Kingship and the physical manifestation of God's will.</note></term> includes all the hidden treasures and all the inner-most and outer-most orders, just as the Supreme Wisdom decreed. He wrote these treasures upon the "shell" <note>original: "צדפון" (tzafpon) - a term likely referring to a protective outer layer or shell in Kabbalistic anatomy.</note>, and the details of these matters were hidden to give every body and path the lineages that connect with the physical frame. 

Behold, the "cleaving" <note>original: "דיווק" (divuk) - the spiritual attachment to the Divine.</note> indicates, according to the foundation of the matter, that they are the "Unified One" including ten <term>Sefirot<note>The ten attributes or emanations in Kabbalah through which the Infinite reveals Himself.</note></term>. From these come the ten Holy Names, which are vessels for the included knowledges that cannot be grasped by thought; they are the secret of the "What" <note>original: "מה" (Mah) - often associated with the Sefirah of Wisdom or the numerical value of a divine name.</note> that was made. 

A portion of the soul is assigned to each and every Name. These exist in designations, "wings," "bosoms," and "breasts" <note>These are metaphorical terms for the protective layers or peripheral powers surrounding the divine essence.</note>. All the spheres have chariots and hosts, according to the custom of the Levite tradition, standing in the Unique Name. He leads His world like a king; this is the <term>Explicit Name<note>original: "שם המפורש" (Shem HaMeforash) - the Tetragrammaton, the four-letter name of God.</note></term> in which the Unique Name is clothed. It is engraved upon the fold of the "Staff," pointing downward in the secret of the "Palaces of Kingship." These are spiritual bodies intended to receive the inner knowledges, which are like flaming forms and "husks" <note>original: "קליפות" (klipot) - the outer shells that contain or conceal sparks of holiness.</note>. 

For this reason, it is said: **"Let us make man in our image"** <note>Genesis 1:26</note>, so that his physical matter might live. The division of his limbs corresponds to the Explicit Name engraved upon the Staff—the secret of the voices. Sometimes it turns to a rod <note>original: "לביט" (le-vet), perhaps a play on 'staff' and 'judgment'.</note> according to its merit, and sometimes the staff points downward. His form is also included in two levels: the seven "moons" of the soul, spirit, and breath <note>Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshamah - the three primary levels of the soul.</note>. They are in one bond so they may live by this power. The spirit moves from the intellect, as it is written: **"Indeed, my spirit is within me"** <note>Isaiah 26:9</note>. 

All the hidden treasures have spiritual bodies in the likeness of the hidden spiritual body above. It is the connector between the form and the body, which is in the pattern of the hidden "husk." In the words of the holy company of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, the traditional author of the Zohar.</note>: 

<gloss>Lest it be forgotten in the world... it was placed as a claim... to be forgotten below. The order of the Holy One... to the Countenance. Therefore, through it, mercy is received by the wise. If permission were given to the eye to see even one person's head... when they form the countenance of a man... the spirit repels... and the man is joined and stands to uphold the unity in the world... His Master calls upon his head... and to be hidden always... man was not created [except in] kindness.</gloss>

**"And God created man in our image"** <note>Genesis 1:27</note>. He created him to be a vessel for reception until he goes out into the world. When he is without [the spirit], he walks only in the revealed world... and he is not looked upon when they are like the silver of the furnace. Every spirit and breath below stands before Him and is clothed in a "husk" <note>klipah</note>... in the glory of the Holy Countenance. 

Behold, the Torah is the sustainer of the body. They have a thinness within the body and also with the Torah, for it was impossible for the two "faces" to connect except through a mediator, which is the "Existence of Mercy." The body was a collection of dust from the site of the Temple. As the Sages, Rabbi Berachiah and Rabbi Helbo in the name of Rabbi Samuel bar Nachman, said: 

<note>From the place of his atonement he was created, as it is said: "An altar of earth you shall make for me." The Holy One, Blessed be He, said: "I am creating him from the place of his atonement; would that he might endure!"</note>

And there are 248 limbs in him, created from the place of his atonement. Through many wisdoms, he was formed in the pattern of the Explicit Name, through the permutations of the "Thirty-Two Paths of Wisdom" through which all existing things emerged into action. For the Explicit Name is after His name, and He is on the throne of their stature. He planted His name there, including right, left, and center. In the joints, they are "living beings" and "hosts." These hint at the inner wisdoms included in the secret of the Seven Treasures. In the book *Permutations of the Paths of Wisdom*, with the 248 letters of the Explicit Name, it is explained that the King created them as 248. When it arose in the Pure Thought to create man, He created him and established him with 248 limbs, which are like the shadow of the Holy Likeness.

<column-break/>

This is why "kindness is flesh," as it is written: **"And He blessed them and called their name Adam."** <note>Genesis 5:2</note>

And as it was before Rabbi Tanchum: the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to him in this language: "There are seven holy treasures belonging to the Holy One, Blessed be He, and all of them have their counterparts in this world." For in the soul, there are divisions of the ten <term>Sefirot</term>, such as Kindness (*Chesed*), and so on. In the "reed" <note>likely the windpipe or a spiritual channel</note>, He created them according to the law of Right and Left. In His desire to write, "they shall become one flesh." 

I have already written in the book *Tola'at Ya'akov* <note>A famous work by Meir ibn Gabbai (16th century) explaining the Kabbalistic meaning of prayers.</note> that there were ten oaths in the hands of their creator, corresponding to the upper "horns." For the Levites, in their submission, are the vessels of action to serve the Name between the Crown. There are vessels of desire to live more, and ten "washings" were revealed there. The foundations of the body correspond to the ten levels of the priestly heave-offering. This is entirely divided from the lower Chariots that are close to the Holy. Part of them are from the bones.

This is the "Repair of Thought" <note>original: "תקון המחשבה" (Tikkun HaMachshavah)</note> in the body, and upon them are Kindness and Strengths. Also, the "Voice" is included of good and evil, and for this, He opened for him the "Way of Life" and the "Way of Death"—meaning the Good Inclination and the Evil Inclination, corresponding to the good and evil of which the Voice is composed. He gave him "Choice," as the scripture states. However, his portion is more in "Judgment," for he is a finished vessel. Therefore, he is called "The Harvest of the Section" <note>unclear technical term</note>. 

The "Bitter Ones" <note>perhaps referring to harsh forces</note> also fall under his authority. He is a totality of impurities and purities. Part of him is from the impurities, such as the skin to cover the shame, and from the earth of the four elements. 

There is a general principle: the "Lower Man" is called by the Sages a **Small World** <note>term: "Microcosm"</note>, for he is a totality of the upper "Great World." From this, we understand that his heaviness is more than the stars... like a pomegranate that contains all the matters of the state. 

I saw regarding this "Unique One" in the Chapter of Words regarding the months, in the rotations of those who delve into the Great Wisdom, that it is useful to seek the word of the Lord. Precisely what we have written will be clarified: that man is a totality of parts. Whether one is from the observant and supervised or from the lowly, for each one there is a dwelling place according to his honor, as decreed by the "Wisdom of the Section" to bestow and to link the lights, each in the dwelling appropriate for it. This is done through the "Received Tradition," guarding his name and physical matter according to the order given in the Torah, as Supreme Wisdom decreed.

There is a soul emanated from the inner-most Sefirot, and there are those from the lowly ones, or the "wings," or the "barren ones." Some are difficult and holy, hidden for the special treasure of the Holy One, Blessed be He... they are themselves a division. For the soul of the wicked is not the same. Even though these are divided in their simplicity according to their level, the souls of the "Established Ones" <note>the righteous</note> are from the totality and are in the heights. 

I saw in the *Book of Unity* by the author of the *Tikunim* <note>The "Tikunei HaZohar," a central Kabbalistic text.</note> a wonderful thing regarding the soul. He said there: 

<note>The soul of Israel was drawn out to be more praiseworthy and intellectual than the matter of the forces... to behold moving and rotating wisdoms... to be revealed in the bodies... and all of them return to their place through the sacrifices offered on the Altar, to find favor before the Names.</note>

Therefore, the Torah of Israel needed to be distinct from other creatures. Just as their souls are more praiseworthy and intellectual, so too it was fitting for their bodies to follow the order of the Divine Thought. Because wisdoms and names mix and rotate within the physical bodies—meaning the souls of Israel mix with the bodies of the [animal] souls—those that are mixed in the bodies of animals ascend through the sacrifice offered for favor. On this matter, look at the "Future Redemption" and see in the *Book of Segulah* which belongs to him, and there you will find it.

## Chapter 21

The Torah was written from the letter *Bet* <note>The first letter of the first word, *Bereishit* ("In the beginning").</note> until the letter *Lamed* <note>The last letter of the last word of the Torah, *L'eynei* ("in the sight of"). Together, Bet and Lamed spell *Lev*, the Hebrew word for "heart."</note> in the sight of all Israel. As it is explained in the *Zohar* regarding the names of the Holy One, blessed be He. The <term>Mezuzot<note>Parchment scrolls placed on doorposts containing specific Torah verses.</note></term> are the secret of piety, which is the "labor." The Torah is called the "Torah of the Lord" because the Name of the Lord is literally within it. It guides the rectification that was received from the mouth of the "Rectification in the Daughter" <note>Likely a reference to the Sefirah of Malchut, often called the "Daughter."</note>. Regarding their names, it is said: "The laws of God are like a flowing stream." The **Veil** <note>The *Parochet*, or the curtain in the Temple.</note> is included in the three paths through which the entire "Body" exists. This is the **Primordial Torah**, which is holy to the world.

One who is meticulous concerning the letter *Yod* in the Kingdom <note>The *Sefirah of Malchut*.</note>—for it is one among the [Names of] the Lord—writes fully from the beginning, from the ancient times of the earth, from long ago. However, one must hide this from the general public, as it is written: "He has also set the world (*ha-olam*) in their heart" <note>Ecclesiastes 3:11</note>—do not read it as "the world" (*ha-olam*), but as "hiddenness" (*ha-elam*). This teaches that the Torah preceded the world. Do not say that the earth came first, for it is written: "From the beginning of the earth." In the phrase "In the beginning God created," the word "created" (*bara*) is the word of all, including God. And this is written: "the heavens and the earth." The intention refers to the **Wisdom of God**, which is the Holy Torah that preceded the world. It was "nurtured" beside Him <note>A reference to Proverbs 8:30, "Then I was beside Him as a master craftsman (*amon*)."</note>, and "I was His delight day by day." The Torah says that God was delighting in the "rectification" day by day. A "day" of the Holy One, blessed be He, is a thousand years, as it is said: "For a thousand years in Your sight are like yesterday" <note>Psalm 90:4</note>.

The inheritance in the attribute of **Beauty** <term>Tiferet<note>The sixth Sefirah, representing balance, beauty, and the Written Torah.</note></term> is the **Written Torah**. For from it, everything arises, and in it is the horn of his resting place. All nullifications are absent there. From this, the entire Torah consists of **613 Commandments** <term>Taryag Mitzvot<note>The traditional number of commandments in the Torah.</note></term>, corresponding to the selection of Wisdom received from the "High Height," in the secret of "many types of dances." These correspond to the two [names]... and they were written twice... in the blessing of the tribes. The letters in the hands correspond to the fingers, a hint to the **Ten Sefirot** through which the heavens and the earth were established. Those ten are included in the **Ten Commandments**, and within those ten are included all 613 commandments. Those letters of the Ten Commandments correspond to the 613 letters of the *Shema* <note>The central prayer of Jewish faith.</note>... and the total is 613 letters, representing 613 types of "dances" as said by the ancients. Since the essence is the Name of the Lord—the secret of the **Beauty of Israel** (*Tiferet Yisrael*)—the Unique Name is called "Life of the Worlds," the "Higher Life," the "Life of the King with the children." Therefore, we understand that the Torah is great, for it is the "Daughter of Death" <note>Likely meaning a protection against death</note> compared to this world. It is known to the Sages of Truth that the Written Torah is included in the **Unity** and the **Splendor**, for the Name of the Lord is the secret of Beauty, included in "the Heavens," right and left.

<column-break/>

He is wise beyond all that he thought. According to the place where he spoke between him and this, he is worthy of the attribute of goodness, which receives all things from His wisdom. Because all of this requires great wisdom received from a wise recipient, the end of the matter is that all who understand shall bless. "When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance" <note>Deuteronomy 32:8</note>, it was for His inheritance, for His is the inheritance and the desire. Even though we said He is the **Supreme Crown** <term>Keter Elyon<note>The highest of the Sefirot, representing the Divine Will.</note></term> among the nations, the nations were far off above, and from there all the nations unfolded. Therefore, they were their portion, and we were all in their lot and inheritance. But **Israel** was the portion of holiness. All of this is "as an inheritance" when He separated the children of man. He separated them all from that place. Therefore, He separated them, and Israel was divided; they were unique. Therefore, as His handiwork, they are a "Treasured People."

Every portion of His inheritance is missing its root above. In this, nations were chosen according to the number of the children of Israel—actions that are "walls" according to the number of the tribes of the Assembly of Israel. This is "And His... for the Supreme Victory." For "the portion of the Lord is His people"—this is lacking because the children of man were separated. In the beginning was the rectification of the separation of all, but Israel remained as the unique portions. It is known that the "Vitality" <note>original: "החיותות" (ha-chayutot) - divine life-force.</note> which He rectified in their histories has many "faces" that receive every trouble. Through everything, the "lot" is sustained by Wisdom.

He brings out His extra rest, which is the Vitality... this needs explanation and the spreading of these words. He will call His people "The Chosen One" under the "Small One" <note>Possibly a reference to the moon or the Sefirah of Malchut.</note>. When it is proven that the nations were allotted from the Unique Place and the Holiness, and Israel was called the "portion of the Lord," it is because His people are His. Jacob is the "cord of His inheritance," everything in the **Crown** for a treasured people. All errors will be clarified. He said: "To separate you [for Me] to be His." It will be further clarified regarding Israel: "The living, the living" <note>Isaiah 38:19</note>. They were all divided as a general attribute. Therefore, they said: "For I the Lord have not changed, and you, O children of Jacob, are not consumed" <note>Malachi 3:6</note>. All this proves that the Crown of their ascent is that they were planted for His cord, for His lot, and to be separated in the **Unity** that was assigned to Him.

He chose this. And behold, they are as a "Nazarite of the Altar" through the merits of His will. His wisdom is like her strength. Even if they are in a "good state," the Great Book explains the reason: He took them for His portion and chose them. "For the portion of the Lord is His people," and its end is "in the land." Other explanations are many and explicit. This will be clarified: it is impossible for Israel to be cut off from the presence of the Holy One, blessed be He, and to be mixed with the rest of the nations, because the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He, is literally within them. His eye is upon them so that they also shall not be mixed with the nations. For this reason, it is also impossible for them to be lost.

This is mentioned in the name of **Rabbi Recanati** <note>Rabbi Menahem Recanati (1250–1310), a famous Italian Kabbalist whose commentary on the Torah is likely being cited here.</note>, saying that even the Holy One, blessed be He, finds in Israel a staff to bless, so that He may have the **Key** of our small existence. The Holy One, blessed be He, said: "I do not bring Israel [into exile] so they will be swallowed among the nations of the world; rather, I hide **My Great Name** within them, and they endure." This is the meaning of "And they shall increase in our midst," and "What will You do for Your Great Name," which is shared with them. Israel is the "shell" <note>Usually a negative term (*Kelipah*), but here perhaps used as a protective layer or container.</note> of the Name. It is given to open the "fetters" of the King or the hero in his greatness. Everything is according to your deeds—if they are good, you sustain the Torah. Influence is drawn to all the worlds, and from their blessing, the outer ones <note>The peripheral spiritual forces or other nations.</note> are also blessed. But if they sin, the spring is blocked, and the "Radiant Children" are hidden from them and delivered into the hand of the Angel of Death. They are sold into the hand of the nations because the holy connection was lost from you. Everything depends on what they awaken [below]; this is the parable of the **Key**.

# The Unity — Chapter 23

Like these; and after the holy Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai (Rashbi) is the traditional author of the Zohar, the foundational work of Jewish mysticism.</note>, peace be upon him, in the *Book of the Palaces* <note>original: "Sefer Heichalot," a genre of early mystical literature describing heavenly ascents.</note>, these are his words: He taught, he acquired.
