<columns>2</columns>
<header>Chapter 39 | Part of Chapter 40</header>

It entered into the secret because Sovereignty <term>Malchut: The final of the ten Sefirot, representing the manifest presence of God in the world.</term> took them all, and there is no lack of life-force within her. This "offering" <note>original: "Terumah"</note> is the life of the Name, the Lord Y-H, to instruct regarding the location of the redemption. The Sefirah of Loving-kindness <term>Chesed: The Sefirah of divine benevolence.</term> is called by the numerical value of Y-H, and thus it is written "to give light" <note>original: "le-orot"</note> regarding its endurance.

Thus, "Israel is My firstborn son" is written there. "Take for Me" <note>Exodus 25:2</note>—Israel alone is taken from all the general places in its class. In the secret sense, because in their simple meaning they are literally His children, and in the matter of the Lord’s loving-kindness toward His children. Know this day and for the future, as it has already been stated in this book: trust in exile brings the blessing to the singular and the dark. Because its foundation is from the blessing, they are called "children." This is what the Holy Lamp, Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai (peace be upon him), meant: when the Merciful One opens the eyes of the one who ascends from below to above, He deposits souls according to her will among all the stars. All her will is to oversee all souls, being deposited from above to below. The souls of the males act by a will from above; the will to descend acts through the stars.

The secret of "The Lord is for those who fear Him" <note>Psalm 25:14</note> adds to the count. For just as in the lower union there is the body, so in the upper union there is the soul to dwell within that body. The "Hyle" <term>Hyle: A philosophical term for primordial matter.</term> is the secret of this—its power and the lower union are like the upper union. Just as the Sabbath limit <note>original: "techum Shabbat"</note> here is fed from the upper union, so it is in the book *The Generations of Jacob* <note>original: "Toldot Yaakov"</note> regarding the Sabbath prayers; I have chosen this secret as a sufficient explanation.

As it is written in the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai: "Fortify the arrangement of the mystery and the couple in the hour when the couple begins to draw near." This draws down to the Sabbath to direct the will to be blessed by the Holy One and the Assembly of Israel, for the wills ascend to be blessed, both the upper and the lower. This is the secret of the verse: "My people, call out" at the time of choosing Israel. The prayer of "He who brings forth bread" <note>original: "Ha-Motzi"</note> redeems us from all the nations. Israel is "the Place" <note>original: "Makom," a name for God</note> because they are the children of His power in their simplest sense. Yet they are called "servants," as it is written: "For the children of Israel are servants to Me; they are My servants" <note>Leviticus 25:55</note>, who remain in the body to do His work and keep His charge.

And it is written: "Only you have I known" <note>Amos 3:2</note> and the world knows the secret of the Name. "And the Lord your God will know"—the secret of the hidden. He spoke of "all the families of the earth" to make known that no faces are alike. It is written: "And I have separated you from the nations to be Mine." This is the reason the division falls upon us and His closeness is found in the tradition of the covenant, the drink, and the portions of kindness. This is the great tax upon our lives and the restoration of the world, as clarified in this book. We do not stop our service even a little, for it is impossible to untie this knot at all, nor to diminish the upper desire. For by your measure, He is a servant and a protector to you as God; He will not change nor exchange His nation, nor profane His covenant, nor ignore His kingdom and His crown.

Through this, the binding of souls is established. This was their intention: to cut away from them any thoughts of being cast off from Him, as is known to the wise of heart. In the Midrash of Rabbi Nehunia ben ha-Kanah: "The Lord tests all who height the heavens alone and spread the earth—who is with Me? I swore by My right hand that this is to be delighted in; I and the whole world and its spreading are all in Him." And He called His name "K-L" <note>The letters Kaf-Lamed, possibly a cipher or abbreviation</note> because everything depends on Him and everything is proven from Him, and all need Him, and to Him they look. From there the souls flourish.

These are the measurements and the rest of the world called "Exile," blessed be the Holy One. They said that from there souls flourish and return to the dwelling place of Israel, who are called "children." As it is written in the Tractate of their Union, they are called "children of the Place." Understand this, and peace shall know truth and peace. This is the foundation of kindness, and know its house and its place is Isra-el. It shall be the direction of the "Place," the secret of the water called Israel. From there, the children of Israel receive it upon themselves, to be wise in it, as it is written: "And you who cleave..."

<column-break/>

Since it took water from the side of the day, they are children of the Lord; His portion and His inheritance. For "the Lord's portion is His people." This secret is hidden, and in death they are called children. In the matter we explained above, this is what we intended to bring in the translation, just as it is attributed to the Holy One at the end of the chapter.

# The Chapter of the Purpose
## Chapter Forty

Regarding "The Place" <note>original: "Makom"</note>, I have already written what pertains to it for the perfection of this work. It is said again that "The Place" refers to the latter Sages of Truth <term>Chachmei ha-Emet: A common term for Kabbalists.</term>, peace be upon them. The world exists through its numbers; it exists through the "Kindness" <note>original: "Chesed"</note> of its number. The tradition in your hands says: "Blessed is the Place who gave the Torah to Israel." This is as if they said, "Blessed is Y-H." This instructs that in the "Place" of endurance lies the endurance of all that exists; it is the place of life and its persistence. This is what they meant by "the secret of the Place of the world."

As Rabbi Ammi said: "Why do we give a nickname to the Holy One, Blessed be He, and call Him 'Place' <note>Makom</note>? Because He is the place of the world, but His world is not His place" <note>A classic Midrashic teaching that God encompasses the universe but is not limited by it.</note>. It is also found in the Mechilta of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai: Rabbi Eliezer of Modi'in says, "The Place called the Place," as it says, "And he called the name of the place Massah and Meribah." From this we learn that the Name is called "Place." And in the Midrash Tanchuma: "The place is with Me—My place is secondary to Me, and I am not a servant to My place."

The intention is according to the law of things: He is the sum of all and bequeaths all. All chosen ones, upper and lower, are secondary to Him, and they cannot contain or encompass Him. This is the intention when the prophets asked: "Is it possible for the eye to behold Him?" For His secret is "Place," and the place is secondary to Him, so nothing can contain Him.

According to the way of truth, the "Place" is the Rock, the secret of Israel. Thus He called to him: "Behold, there is a place by Me... and you shall stand upon the rock" <note>Exodus 33:21</note>. This is a gate for him in the fullness: "And you shall see My back." For this, take the intention in the wisdom of the letters: "Place" <note>Makom, M-Q-V-M</note> follows the path of exchange and substitution. For the letters K-H-V-Y <note>A permutation of the Divine Name Y-H-V-H</note> are exchanged within them. They are like a "garment" for the eye. For the letters Y-H are exchanged for K-S... <note>The text here enters into complex Gematria and letter-substitution systems like Atbash or Albam to show how the letters of "Makom" act as a container for the four-letter Name of God.</note> Just as there is no endurance for the body without the soul, so there is no endurance for the "Place" without the Great Name that sustains it. It is known that the Y-V is the essence of the Name, for it includes the small point and spreads to all creatures, like the soul spreading through all parts of the body. From this soul, its actions are recognized in the body.

This is to instruct that the primary endurance of the "Place" is Y-H. Furthermore, it instructs that the Name does not change even if the place changes. Note that the intention of this exchange is to sustain the world and establish it. It is impossible to endure without the Great Name. The "Great Place" is the sum of all "Places," the collective of the chosen ones. He is joined to them to oversee and place His eye upon them, to influence them with His great goodness. Therefore, their wisdom was to start with the name "Place" to awaken this secret of substitution. If so, "Place" is what sustains this location. And the Prophet said: "Blessed be the glory of the Lord from His place" <note>Ezekiel 3:12</note>, as if saying "from His essence." They permitted themselves to pray to Him using the name "Place." At the end of the chapter, Rabbi Eliezer said: "He is blessed from Himself... a righteous man is a blessing," meaning He is blessed from His own essence. The mention of the name "Place" in the writing of the Torah, when saying "Blessed is the Place who gave the Torah," is to instruct that the "Place" is the covering of the secret...

# Chapter 41 | Part of the End | Chapter 42

...to receive the presence of the Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah"</note> because of the Attribute of Justice <note>original: "Middat ha-Din"</note>. And the way of the flaming sword is to consume that which is included in the ten known voices alluded to in the Courts of Law that arose <margin>etc.</margin> in two circles at the end, with a rounded top for the Throne. And that place is the fifth, as they alluded to with Divine help in the verse "my portion" <note>original: "chelki"</note>, meaning "how many" <note>A wordplay on the Hebrew letters of 'chelki'</note>, and it is written "face against face," literally. By numerical value <note>Gematria</note>, "Presence" <note>Shekhinah</note> equals "The Glory" <note>ha-Kavod</note>. There are four faces corresponding to the four places where the Glory is spread to the four winds of the world. And the place is a hollow place within us, founded and designated in two circles, right and left. Above is Loving-kindness <note>Chesed</note>, Levi, and Mercy <note>Rachamim</note>, and in the middle they are lower, like the shelter of the rainbow. Therefore, the Throne of Glory is founded upon the partnership and union of the Great Master, founded on three complete "daughters" <note>likely referring to the three pillars or primary emanations</note> prepared against Him in the lower vision, like another power beneath Him. Through the Attribute of Justice, the secret is a small throne beneath the High Throne. It is also founded on three powers, and it is a complete lower structure surrounding one another towards Loving-kindness and Mercy, all around like the appearance of a rainbow. And concerning this small throne which is beneath the feet of the Higher One, the scripture says: "And under His feet like the work of a paved sapphire" <note>Exodus 24:10</note>, and they explained: "under the Precious Throne." Since each of the thrones is founded on three foundations and three powers, He made three windows of degrees for the Throne in the upper worlds, for He founded three upon each one. It extends over the upper and lower beings. Furthermore, there is an inner secret in the two circles of the Throne, for the three latter ones in the "House" are the upper degrees in the secret <note>here the text is slightly obscured</note>... to show that the Throne is not a separate thing from the Head who sits upon it. I have already written that the Lower Throne is of a certain kind, for all the inner powers are called "limbs," and it is the beginning of the seal of action in the power of the Will Above, a structure prepared before Him... and they are all unified in it. Thus, the Throne is not something apart from Him, for the entire foundation flies within everything. For the Lord is a God of Loving-kindness, and they said: "A hand upon the throne <note>original: "kes"</note> of the Lord <note>original: "Yah"</note>" <note>Exodus 17:16</note>. It is written *kes* rather than *kisse* <note>Throne</note> to show that the Throne is not complete, and it is written with the name *Yah* <note>the first two letters of the Tetragrammaton</note> rather than the full name, to hint that the Name and the Throne are not one <note>until the final redemption</note>. Therefore, all this Loving-kindness is to show that He is a thing of Loving-kindness. And also it hints at the Wisdom of God, for Wisdom is thought... the scripture "A hand upon the throne of God" refers to Amalek. There is no hand on the throne, which is what we said... This is what the house of Amalek did, stretching out their hands against the firmament and throwing them upwards... Behold, you see what was missing. And in the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>The Zohar</note>, peace be upon him: "Forever the Holy One, blessed be He, stands before the gathering of the holy ones... until He removes the firmament from above... go and see what you have seen." It is as if he stretched out his hand against the Holy Covenant above and below, and because of this, he diminished it. And if the fear of God, which is the Attribute of Justice, had not delayed him, then the Name would have been written in a complete way. "And Joshua weakened Amalek and his people by the edge of the sword" <note>Exodus 17:13</note>, for there was a sword of vengeance among them... And in the Mekhilta they said: "This war was by the word of the Almighty." And in the Midrash they said: "A tradition is in our hands that the sons of Rachel <note>i.e., Joseph/Benjamin</note> will defeat Esau/Amalek... the oaths of the tribes of the Lord." These are the oaths... to break the exile of the Divine Presence... for the Name will not be complete and the Throne will not be complete until the seed of Amalek is erased. And after that, it is written: "The Lord will reign forever."

...Throne and the Name are lacking. And it is known that during the time of the prayer, he separates the wheel of the world... as it is found in the Midrash: "As long as the offspring of Amalek exists, it is as if a garment covers the Face." But when Amalek is destroyed, then the Lord shall be King. The explanation is that Amalek is the force of the "Pecked Skin" <note>original: "klipa"; a shell of impurity</note> which prevents Mercy from dwelling on the Desired Land. "On that day the Lord shall be one and His name one" <note>Zechariah 14:9</note>. This is what we saw fit to explain regarding the secret of the Name.

## Chapter 42

Behold: every place where salvation <note>original: "yeshuah"</note> is mentioned in relation to the Above, it is a foundation and spiritual vitality. And in the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, peace be upon him: "Who is like our God in all our calling to Him?" <note>Deuteronomy 4:7</note>. But when the Lord... is praised for being unified in the holy crown... and this is hinted at, for in our intention we believe in the "Fifth" in the "Sabbath of the Face"... and it is unified in the Supernal Light that is drawn from the freedom of all the attributes and the crowns. And this is: "Jacob in the heavens... the Lord sat at the Flood" <note>Psalm 29:10</note> in His glory to sustain the world so it would not be destroyed... And through this, "The Lord sits as King forever." And this is the secret of "I have set my Rainbow in the cloud" <note>Genesis 9:13</note>. And this is "God sits on His holy throne," which is the Foundation. And it has already been explained that the One who sits is not separate from the Throne, but rather sits and is unified within it, for the "sitting" in it is the unification of the foundation. "To You I lift up my eyes, O You who dwell in the heavens" <note>Psalm 123:1</note>—those who wait and look to the Upper Reasons, which is the Great Name. And in the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, peace be upon him: Rabbi Abba opened and said: "A Song of Ascents, to You I lift up my eyes..." This refers to the Holy Land... "From where shall my help come?" Every place that is seen... Israel in general. "O You who dwell in the heavens"—there is no "dwelling" <note>original: "yishuv"</note> here except for the one who establishes the world. Just as a king... desires to bring blessings from the depths... as it is written: "From the depths I have called to You, O Lord" <note>Psalm 130:1</note>. This is the intention of the purpose: to draw the light upon the other degrees... and from there it is considered light and flow, which is the Unification of the whole. The High One, who is sometimes the Heart of Judgment <note>original: "Liba Din"</note>, refines all the attributes and purifies the beginning and foundation of this entity called "Rock." It is written that "the Rock reveals the secret of the hidden things" that emerge from the Rock specifically. "The Rock, the Source, His work is perfect," great and profound, for "all His ways are justice." This is the Power <note>original: "El"</note> who refines this with strength and judgment, for He is a "Righteous and Upright God." And all sovereignty arises from the "King of Loving-kindness" <note>original: "Melekh Chesed"</note>, who refines the excess of all matter; that is to say, He alone is the All, the surplus within the entire Orchard <note>term: "Pardes" — the mystical realm of spiritual knowledge</note>.

And in the teaching of the Sage <note>original: "RaS'L," likely a reference to a specific philosophical or Kabbalistic authority</note> regarding the "Living God," he looks toward the Higher Wisdom <note>original: "Chokhmah Ila'ah"</note>. Thus, "God is a faithful Rock" who binds the knot of faith through His deeds, as it is written "He," meaning He alone, all is one in the Orchard. And the unification of all these "shrubbery-branches" <note>referring to the emanations</note> is the secret and foundation of Him alone, ascending and binding and embracing in Loving-kindness, and all is He, and He is the "One Righteous One" <note>original: "Tzaddik"</note> who responds forever and for all eternity.

And regarding the kingdom of the children of man, they should desire the distances of the various actions that emerge from the Rock, for His judgment is changed based on the action performed by the person. To this end, let the "entering ones" not come to destroy their path with Him, for the system of constellations is refined through "The Rock, His work is perfect." He said that the actions of the Rock of the worlds are perfect, and He Himself is righteous and upright in all His ways—that is to say, perfect and simple in all His attributes. And after stating He is perfect and simple in all His attributes, the word "There is no" <note>from the verse "there is no iniquity"</note> awakens us to the concept of His dwelling.

The master of "The Wisdom of Judah" <note>likely a reference to Judah Halevi or a similar philosophical text</note> explained His words, saying that the term "Rock" refers to the fact that He is the Form and the Artist <note>a wordplay on "Tzur" and "Tzayar" (artist/shaper)</note> of the worlds. It is known that from the side of Gevurah <note>term: "Gevurah" — the attribute of Strength/Severity</note> comes all existence and the density of multiplicity. But from the side of the "Rock," it is known that there is but one simple and complete action, and thus it is said: "His work is perfect." However, because "all His ways are justice," He is the God who exacts payment to fulfill the reward promised to the righteous and ensures there is "no iniquity" for the wicked, rewarding each man according to the fruits of his thoughts. He is "Upright," despite the multiplicity and changes in His actions; do not think that He changes in His rewarding. Our Sages of blessed memory explained: "Righteous" refers to justifying the verdict. This action is according to its preparation.

And this Rock is the source of Israel, in the secret of "The Rock that begot you" <note>Deuteronomy 32:18</note>. Israel emerged from the "Higher Rock," a wondrous Rock. And the Higher Rock is the Rock of all things. This was the life of Israel, as it is written, "The Rock that begot you."

Furthermore, regarding the word "He-is-not" <note>original: "Eyn"</note>, but you shall know the refinements of these two "Rocks." One is refined to be awakened to punish them and to take away their right hand because of their sins, and He is not found in their strength. Regarding this, it is written: "The Rock that begot you, you forgot." And "there is no Rock like our God" <note>1 Samuel 2:2</note>. They explained in the Midrash: Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai said: Listen to this! You said "Rock" <note>original: "Tzur"</note>. From where does a person derive his strength? The Holy One, blessed be He, is a "Shaper" <note>original: "Tzayar"</note> who forms a child within its mother and gives it a spirit and breath and brings it out to the air of the world. That is to say, there is no "Rock" or "Strength" among the supernal powers like our God, the Rock of Israel. Another interpretation: "There is no Rock like our God"—there is no artist like the "Rock" who shapes a form within a form <note>referring to a fetus</note>, and I stand before you until the form is complete. Thus He is called "Rock," and there is no Rock like our God, who provides for all.

And it is written, "Look to the rock from which you were hewn" <note>Isaiah 51:1</note>. The kingdom was hewn from the High Rock, for the "hewn ones" are those separated from the strength of the Judgment that comes. He is called "Rock," but the High

### Chapter 46

Rock is called so because He is the source from which all life is drawn. This is not the case with "there is no Rock like our God," which refers to the High God. Every "Rock" that David mentioned in his prayers refers to the Holy One, blessed be He. And He is called the "Rock of Israel."

Our Sages of blessed memory said: "The rock from which you were hewn" refers to Abraham our father. Their intention was regarding the coming of Israel <margin>etc.</margin> to say that they should look and contemplate the place from which their souls were hewn, and let it provide for them in the bodies of the Hebrews. For they were brought here to the source of the Divine Presence <note>original: "Shekhinah"</note> through the path of Truth and Faith.

He is the High Rock, the source of life. The intention is that from the side of their soul's source, they are prepared for perfection. Even though they heard the opposite regarding the "judgment of the foundation," they changed the nature of the foundation and the law. Also regarding the body, our Sages said "Look to Abraham your father," the source of purity and holiness. For Sarah's barrenness ceased when she conceived after Abraham's circumcision, so that the holy soul would be birthed in a pure and holy body. Afterward, Isaac was born so that he would have the holiness they received from him, founded for the service of the Place <note>term: "HaMakom" — a Name for God meaning "The Place" of the world</note>, blessed be He. Thus the nation was established in both soul and body toward perfection. And if they follow the backward path, to whom will they turn?

As the Sages said regarding the later generations, a time was set for them to follow the Kingdom of Heaven. But they turned to the "neighbors" <note>foreign influences/idols</note> who increased within them. The prophet spoke well when he said that after our beginning, there was a foundation and a source, which was Abraham in his holiness. I said to him, "I will bless you," as it is written, "and I will bless you with abundance, like the dust and the stars." And as it is written, "and I blessed him with everything." Our teacher explained that we are occupied with a great matter, and all this was before their status as "transgressors." He specified what this "seed" was that they merited. He hints and they say: "The Queen of Heaven will compel us to serve her, and we will not be able to leave her authority." To this, he brought the proof: "Look to Abraham your father," for the Rock of our world made it impossible for him to give birth until after his "beginning" <note>circumcision/transformation</note>.

We find that the verse mentions "calling" in the language of a summons: "I call to you, Jacob." It was as if he were nothing, not remembered appropriately, a solitary man without seed. And afterward, "I merited to be established for his sake, and I blessed him and multiplied him," so that the establishment from him would be above the celestial system. I have cleared away my "stench" <note>likely referring to Sarah's physical barrenness or spiritual obstacles</note> for his sake. But you have no claim based on the stars, for no star compels you except through your own wicked choice. The stars have no power. If the Torah and the commandments are upheld, you will return from your doubt and your guidance. This was the case for Abraham, from whom we descend.

It is known that the merit of the Land caused this for him. Regarding Abraham, it was said: "For you it is impossible," but afterward it was said, "Go from your land... and I will make you a great nation and I will bless you." The Place designated him from among the kingdoms for His service. And the Holy One, blessed be He, protects every righteous person to call them by His name to serve Him as a single tribe. But they did not follow his path; they served "him" <note>idolatry</note> until he was cast out. This was a great blow, and in the future, the Holy One, blessed be He, will return the place of His service to Israel. To this, he added: "For the Lord will comfort Zion," as He will comfort all her ruins. "And I will bless you"—He was a "tree of merit," and the Holy One, blessed be He, made him fruitful through the merit of the Land. For he took from him the "stains" to be their God. Also the Torah and the intellect are in His goodness. That which was in the desert, without name or renown, He turned into Eden, and its wilderness into the garden of the Lord. All this the prophet said to the righteous who followed him. As he preceded by saying, "Hearken to me, you that follow after righteousness, you that seek the Lord," and he rebuked the wicked of that generation who did not look to the "Rock" from which they came, nor the source of their beginning, to walk in His ways. This rebuke was for them, while it was a comfort to the righteous who understood all this.

And this was the intention of this chapter.

### Chapter 44: The Section of the Purpose | Chapter 45

<note>original: "Lao Virdis"</note> **Green Stone.** For **Unity** <note>Hebrew: *Yichud*; the mystical practice of aligning the various aspects of the Divine</note> is the cause for the ascent of higher and lower beings, while **separation** is the cause of their descent. This matter concerning **Jacob** seeks to reveal and teach that **Jacob and Rachel** <note>representing the masculine and feminine aspects of the Divine presence</note> are a secret, and the seven stars over him—as **John** <note>likely Rabbi Yochanan</note> revealed to us regarding the **Fortune of the Spheres** <note>original: "Mazal ha-Igulim"</note>—show that Unity returns all the righteous to shine upon them in their ascent. It is written: "And the Lord finished and He wrote." His statutes are written to tell the sages: "These are My statutes," etc. This is a general principle intended to hint at the matter of **Unity**. In their tradition, they said "the Tablets were written," a concept distant from the level of the **Holy Spirit**. Everything leads to one place.

"And the Lord finished and He wrote" regarding the lights of **Unity** reaching the place of the power of the <term>Mazal</term> <note>Literally "flow," referring to celestial influence or the zodiacal force that channels divine energy downward</note>—the fourth level from top to bottom, and from there upward. This language is used in the higher realms and is a necessity for the entire intention. This is also stated in their wonders. It is written regarding **Shabbat** and **Israel** being the seventh, and the book shall not depart from him. The "Long Star" of the Lord agrees with everything from above to look upon the children of man according to their deeds. This is a star in **Unity**, for there is nothing in the scriptures but the **King of Kings**. From the perspective of the Aleph <note>the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet, representing the One</note> that rides upon the hidden secret, there are seventy presiding princes; the Aleph is the Master who rides upon them. Therefore, every language starts with Aleph, and this is the secret of the Upper One in that hidden assembly that gazes upon the sublime. Regarding the "Rock of your father," this is a star unique to the **Foundation** <note>the Sephirah of Yesod</note>. The Foundation is the one that nourishes them; it is described as the "Fruitful Vine," through which sustenance is channeled according to the wisdom of their days and their <term>Mazal</term>.

"I saw the Lord standing over the altar" <note>Amos 9:1</note>. This refers to the status of the **Sacrifice**, for sacrifices unify the celestial powers and bring them close to one another. This is the secret of the world's existence and the **Unity** in the world. From the **Altar**, one must offer them before Him. They revealed that "above the Altar" the power of the Aleph is found, for He is the beginning of all beginnings. Concerning the generations of **Unity**, it is spoken of as a "scent of satisfaction" <note>Re'ach Nichoach</note>. In their tradition, the "descent of the Lord" to any place refers to the **Holy Spirit**, as it is said: "I saw the Lord standing over the altar." This language refers to the future, adding another matter to your understanding, which is **Unity**. This expression "standing" hints at the root of the collective. It is like a planted pomegranate, as it is written: "And the Lord God planted a garden in Eden" <note>Genesis 2:8</note>. It is also written: "The eyes of the Lord roam throughout the earth" <note>Zechariah 4:10</note>, looking toward one point. Rabbi Chanina said: "In my inner parts, He understood and planted, and their root is wisdom." Within the three, the "eyes of the Lord" are mentioned. Rabbi Chanina's words are precise, and their planting is exalted.

The **Mazal** consists of established letters, and their dwelling place is beyond the "End" <note>the Infinite/Ein Sof</note> in the future. Since the **Mazal** and its lights are the source of their health and greatness in their place, once they are included in the emanation and the intentionality beyond the "End," they are established in the inner parts. In the Midrash of **Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai**, they are all like plantings that were hidden and thin, and afterward, their root was established in one place and they were sustained by the Intention. This hints that they already had existence before their emanation, but it was hidden and extremely subtle. The One who bestows their strength and vitality places them in their designated spot within the inner chambers. From Him, they are drawn to the right and left, like great mountains. In the Midrash of **Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai**: "All the beasts of the field," etc. <note>Genesis 2:19</note>, these refer to the "Masters of the Plants" who follow the language of the **Watchers** <note>angelic beings</note>. Regarding the light of this world, they did not mention the word "creation" but rather "emanations," and this is the purpose of the Pillar's strength. Because it cannot be fully grasped, it says "their root was established," meaning they are not separate from Him. This has no end. He added: "The eyes of the Lord roam," to show that every Name receives from the Wisdom that is above it to provide nourishment, for all are one. Even if they are spoken of separately, they are not divided.

"His feet were like glowing bronze" <note>Ezekiel 1:7</note>, the place for the feet of the **Glory**. In the **Book of Heichalot** <note>The Book of Palaces/Heavenly Halls</note>, it is written: "Afterward He hid the foreskin," etc. The intention is that there was an assembly and compassionate ones from the Second Temple. This is the secret that **John** hinted at: in the end, in His "Might," He will be revealed and stand in His place. Thus, when it says "I saw a ladder," he saw them "riding on a red horse" <note>Zechariah 1:8</note>. He prepared our death, a word for him. This is also the meaning of "He stands in the ascent." The verse follows the sense of "God has ascended with a shout" <note>Psalm 47:6</note>; He begins with Judgment but is included in Mercy. ### Chapter 48

**A collective for all.** "And the Lord stood over him" <note>Genesis 28:13</note>. It repeats the word "over him." ### Chapter 49: The Section of the Purpose | Chapter 50

Their wisdom and understanding in the eyes of the nations, as it has already been explained, for it is written: *And what great nation is there that has righteous statutes and judgments as all this Torah?* <note>original: "Deuteronomy 4:8"</note> This causes proximity and the **Unity of the Great Name** <note>Hebrew: *Yichud ha-Shem ha-Gadol*; the mystical process of harmonizing Divine attributes</note>. And this is especially the secret of everything, to speak specifically there with the Name and bring all powers close, for behold, He is near to all who call to Him through the Name. And the <term>Mishpat</term> <note>Judgment or Law</note> is tested according to the level of the **Unity of God**. They shall be appointed and hand over and begin to rest from the judgment, for they are the cause of Unity. To symbolize this is the intention and the specific drawing near of the powers of the Great Name, which is called a **Sacrifice** <note>Hebrew: *Korban*; from the root K-R-B meaning "to draw near." A sacrifice is viewed not just as an offering, but as a mechanism for bringing human and Divine realms closer together.</note>. *A sacrifice to the Lord and my God.* *My sacrifice, My bread.* <note>original: "Numbers 28:2"</note> And they said in the teachings of **Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai** <note>Rashbi, the traditional author of the Zohar</note>: What is a sacrifice? Our table stands in place of the altar; when they all draw near as one and are tied together, all of them become one to perform the perfect Unity, to draw near to the Holy Place. By taking the secret—blessed be the Lord—the sacrifice of the sages is called "to the Lord," and this is to draw near from it to the Godhead and to be seen in precision, and so it shall be forever. And regarding this secret, the scripture warns: *Be careful to offer to Me,* meaning to bring all his powers near to Him to become **One**. And so too: *A person who brings an offering to the Lord.* <note>original: "Leviticus 1:2"</note> Why is it written this way? It is the secret that they are unified by the Name. And further: *bring near to the Lord,* as it is said, *Israel, the Lord is One and His Name is One.* <note>original: "Zechariah 14:9"</note> And the general rule is that any language of "proximity" mentioned toward the Heights means **Unity and Cleaving** <note>Hebrew: *Yichud ve-Devekut*</note>. And the scripture also included: *unto the Lord,* in the cause of the sacrifices, which are from the custom of the **secret of Unity**, for they are unified through them, even as they enter toward Him and cleave to Him. And from this, even at the Standing <note>the revelation at Sinai</note>, it says there that the drawing near was of the essence, and concerning this it said to the wise man, "Come and explain for the sake of the essence," and before us. The matter of Unity is beyond the reach of any man of spirit. And it says: according to the preparation of his foundation, he also was entering and cleaving according to his wisdom and his value, which ascended above every inclusion. At the end, his soul spread toward the Lord to perceive the inner powers, that he might cleave to the place of my perception and my powers in the ultimate cleaving and Unity. Investigations into this are found in the quality toward Him according to the Sages of Truth <note>Kabbalists</note>. And regarding the binding of all, the holy mouth, the holy speaker, Rashbi, peace be upon him, said: In the day that the dominion of the spirit speaks from them, as it is written: *Behold, and also my thought,* and it is written: *Your lips are like a thread of scarlet.* <note>original: "Song of Songs 4:3"</note> And God established me, as it is written: *How beautiful you are, my beloved,* and it is written: *His lips are lilies, dripping with flowing myrrh,* <note>original: "Song of Songs 5:13"</note> and so on. This is the matter of every language of "planting" mentioned toward the Heights: *He shall plant cedars and we shall do,* and *the Lord descended upon Mount Sinai,* and *the secret of the deeds of Esau were entirely.* If the intent of the scripture is toward the end of all, its meaning will be "upon all" and His Unity is upon His distance, and the Lord alone. And "He touched" means He influenced and unified with my powers for the sake of the mouth, meaning without forgetting His people. Every language of "planting" mentioned toward the Heights has this meaning. This is what we wished to explain in this chapter.

# Section 47 / Chapter 47: The Purpose

->He is prepared to grant a place in the celestial dwelling, and it <note>the soul or the Shekhinah</note> was longing for the **Chariot** <term>Merkavah: the divine assembly or "vehicle" through which God's presence is revealed</term>. And these are the righteous who melt away before the day <note>of judgment or revelation</note>; they are the ones learned in vowing to their Creator. For through those who are drawn close, the soul enters the will of the **Celestial Righteous One** <note>original: "Tzaddik shel Ma'alah"; a reference to the Sephirah of Yesod, the divine foundation</note>. It is aroused to unite with Him, receiving the divine flow in its entirety, as if saying to her: "Come, O Bride! Come, O Bride!" <note>The classic greeting for the Sabbath, symbolizing the union of God and His indwelling presence, the Shekhinah</note>. This is the secret of the verse: *And a mist went up from the earth* <note>original: "Genesis 2:6"</note>. This "mist" refers to the Torah, good deeds, prayers, and the intense will of the righteous who dwell on the earth. For they are the ones who arouse the "Righteous One" and the "Well," and they are like a festival upon the face of the ground. Just as the lower earth cannot sustain its longing except by receiving the world <note>the flow</note> from Moses <note>representing the channel of Torah</note>, and there is an advantage to the leadership and the high ones who pour down upon it; so too, the righteous on earth elevate the status of these matters. This is the perfection of their Torah, their good deeds, and their prayers. These "elders" <note>the righteous</note> ensure the longing persists and add strength and abundance to the ascent. Thus, the Celestial Righteous One is aroused and comes to receive her <note>the Shekhinah</note> in his embrace with great love. In this way, they fulfill the will of their Father in Heaven, creating a perfect bond for their Creator. This is the secret of how every Name is forgotten, yet He remains within them. This is like a son who asks of his father for an addition, and this constitutes his whole day and stays within it. This fire of passion causes those drawn close to ensure that the righteous remain pure and holy in their love and devotion. The Celestial Righteous One oversees their arrangements and good deeds, for they are the primary group and the upper connection to the **Foundation** <note>original: "Yesod"</note>, and the life that is joined to it. This is a secret: there shall be no cause of separation or division between them.

In Chapter 11 of the *Chapters of the Palaces* <term>Heikhalot: early Jewish mystical literature describing the celestial halls</term>, Rabbi Ishmael spoke in this language: Rabbi Ishmael said, "Fortunate are you, everyone who is a teacher and a son of a ruler, for you are sealed in uprightness by one of the Great Ones in the chamber of the Torah. He is like one who leads the Sabbath, the lamb, that light, and may my Lord place signs that he was a companion in the carrying of the **Chariot**..." Rabbi Ishmael further said, "I heard from the mouths of the **Attribute of Mercy**, and I gave them to Rabbi Akiva; and Rabbi Akiva wrote them for Moses, and the scribe wrote them before him." He said to him: "And now, ascend and receive it! But you have passed and not ascended, and you have not immersed, yet the world is yours." That "Woman" <note>The Shekhinah or the personification of the Sabbath/Torah</note> shall come and recount the virtues that the Creator opened before her on the sixth day, saying, "Today I am prepared." And they returned to that woman... her heart was drawn after you, and they said to her, "So-and-so will satisfy me." Great was the delight over her... and he endears her with subtle hints. She went and did so, and I merited the sin-offering before Rabbi Ishmael. It was like a holy dwelling of the Queen of the Palace, pure in her perfection. They placed her on the knees of the Rabbi... the Holy One, Blessed be He, and immediately they shone from before the Throne of Glory where He sat, seeing them in a wonderful way. The order of the indwelling is in the cycle of the heights, and the order of the splendors is dried before the Throne of Glory three times every single day, as it has been since the world was created. And upon his word it was finished. 

Behold, they said that for every holy person and for the merit of his deeds, there is an addition in the **Chariot**. Those who are drawn to it are attached to the upper connections. Moses was entirely within this secret, for they were drawing one another until the Holy Source was joined to him. However, when the cause of separation <note>sin</note> intervenes, it separates the lovers and the Shekhinah is distanced. This is the rest of the body of the book for the contemplator: for the Torah and good deeds are the great cause of the **Unity of the Great Name** in its intention. Those who cause this Unity are attached and holy to Him. This chapter stands firmly in this intention.

## Chapter 48

A ray of light in its brilliance; draw near to the soul of the poor and remember... and in the way explained in the previous chapter, "For what nation is there that has God so near to it?" <note>original: "Deuteronomy 4:7"</note>. ...to repair and arrange the place of the **Celestial Temple** <term>Beit Ha-Mikdash shel Ma'alah</term>, so that they may be one facing the other, corresponding to each other. Just as the action in the lower domain is a reflection of the celestial domain, so too, the perfection and the needs of the Upper depend on this lower world. Therefore, the Upper was not revealed until the Lower was created, for thus is the perfection—through the thought and the action of the Lower as is proper, the perfection of the Upper is revealed. Both those above and those below gazed upon this wondrous secret, as hinted at in the Account of Creation when it says: *And every plant of the field... for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was no man to till the ground* <note>original: "Genesis 2:5"</note>. 

According to the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai (may peace be upon him), he said in this language: "And why was it so? To show us in the book that there was no joining 'face to face' <note>original: "Apin be-Apin"; a state of divine union and flow</note> until the rain fell. For it is written, *For the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth*, and at that time, there was no repair <note>original: "Tikkun"</note>... and there was no son of man to repair it from below. When it is found 'face to face,' then it is written above all this, and it is settled as it is written: 'the Tabernacle was raised.' They are considered as one, and the repair is with him. Until it is repaired below, it is not repaired above." 

Ultimately, the lower exists so that the upper may be repaired. For instance, until there is repair above, there is no joining "face to face," and the verse proves this by saying *For the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth*. For this reason, it was placed in the repairs <note>the *Tikkunim*</note>. This did not have the strength... to be hidden... not anymore above to repair above "face to face." And in the Female, to be strengthened to receive... forever... in the end, they are more supported... hidden in the secret above. If the world below is not repaired, the world above is not repaired, as it says: *For the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth*. Without a place, the world is not sustained except through the lower. It is possible for it to be "face to face" and to be repaired; it is found supported above. And this was preceded... in the repairs. 

Behold, the conclusion is that the celestial beings require the repair of the lower beings for their own revelation and repair. For at the point of arrival, upon them rests the perfection of the **Celestial Chariot** and the perfection of the "Secret of all Secrets," until the Temple is built and sent according to the law of the lower Israel. For the Chariot is a **Microcosm** <term>Olam Katan: the idea that the human being or the earthly sanctuary mirrors the entire universe</term>. Just as the Upper repair was necessary for the lower repair at the beginning of creation... it did not rest and did not subside... there is a need for the repair of the "children of life." For all the Celestial Chariots always need the "Form of Man" <note>the spiritual archetype of humanity</note> for their existence and revelation. According to the ascent of the lower table, generations are compared to the "woven blue" <note>Tekhelet</note> which are the works of the Creator. It is strengthened by the "addition" of the flow of abundance, an increase of light and blessing in the celestial domain which is its counterpart. For everything is in the domain and the power behind it. 

And in the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai (may peace be upon him) on the verse *And a mist went up from the earth*: "The secret of the earth is first to arouse the action above. That which is done ascends from the earth first and acts to arouse. Everything is explained in this secret... just as the sacrifice is aroused from below and creates perfection above to join everything together... and it begins from below and afterwards everything is revealed. The perfection of all things begins at the end <note>the lower world</note>. At first, there was no arousal to receive that which is above, until it was found below." 

Behold, the scripture has revealed that the celestial beings were not repaired above until the lower beings were repaired below. This was in the intention and the thought of perfection, to make known His greatness and His power—how great He is! For He handed over to them the choice of perfection. This is the meaning of *And every plant of the field*, as it is written "and all his shrubs." For the arousal that is awakened below makes an impression and arouses its counterpart above. The life of the celestial beings is dependent upon those below, and specifically, all their peace depends on Israel. Because it was necessary to descend... it is the earth that receives the repairs. This is in the passage *And he shall drink* in the secret of *Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear* <note>original: "Genesis 1:9"</note>. And in our knowledge, the "dry land" is the secret of the **Shekhinah** <term>the Divine Presence</term>. All of this is a necessity and the light of the delay...

# Chapter 53: Part of the Purpose | Chapter 54

In His authority, and he looked lightly, for there is a profanation in the place of Michael <note>The Archangel Michael, often associated with the Attribute of Mercy</note>... etc., healing. Purchase for me, for your children, mercy upon Israel, and let there be no proof against us; and may we be joined with Your people. And there is another interpretation: *And you shall be consumed among the nations*—this is the established rule. Everything follows the path we wrote regarding Joseph. And some have said regarding the term "at the corner," it refers to the horn, which provides the reason for the rule of the spirit, which is that it is leavened. *And the glory of the Lord was revealed* <note>original: "u-khvod Hashem niglah"</note> means it appeared upon the face of the desired land; that is to say, through the existence of the Great One in His glory, and for this, it was not moved. The general principle is that it refers to the end, to the foundation of the stated principle regarding the upward direction. This concludes what was to be said here, as we intended in this chapter.

### Chapter 54 <insert>Tradition</insert>:
#### Every expression of "walking" attributed to the Omnipresent

The meaning of this term refers to the turning and the spreading of the **Union** <term>Yichud: the state of divine oneness and the flow of energy between different aspects of God</term> to the higher and lower realms, so that they may be "receptacles" and hear *the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden* <note>Genesis 3:8</note>. Originally, the primary dwelling of the **Shekhinah** <term>Shekhinah: the Indwelling Divine Presence, often viewed as the feminine aspect of God that interacts with the world</term> was among the lower beings. This is because the secret of the lower creations and their arrangements was modeled after the order of the higher virtues and their arrangements: higher realms corresponding to higher realms, and lower realms corresponding to lower realms. Because the leadership of the lower world was aligned with its counterpart above, the Holy One, Blessed be He, desired for the lower beings to be His dwelling.

From this, we learn the secret of the Shekhinah, for there is a great secret here: "The foundation of the house" <note>referring to the Matriarch Leah</note> and "Rachel was the mainstay of the house" <note>referring to the Matriarch Rachel</note>. Therefore, the primary dwelling of the Shekhinah was among the lower beings, where the higher and lower forces were found in unity, intertwined within the attribute of the lower beings. They were included within one another, such that the higher and lower were revealed as "There is none else besides Him." This is like the saying: *I create the heavens and the earth, I fill the heavens and the earth*—meaning the heavens and the earth were included and contained within one another.

There, they found salvation through the wonders of the Intention, as the **Union** was drawn out and spread upward and downward. This is the secret of: *And they heard the voice of the Lord God*. "The Voice" refers to the last voice of the **Seven Voices** <note>The seven voices mentioned in Psalm 29, corresponding to the seven lower Sephirot/Divine emanations</note>. "Walking" <note>original: "mit-haleikh"</note> means spreading out, for this "Garden" refers to the garden below, which is aligned directly with the Garden above.

Similarly, consider the verse: *And the Lord went His way as soon as He had finished speaking to Abraham* <note>Genesis 18:33</note>. When the "Will" was removed, the Shekhinah departed from the lower beings. When the patriarchs desired to separate themselves from their brothers and align themselves with Abraham, they intended to return that which had been distorted—the "Will" that draws the Shekhinah down to the lower beings. However, it was not permanently established among them as it was before. It would spread and descend upon Abraham, for he was the **Chariot** <term>Merkavah: a human "vehicle" or structure through which the Divine is revealed on earth</term>. They listened to him, and he provided a prepared place for the Presence to rest among the lower beings. For if not for Abraham, who filled the place of the entire world with the seal of the Shekhinah's glory and holiness, the world would have remained separated from God since the time of Adam's sin. When wisdom increased, the Presence rested upon a prepared and illuminated place. When it departed from him, as it says, *And the Lord went...*, the Glory was gathered and spread away from him. This is similar to the concept of: *I will go and return to My place* <note>Hosea 5:15</note>.

From this matter, we also find: *And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them, and He departed* <note>Numbers 12:9</note>; and *I have been walking in a tent and in a tabernacle* <note>2 Samuel 7:6</note>. "In all the places where I have walked with all the children of Israel," refers to moving from the higher realms to dwell in the Tabernacle between the two Cherubim, making My primary residence among the lower beings as it was before the Sin. But it was not fixed until the **Eternal House** <note>The First Temple in Jerusalem</note> was built. Regarding this, they said: *For the Lord your God walks in the midst of your camp* <note>Deuteronomy 23:14</note>. They intended to prove to you that the "Living God" and "My King in holiness" who merited holiness, is drawn down and spreads into holy and pure places. For the end of the worlds is linked and unified perfectly in Me, and this was the original intention. *The ways of the world are His* <note>Habakkuk 3:6</note>—do not read "ways" <note>original: "halikhot"</note> but "elevations" <note>original: "aliyot"</note>, to prove that the flow is drawn from above to below, joining higher and lower.

And they further said: *Whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people* <note>2 Samuel 7:23</note>. This refers to the drawing down of the Shekhinah into the exile of the people of Israel in Egypt, as it says: *I will go down with you to Egypt* <note>Genesis 46:4</note>. This was the secret of their greatness, for I joined you to redeem Himself, as it were, alongside Israel. This is the secret: they returned to redeem...

<column-break/>

...and the God of Israel, strength and might, and a "treasured strength." The reason is this: *This is the gate of the Lord* <note>Psalm 118:20</note>, the Gate of the Union mentioned before. It is this Attribute that is sealed with the name of the Lord, and from there every soul emerges. This is the "Life" from Him, for *the Lord your God is a consuming fire*. One who "eats" draws strength from what remains in him; it does not mix, nor is it according to the usual law. It is not just "living," for life can refer to a "living being," but rather to the desire for a "daughter's daughter," as it is said: *You shall not approach*, lest you turn the evil into the *flaming sword* <note>The sword guarding Eden</note>.

Regarding strength and life, it is said: "Another strength." Because this is the Gate of Inner Loving-kindness, the cause of "Holy shall it be," kept in the hidden treasuries of the higher days. These days govern the "profane days," the days of evil, and they have no entrance above. But on the **Sabbath day**, it shall be opened. From its conclusion and its standing, it speaks of the passing of the profane days. On the holy day, it shall be opened from the sealing of the Moon, so that the light of the Moon becomes like the light of the Sun. We have already explained this secret in the *Book of the Generations of Jacob* <note>original: "Sefer Toldot Yaakov"</note> in the appropriate section.

In the *Book of the Foundation of Foundations* <note>original: "Sefer Yesod ha-Yesodot"</note>, the teacher Rabbi Elchanan <note>Rabbi Elchanan ben Yakar, a 13th-century philosopher and Kabbalist</note>, of blessed memory, wrote that the "Secret of Lebanon" is a precious thing based on his own handwriting, which promises in every place that it is exactly as they said. In every place, "Pure, pure" means he is with his Shekhinah. Were it not for the sin, His glory would have been established like the higher dwellings. Truly, the "Sun" <note>representing a divine flow</note> governs in every place and atones. Any "cutting off" <note>karet</note> from the profane is to dwell for him there, as it is written: *In the place which the Lord shall choose to cause His name to dwell there*. It is also written: *In every place where I mention My name... I will come to you and bless you*. This refers to your desire to bless Israel in the building of this Great House, the Sanctuary, for they bless with His name as written and within His borders, like children to their father, for grace and honor. But after the hearts were flawed, He returned in a "thick cloud" to the Attribute of Loving-kindness—here is holiness and will. This is the measure of what I wished to awaken in this chapter.

### Chapter 53 <insert>Rest</insert>:
#### Every expression of "descent" attributed to the Omnipresent

The meaning of this term is the turning of the **Attribute of Justice** <term>Midat ha-Din: the divine quality of strict judgment and law</term> into the **Attribute of Mercy** <term>Midat ha-Rakhamim: the divine quality of compassion and grace</term>, or vice versa. The end of the "Union" is to move from "One who has mercy" to "That which is pitied." This is entirely according to the preparation of those who receive it. Any "lingering of the voice" is within them, heaven forbid [not in God], for the cloud of "Will" and the release of... is not like the judgment of the righteous as the judgment of the wicked, heaven forbid! It is according to the preparation, as it is written: *And my judgment shall be in righteousness*. He knows and "descends" to the favor, establishing the Great Holy Sabbaths to return to the grace of the "walking," as the reveals of Justice and Mercy.

It is written that the righteous man prepares his prayer according to his deeds, to turn the Attribute of Justice back into Mercy. In that state, the "Voice" agrees with the Attribute of Mercy, even within the strength of the "Descent." Thus, all is Mercy for him. This is what the righteous do for you: they "bend" the Attribute of Justice toward Mercy. Conversely, for the wicked, according to his deeds, even the Attribute of Mercy in that state agrees with the Attribute of Justice, as the Judge is also there. This is the secret of "Heaven forbid," the turning of Mercy into Justice.

This is the secret of what is written: *And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to your word*. May it be the will of the Lord to be favorable to the Levites. When they are separated in this way, the "Sanhedrin" <note>The high court, here representing the divine assembly of judgment</note> agrees with Mercy according to the level aroused from below. Likewise, when Mercy agrees with Justice according to the level aroused below, they are included in the descent. The "Right Hand" is the ultimate existence of the matter. One should not associate this with anything other than repentance, as it says: *By the transgression of the Lord in His right hand*, to cut off iniquity. When Justice agrees with Mercy and is included in them, it is all called Mercy. Then the Union is from "Upward to Upward" <note>an escalation of holiness</note>. Similarly, when Mercy is included and agrees with Justice, it turns back into Justice; then the Union is "Upward to Downward."

This is the secret of the verses and their order in the sequence of fasts. Rabbi Meir transmitted: "When the Lord is strengthened and goes out from His place," it refers to the transition from Justice to Mercy for Israel. It will be clarified for you that "Upward" is the law of the "Act" alone, and everything follows the preparation of the recipients. This is the secret of "The Lord will descend" when He comes to save Israel. He is like a branch that is torn... and the Lord will be favorable to His debtors, for through the "Voice" which is for the wicked, He performs "Loving-kindness" with the righteous. According to the measure of his creator... and from there He strikes in His existence and heals.

# 51 Chapter 51: Part of the Purpose | Chapter 52

Since the desire for the World to Come <note>original: "Olam HaBa"</note> belongs to all who believe, for this reason, He shall be exalted to exalt you. And the power is from those who yearn for the Beloved. And the soul is hidden within Him. This is the secret of Jacob’s ladder <note>literally "the mystery of the hidden thing of Jacob"</note>. **Exaltation:** They shall inherit a throne of exaltation from the heights—meaning the levels that were the place of the Thought, which are designated through the "Exaltation of All." And as for what is written, "And for this, it came into the Work of the Kingdom." The general principle is that every language of exaltation and swelling attributed to the Omnipresent <term>HaMakom: literally "The Place," a common rabbinic title for God</term> refers to the understanding of the one who perceives it. ### Chapter 51

**Passing.** <note>The Hebrew root E-V-R means "to pass" or "to cross."</note> Now, this matter is decreed. And before the Attribute of Mercy <note>original: "Chesed"</note> it says "Passing." In the work of the Confusion <note>Refers to the generation of the Tower of Babel</note>, for the beginning of the exempting of my sins and her burning in the chapter regarding Abram. And if so, every "Passing" is the head of a covenant. And this is in the chapter where Abraham assisted him with spiritual virtues <note>original: "segulot"</note>, for all this was in the Work of the Confusion regarding Abraham, and ended with the decree of the matter. And before Mercy, it said "Passing" between the pieces <note>Refers to the "Covenant Between the Pieces" in Genesis 15</note>. And it said: *On that day, the Lord made a covenant with Abram.* And according to the logic of the matter, our Great Teacher <note>Likely referring to Maimonides or Nahmanides</note> of blessed memory wrote in this generation of language: "And behold, the matter is decreed, and before Mercy, 'and he passed,'" as if to decree the matter of all of them. And within it was a torch of fire that was seen in the matter of a great cloud and a catching fire. And the matter is for the one who understands. And the "thick darkness" <note>original: "arafel"</note> mentioned at the giving of the Torah, and the torch of fire within it—this is the fire that intensified the fire, and His words were heard from within the fire. And it is written: *And the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a consuming fire.* And the written fire **Passed** between the pieces. And it is He who is called "the Groom from of old." And with this name, the Lord made a covenant with Abram by His decree; the Blessed One passed in His very self through the covenant between the pieces, and the wise shall understand. *And I will pass through the land of Egypt* <note>Exodus 12:12</note>—not through an angel. I passed through, perhaps in the midst of My recognition, and His light was revealed, not to look upon their dwelling with them, and not without blessing, for it was not a mere "passing." And it is written: *And I will pass through the land of Egypt*—this is to be understood like a king who passes from place to place.

And the Sages said regarding the verse *And I will pass over you* <note>original: "u-pasachti"</note>: Rabbi Josippon says, do not read it as "and I will pass over," but "and I will step over" <note>original: "u-fashati"</note>, for He took a leap over the houses of the children of Israel in the haste with which He passed. And it is through the power of "leaping over the mountains." And this "Passover" <note>Pesach</note> is "He who stands behind our wall" <note>Song of Songs 2:9</note>. And according to the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>Rashbi, the traditional author of the Zohar</note>: "Yesterday in this language, and how many 'passings' does the Holy One, blessed be He, have? It is only because they do not know the difference between the void and a star." This is explained in my glad tidings. Behold, there was one observation according to all the Sages of Israel, and also from him it is the way of the individual. And this name, before the Teacher <note>Maimonides</note> of blessed memory, they called "the way of the study of the secret," the "Way of Faith." Not all her children who are counted are according to their health; we have no permission to mock them or explain them from our own minds. *And the Lord passed before his face*—this strengthened the Glory and fulfilled what was elevated when He said, *I will cause all My goodness to pass before you.* When He said "before his face," the intention was before the face of Moses, and the removal of his resting was the Goodness, may He be blessed. Our Sages said: *And the Lord passed*—His Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah: the indwelling presence of God</term> passed over my portion. And the attribute of "And He called" refers back to the Glory that passes, for it is the Holy One, the Giver of Attributes.

And I have already explained in the chapter on this "Visit" above, according to the Kabbalah <note>Traditional mystical reception</note> that comes from the Singer to the Sages of Israel. And it is written: *The Lord passed*—the Divine Presence passed. *And a great and strong wind rent the mountains... and after the wind an earthquake... and after the earthquake a fire... and after the fire a still small voice.* These are to leap over the husks <term>Kelipot: "shells" or "husks" that represent forces of evil or concealment in Kabbalah</term> of the uncircumcision. The wind and earthquake are not the ones passing before the Divine Presence; they are far from the Holy, for they are the money of the second chariot <note>A difficult metaphor referring to subordinate spiritual forces</note>. It said of them: *The Lord was not in the wind, the Lord was not in the earthquake, the Lord was not in the fire*—to say that all holiness does not reside or come in them. And it said: *And after the fire, a still small voice.* And this is the praise for them: Holiness, but not "The Holy," in secret and intention. This voice is close to the Holy. It did not say "The Lord was not in it" as it said with the other husks. And because it was from the collective of Holiness, He did not mention the Name in it, but the Voice—we understand it as being present, coming through a path of extension, the Voice that is close to the Holy. And the "Exaltation" is the last of the last. And behold, to Him is the Voice, and it said...

<column-break/>

And the distance of the Voice was to Elijah, of blessed memory, in the bushes. And for this it said: *And it was, as soon as Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle*, just like the matter of *And Moses hid his face*. And this is sufficient for the matter of the chapter.

Every study in relation to the "Matter" in the place of every secret of Emanation <term>Atzilut: the highest of the four worlds in Kabbalah, the realm of pure divinity</term>, and the Great Name shall be refined in His glory. And remember that all His words are directed toward the **Upper Union** for the Holy and for their good, awesome teachings.

In every path there is no lack at all, and there is an advantage of wrath in every place. For when the Divine Presence dwells equally in Israel, it also dwells above. And the connection is hers, for there is a dependency in this: for the service in the place where the Divine Presence sits below. For in me is the second [attribute] of the Ancient One, and in it is the one who opens in prayer, who is blessed. And my God is "here" for the place of peace. And they said: "I will come to your house"—meaning to the union that is on the day of her coming, wrapping My will. And everything is implied in the scripture that says: *In every place where I cause My name to be mentioned*—it did not say "where you mention" but "where I cause My name to be mentioned," meaning that which you cause through your deeds so that I mention My name. And the Holy One, blessed be He, does not come into the "Jerusalem of Above" until He comes into the "Jerusalem of Below." *And the Lord my God shall come, and all the holy ones with You*—meaning in the goodness of the Lord my God to be unified in His glory. And they came with all the holy ones with Him—meaning all the powers shall be elevated in Him, for He is the glory of My light in the calling. And he said to me: *Lord, this gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter it...*

<meta>This page transitions from the general discussion of divine movement and covenants into a specific, high-stakes theological debate regarding the origin of the universe. It addresses the famous and controversial passage in the "Chapters of Rabbi Eliezer" (Pirkei De-Rabbi Eliezer) about the materials used in Creation, which Maimonides (the "Rav") famously critiqued for appearing to suggest that the world was created from pre-existing matter rather than from absolute nothingness.</meta>

The comforter of the shore... <note>The opening lines are fragmentary etymological notes continuing from the previous page's discussion of specific Hebrew roots like B-V-S and K-F-S-R.</note> and its meaning is... and the lightness of my mouth... the floor of the news, the purpose of the confusion, and there is no need to repeat the words. # Chapter 53
Our Sages of blessed memory <note>original: "RZ''L"</note> taught: **"And under His feet was like a work of sapphire brickwork"** <note>Exodus 24:10</note>. This has already been explained—that which was perceived as being beneath His feet as a work of sapphire brickwork was a metaphor for the radiance of the spheres, without needing strange interpretations that deviate from the literal meaning. 

They said: "The heavens are My throne, and the earth is My footstool" <note>Isaiah 66:1</note>, and "His feet stood." The intention of this chapter is only to explain the words of Rabbi Eliezer the Great regarding the foundation of the intention in Chapter 26 of his chapters <note>referring to the *Pirkei De-Rabbi Eliezer*</note>. He used this language: "Heavens—from where were they created? From the light of His garment, for the Holy One, Blessed be He, took of the light of His garment and spread it like a cloth, and they were stretching and going until He said to them, 'Enough!' <note>original: "Dai"</note>. For this reason, He is called God Almighty <term>El Shaddai: interpreted here as 'The God who said Enough (She-amar Dai)'</term>. And the 'light of His garment' is that which is written: 'Who covers Himself with light as with a garment' <note>Psalm 104:2</note>." This is what he said regarding the expansion of the curtain.

"The earth—from where was it created? From the snow beneath the <term>Throne of Glory: the celestial seat of divine manifestation</term>. He took it and threw it upon the water, and the water froze and became the dust of the earth, as it is said: 'For He says to the snow, be earth' <note>Job 37:6</note>." 

The words of the Sage <note>Maimonides, often referred to as 'The Rav' or 'The Guide'</note> were very harsh regarding this. He wondered: if the "feet" and "hands" are to be taken figuratively, as he said regarding the "God of Israel," then what did Rabbi Eliezer see that led him to this? For he is from the "Book of Truth," and it is impossible to find a flaw in him. He <note>Maimonides</note> struggled to reconcile how one could say the heavens and earth were created "from" something. Is it not a principle of our faith that creation is **Something from Nothing** <note>original: "Yesh me-Ayin"</note>? 

If the "light of the garment" is something created, then what was it created from? And if the "snow beneath the Throne" is something created, what was it created from? And if the "Throne of Glory" itself is something created, what was it created from? If he meant that the light of the garment is something eternal and the Throne is eternal, then this would be a great distance from the Torah, and it would resemble the views on the eternity of the universe held by Plato.

Until he <note>Maimonides</note> said: "The end of the matter is that this is a very difficult statement to understand." He suspected that perhaps the heavens and their nature were being compared to something else entirely. 

Behold, our eyes see that the Rav <note>Maimonides</note> considered Rabbi Eliezer to be among our greatest sages, the pillar upon whom all our wisdom hangs. He was a master of the <term>Oral Torah</term> and a descendant of the great lineage, as is known from the Talmud <note>Yerushalmi, end of Chapter 'Aglah Arufah'</note>. They said of Rabbi Eliezer that "since he died, the Book of Wisdom was hidden." And there, the Elders sat, and even though a <term>Bat Kol: a heavenly voice</term> went out to support him, they still debated his views. They said he was worthy of the Holy Spirit... 

Indeed, all who walk the path of logic see that this man, after mentioning the greatest "separation," says he is worthy of the Holy Spirit. This is certainly a mystery. They quote Rabbi Eliezer as mentioned in the Gemara <note>Avodah Zarah</note>, and even the Heavens declare his righteousness, saying "What have you to do with Rabbi Eliezer, for the law follows him in every place!" 

It is also mentioned that when he ascended to the Heavens, he heard the voice of the Holy One, Blessed be He, sitting and engaging with the section of the **Red Heifer** <note>original: "Parah Adumah"</note>, saying: "My son Eliezer says: 'A heifer whose horns and hooves are black...'" He <note>Eliezer</note> said before Him: "Master of the Universe, may it be Thy will that he be of my descendants." He replied: "He is already of your descendants." 

<column-break/>

He <note>Maimonides</note> saw that he should not multiply words for himself. How could he not see that his <note>Rabbi Eliezer's</note> intention was deep? Perhaps the Rav <note>Maimonides</note> himself was forced to interpret these words in a distant way, just as he himself was deep in his explanations. 

The Rav said: "Perhaps the 'light of His garment' refers to the **Active Intellect** <note>original: "Sekhel ha-Po'el"</note> and the 'snow' refers to the **Prime Matter**." Thus, he tried to bring Rabbi Eliezer's words into alignment with the belief in **Something from Nothing** according to his own struggle. 

And if one asks: why did Rabbi Eliezer say such things? The Rav himself answered that those who investigate his book will see that he wrote: "Before the world was created, there was only the Holy One and His Name alone." This proves he believed in the renewal of the world <note>Creation ex nihilo</note>. 

Furthermore, who is to say that the "light of the garment" was not created before the rest of the world? In the explanation of "garment," it refers to the cycle of the intellect. When the intellect cycles, it produces the spheres... so it is possible to explain this according to the dream of the perfect ones. 

Also, the "snow under the Throne of Glory" can be explained according to our knowledge: that the sphere is His throne, and the power hidden within it is the snow. For from the center point, the dust of the earth was created and spread. The "snow" is the coldness of the sphere. This is according to the wisdom of nature. And it is right to explain it thus, and not to rely on the "eternity of the world," which is against the secrets of the Torah.

On the path of truth <note>a phrase often indicating a Kabbalistic or mystical interpretation</note>, Rabbi Eliezer did not mean that the Heavens were literally created from a physical garment. Rather, the "light of the garment" is a hint at the **Great Throne**, for this light is the first cause of the Throne. 

In the beginning, "God created..." <note>Genesis 1:1</note>—this is the Attribute of Mercy. This first light created the Heavens, which are "Fire and Water" <note>original: "Esh u-Mayim," a common play on the Hebrew word Shamayim (Heavens)</note>. Rabbi [Eliezer] matches the Sage [Maimonides] on this: that the Holy One took fire and water and mixed them together to make the Heavens. As it is written: "The beginning of Your word is Truth" <note>Psalm 119:160</note>, which is "Fire and Water." This is the meaning of "He covers Himself with light as with a garment"—with this, the heavens were made. 

It is known from His wisdom that all created beings came forth. This is "God's wisdom," the light of the beginning. "With wisdom, God founded the earth; with understanding, He established the heavens." In the Zohar <note>original: "Mar'eh de-Rut"</note>, it says: "Rabbi Shimon said: 'Everything was created through a secret. When the Holy One desired to create the world, He was wrapped in light, and from that light, the heavens were created.'" This light is called the "Light of the Garment," the primordial light that preceded the world.

"The earth—from where was it created?" This is the "Desirable Land." From the "snow beneath the Throne of Glory"—this is the truth of the Sun, which is His name... for there is a glory above a glory. And from the "snow," it would be folded into Mercy, even though it is the **Attribute of Judgment** <note>original: "Midat ha-Din"</note>. And these two were joined together, the Heavens and the Earth, like a man and his wife...

<summary>This page discusses a famous theological conflict: Rabbi Eliezer's claim that the heavens were made from "divine light" and the earth from "celestial snow." The author mediates between Maimonides' fear that this implies pre-existent matter (Platonism) and the mystical view that these are metaphors for divine emanations.</summary>
