# Chapter 7: Part of the Secrets of the Torah / Chapter 8

In the secret of the Living Creatures <term>Chayot; the four-faced angelic beings described in Ezekiel’s vision</term>, they appear as shining pillars. From whatever place they arrive, they come from the Name <note>original: "HaShem"</note>, and within them is a power to consume, as it is written: "The Lord your God is a consuming fire" <note>Deuteronomy 4:24</note>. They shine and spread forth in this way every single day. Wisdom <term>Chokhmah; the second Sefirah, representing the flash of divine intuition</term> is hinted at in the verse: "herb yielding seed" <note>Genesis 1:11</note>. This "herb" stands within the general light that encompasses the rows of the heavenly array. Regarding the likeness of their faces: "the face of a man, and the face of a lion on the right... the face of an ox on the left... and the face of an eagle" <note>Ezekiel 1:10</note>. And what is the secret of the Elder? The secret of the Eagle, Lion, and Man is that they are all ultimately in the "likeness of Man," and the "likeness of Man" is within all of them. All the "herb" was prepared in this light for the holy service, for the sake of the "Service of Man," as we have written. Because they stand within this light, they always retain their form; they exist without any other garment or state. Therefore, "permanence" is mentioned regarding them, and they stand like plants, enduring forever. This is why it says of them "yielding seed"—to indicate the continuity of life.

The spirit within all of them was completed below, and the Living Creatures exist as a power for the upper beings. This is because their weight is balanced in this light, where existence stands. Blessed be He and His Kingdom! He spoke, and it was composed; it is green and has the power to "yield seed" in a limited way. This includes the appointment of the Living Creatures of the Kingdom <term>Malchut; the final Sefirah, representing the physical manifest world</term> which ascends upward. Because the crown [of the Kingdom] shows mercy to those before it, a pearl descends <note>A metaphor for a soul or a spark of divine light</note> and receives the "tastes" of sweetness. The ranks ascend from the midst of the rock and offer praise; a voice, a coolness, and a lightness shall praise you! She <note>The Shekhinah/Kingdom</note> is guided and joins with her blessings, and is received like wine in the first light that was within her. Because they are blessed, they have permanence in those heavenly "harps." Regarding this row, it is written: "They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness" <note>Lamentations 3:23</note>. This "faithfulness" encompasses fifty <note>Likely the 50 Gates of Understanding</note> every day. All His work is done in "faithfulness," a wealth of life. For life we shall pursue, to unify the upper and lower worlds. This foundation is not suspended; all the walls go with one another, as the Sages of the salt [the ocean] said: "All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return to go again" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:7</note>. The "Kingdom" is the "Sea," which contains and includes everything within it. It clothes them with more than what was there before. After they are included and integrated, He returns and sustains and empties them, returning them to how they were at the beginning. They are "fifty" and are renewed every single day.

Because they stand within the general "Form of Man," they have existence and a "body" similar to the upper beings, hinted at in the row of "herb yielding seed." Therefore, those who consume them are nourished and renewed every day, just like the upper beings who are nourished and renewed, as hinted in the row of "Man." After the completion of the general image that includes all images—which is the "Form of Man" in the row of "herb yielding seed"—what is written? "A fruit tree yielding fruit after its kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth" <note>Genesis 1:11</note>. This refers to the "Righteous One" <term>Tzaddik; the attribute of Yesod, which channels divine flow to the world</term> who yields seed from those upper hints. He throws "seed upon the earth," meaning his seed is within him for the sake of the earth's rest, to make it give birth and sprout, and to bring back its fruits. From the "herb," a "great tree" was made, which is the "fruit tree." This power is the entire proper order of the King's table, which is the "food of Wisdom." First comes "herb yielding seed," and then the "fruit tree." The root of the matter is that the earth produced the "Tree of Life," the fruits of the Righteous One. It is written "fruit tree"—this is the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil, which is a "living fruit." Who is the one who "makes fruit"? This is the Righteous One of the world <note>the Sefirah of Yesod</note> "after its kind." For everyone who has the "breath of the spirit of holiness" in his nostrils is the "fruit of the land." He is like us, "after our kind," for there is a Covenant of Peace between us. Thus, he is found and his portion is "after his kind"; they are alive and exist through him. The "Righteous One" is the "herb," the "fruit," and the "tree." She <note>the Shekhinah</note> becomes pregnant and gives birth to the "fruit after its kind," so that the "herb" (the fruit which is the Righteous One) will be like its kind.

The portion of the one who resembles him—his radiance and his sister—is chosen and resembles them, just like us. For he is clothed in the light of the "living" to see the "revelation of the Names" and the disclosure of his Father's commandments. This is the secret of the "fruit tree": the one who "makes fruit" is the Holy Covenant <note>the sign of circumcision, linked to Yesod</note>. "After its kind" refers to the one who inherits his kindness, for they are "perfect" and "upright," as it is written: "Your eyes behold the righteous." From there they emerge, and they are similar to the Prince. Everything was sown and known within him. He should have said "and his seed is in it," but why does it say "and seed is in him" <note>The Hebrew word 'bo' can mean 'in it' or 'in him'</note>? This refers to

<column-break/>

the earth. Its "seeds" are upon the earth, resulting in its expansion and purity. The "branch of the earth" is there for their benefit, corresponding to the "herb yielding seed," because permanence was decreed for it; it does not pass away. Therefore, it is written "after its kind" <note>original: *le-minehu*</note> with an extra letter *Yod* (י) to indicate the "begetter" <note>The letter Yod often symbolizes the point of creation or the masculine seed</note>.

Who is the one who begets? Even though she [the earth] transgressed the decree—for the Holy One, blessed be He, said: "Let the earth bring forth... a fruit tree," meaning the tree itself should taste like the fruit, yet she did not do so. Instead, she produced a "tree making fruit," where the fruit is eaten but the tree is not eaten. In the chapter "A Man Leaves," it is explained that "fruit tree" refers to the "Blessing for Generations." When they asked Rabbi Joshua, he did not answer this way, for even for future generations, the taste of the tree and its fruit were not equal. This returns to what Rabbi Joshua ben Levi said, and Reish Lakish said: "All the works of Creation were created in their full stature and height" <note>A famous Talmudic dictum from Rosh Hashanah 11a</note>. The meaning is that their souls were made by the Creator as a "fruit tree," but for future generations, this was diminished because of the sin of Adam.

In the way of truth (Kabbalah), everything is prepared. "A fruit tree making fruit" refers to the matter we hinted at: the "tree" makes "fruit" in the lower realms. If it is diminished in the beginning, it will later "multiply like a pomegranate" in the upper realms and be prepared in the Kingdom. On this [third] day, two "sayings" <note>The phrase "And God saw that it was good"</note> were said. This is because the third "saying" is the deciding factor, drawing from the two sides, Right and Left. The "Right" side contains the "Living Man," which is the "Living Tree" and the "sustaining power." Through him, the "saying" completed this work. Because of this, it is written "that it was good" <note>Genesis 1:10 and 1:12</note>. For the power and heat of the Sun are integrated into the "flow" and the "walking of the fruits." At the end, the nourishment of the branch is completed and integrated. Therefore, "that it was good" is said of it twice. A separate "saying" was not given to it because this day includes the two general principles of Right and Left; they are harmonized, sustained, and separated, and the conflict is removed. This is why "it was good" is said for both. This is what we hinted at in this chapter.

->**Chapter 8**<-

**And God said, "Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven"** <note>Genesis 1:14</note>.
The light we hinted at, which was integrated on the first day, was a light of such intensity that it had no limit to its existence. It would have overwhelmed the world, so it was not used for the first three days. Instead, he took from it what was appropriate and hid it away for its proper time. Furthermore, that "covering" did not spread out except to the end of the "Thought," and there it stands for the need of the "Righteous"—specifically the righteous. It is not given in your gifts except according to the "Desire" and the "Will" of the matter. It is explained: that light was blessed during the six days of Creation to shine during the day. However, it was hidden and removed from them because of the "wicked." It was not created to serve only during the day; rather, it was hidden, prepared for the righteous in the future. Then, "the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days" <note>Isaiah 30:26</note>. Note that it says "sevenfold" and not "threefold."

On the fourth day, the lights were fixed in their positions. He commanded them for the seven days that are prepared. In truth, it was created to shine only during the day—meaning, in the state that He said "let them be." If they were in this perfect state, there would have been no "second" or "traditional" light [the moon] to oppose the Sun. For the Sun is the "King," the "Light," and the "Interior," and the moon would be the secondary "Face." But it was not so. He intended to reveal the "Upper Wisdom," so that light was hidden—meaning, for the sake of the "returning light." It is prepared above, in the highest heights, for the sake of the righteous. Through the "Plant of Desire," it will be established and ascend to the "Ancient of Days" <term>Atik Yomin; a name for the most hidden, ancient aspect of God</term> until the time when the "blemish" is removed and the Crown returns to its rightful place. This is what is written: "the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun," exactly as they were in the beginning of the "Desire." Then the "light of the sun shall be sevenfold," rising to the highest level to be called "Mercies." The feminine aspect will then be integrated without any "seed-sowing" <note>meaning without the need for external influence/diminishment</note>, and her beauty will be revealed. This is the "Great Gate." This is the secret of the "Seven Upper Days" in their totality. This will occur on the day when the Lord "binds up the breach of His people" below and heals the "wound" <note>original: *machatz*</note>, which is the diminishment of the moon, and it shall be healed. In the Midrash, it asks: What did He do when He hid it? He created the "lights." The light was hidden from it—a light that was sweet and sublime to its very end. With it, the world was created. For the Holy One, blessed be He, looked at the generations of the future and saw that they would not be proper...

It details the "Hidden Light" of the first day, which was concealed for the righteous in the messianic future when the moon’s light will be restored to equal the sun's.</summary>

# Chapter 9: Part of the Secrets of the Torah / Chapter 116

The sages rose to support the reasoning with a cloak <term>Tallit; a prayer shawl</term> of hole-weave that was entirely white. This represents the "blue of the servants of the Lord" and their rectification for the "Princes of the Shining Ones" <term>angels of light</term>, placing things upon the foundation of their proper form and their attached completions. The sages were careful among themselves to keep these matters alive through the "Fenton" <note>This likely refers to a specific meditative or mnemonic technique</note> and with necessity, in the way of both the revealed and the hidden, based on clear assurances—some of them revealed and some with simple intention. Why should your thoughts fall away from all these things you have heard, whether they seem near or far? The movements we have acquired in the "Secret of the Chariot" <term>Ma'aseh Merkavah; the earliest form of Jewish mysticism</term> are based on the truth. For the sake of the glory of the God of Israel, we have been permitted to reveal secret matters to you, the foundation of your support and your illness...

It is given to the author in the *Book of the Chariots* <note>original: "Sefer Ha-Agallot"</note> that the Assembly broke into two to clarify it, just as in the "House of Branches," Israel intended to hint at this secret in the building of the Crown <term>Keter; the highest Sefirah</term>. It did not say "to clarify it" in every place, but rather it is clarified and hidden in his words. Therefore, I will not proceed to decide, but rather to place the relationship of the verse. It will be to give strength when Gabriel <term>the archangel of judgment/strength</term> prevails and the God of the heavenly hosts casts down the Accuser <term>Samael or Satan</term> and all his helpers and officers who prosecute us. Their judgment is upon us, and he will be removed from His sanctuary. He will be sanctified before my eyes and the eyes of your lions until the day of his binding. In his rising, let there be no memory of him, and let the hidden canopies be like tens of thousands of officers from the exile, and the troops of the cloud...

And with the "Razor of Strength" <term>Gevurah; the attribute of Judgment</term>, the upper princes will be awakened to stand in the vitality of the movement upon a foundation more than at the beginning of the accusations... The upper princes will be submerged in the hidden upper horn, in the deep, and the degree will be in life, and you will delight in the joy of happiness. In the time of anger, it will be as at the first, and the righteous will rejoice and delight in it, for it is an "everlasting covenant" <note>Genesis 9:16</note> in their hearts, prepared for the future to come. The simple division is like the "Ancient Craftsman," and the action was prepared and ready for the sake of the Upper and Holy Name. This is the "Envious Zeal" for the sake of the upper dwellings, the reward of the Garden of Eden. This is what we have taught you regarding "the blue of the Lord's servants and their righteousness." All this is the language of our Sages, of blessed memory, in their secret tongue, and the Elders whom we loved in the kingdom.

And "every living soul" <note>Genesis 1:21</note> that is "blessed" is the one that was forgiven previously. This is the "soul of every living thing" that is attached. This is the "Pre-eminent Living Creature" <term>Chayah; a high-ranking angel</term> in its material. The Sages compared "Night" <note>original: "Laylah"</note> to the language of "creeping" <note>original: "romesa"</note>, hinting at the attribute of Night <term>often associated with Malchut/the Shekhinah</term>. Concerning this, it is said: "therein all the beasts of the forest creep forth" <note>Psalm 104:20</note>. They all walk because of the darkness of the night, and as guards of the night to arrange things for Love. They do not change, and their waves are the chosen ones of the Lord... And concerning this: "all the beasts of the forest creep forth," which indicates the vitality of the "Lower Ocean." They are like days... stretching to all sides, and they are the "Living Shining Ones." This provides for them to nourish the offering of light from the Upper Pool, the Source of Life. Therefore, the first one we arranged regarding the "Garment," their blessing is to distribute everything to each of the upper powers to perform their actions, whether for Judgment or for Mercy. Therefore, the second one we arranged in the "Unification of the Name"—the blessing also comes from the Upper Unification to protect the Will until the "Pool of the House of David" <term>the Sefirah of Malchut, the recipient of divine flow</term>. This is "the day," which is in the building of the fullness that receives the drawing forth toward it...

<margin>257</margin>
...to spread with mercy... the multiplication of the angels... from the Lord... and therefore they will be compared to branches... like the matter of "all the rivers run into the sea" <note>Ecclesiastes 1:7</note>... and this is the reason for the division of intention in this chapter.

->And God said: Let the waters swarm with the movement of living souls...<-

### Chapter Ten

<column-break/>

...to the center. And the "swarming" <note>original: "sheretz"</note> is the swarming of the waters. In every repetition, Rabbi [X] said: This is the spirit of the First Man <term>Adam HaRishon</term>. From that earth, which is the site of the Holy Temple, "living soul" <note>Genesis 2:7</note> refers plainly to the soul of the First Man. This is why it is written: "the tree which is in the midst of the garden" <note>Genesis 2:9</note>, and "from the fruit of the tree"—this refers to the Holy One, blessed be He, who is in the midst of the Garden, in the midst of the "Five" <term>the five inner Sefirot</term>.

As it is written: "And God said: Let us make man in our image, after our likeness" <note>Genesis 1:26</note>. And for this reason, He created them male and female, as it is written: "male and female He created them" <note>Genesis 1:27</note>. He formed for him "two faces" <term>Du-Partzufin; the idea that Adam and Eve were originally joined back-to-back</term>, and afterward He separated them from one another. The Sages said: This is why "it was good" <note>Genesis 1:10</note> was not said on the second day, because they were destined to be separated from one another and were not yet [fully] created. As long as they were attached to one another and were not "face to face," the Human was not complete and it was not "good," for they were two-faced. And it is written: "It is not good for the man to be alone" <note>Genesis 2:18</note>. Was he alone? It is written "male and female He created them"! Rather, there was a "hiddenness" to his soul because she was attached to his back like a single surface, and this was "not good."

Therefore, know that "it was good" was not said during the creation of man below because he was created with two faces, until they were [separated] and then it was said "behold, it was very good" <note>Genesis 1:31</note>. To make for him a "helper against him" <term>Ezer Ke-negdo</term> so she would be opposite his face, to attach together face to face. What did the Holy One, blessed be He, do? He separated them and nullified the attachment from behind. The verse says: "And He took one of his ribs" <note>Genesis 2:21</note>—this "one" is the Female <term>Nukvah</term>. He brought her to the Man, and behold, she was built and brought to the "Apartment" <note>The bridal chamber or canopy</note>... to be face to face. For until now he was "alone," without a witness... and they became "children to children" <note>a phrase implying generational continuity</note>. He made him a helper against him. Since they were found as male and female who were at the beginning two-faced, Man was also found to be on that form...

And what is written: "The Lord God sent him forth from the Garden of Eden to till the ground from which he was taken" <note>Genesis 3:23</note>? Thus it is, and the "Holy One" is the Female who was created from the First Man... from the "rib" which He took from there.

<margin>257</margin>
Rabbi Samuel bar Nachman already said: At the hour that the Holy One, blessed be He, created the First Man, He created him with two faces. They were created and built back-to-back... It is written: "And He took one of his ribs" <note>Genesis 2:21</note>. One said: He split him into two... and another said: "rib" <note>tzela</note> means "side," as we translate the biblical word for the side of the Tabernacle.

The intention is that the "Side" is what stands and includes one of the souls of the Beginning—this is "my dove, my perfect one, she is the only one" <note>Song of Songs 6:9</note>. His kidneys... for the dwelling of the Tabernacle. And the measurement in the world: on the day of both of them, from East to West... as the prophet says: "the West" is the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term> in the West, and "the East" is the rising sun. And this is what they said: At the hour the Holy One, blessed be He, created the First Man, He created him as a golem <term>unformed mass</term>, and he stretched from one end of the world to the other, as it says: "Your eyes saw my unformed substance" <note>Psalm 139:16</note>. Furthermore, they said he filled the whole world, from East to West, from North to South, from the firmament of heaven to the end of the sea... all this secret is the "Hiddenness of the First Man," for he includes everything. His union is in all from East to West, and he fills everything, including all the powers.

And God said: "Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed... to you it shall be for food. And to every beast of the earth... every green herb for food" <note>Genesis 1:29-30</note>. These matters are very precise and include a high attachment and a very precious foundation. Behold, this is the distinction that the wise man will understand: that "grass is for the cattle and herbs for the service of man" <note>Psalm 104:14</note>. I have already written regarding the "Secret of the Throne of the Earth," and this is "And God said" regarding the Covenant. This is "every green herb for food."

# Chapter 8: Part of the Secrets of the Torah / Chapter 9

"Bring an atonement for Me" <note>original: "Hevi'u alai kaparah"; a reference to the Talmudic legend in Chullin 60b where God asks for an atonement because He diminished the moon</note>, so that the end of death may be removed and the judgment <term>Middat Ha-Din; the attribute of strict justice</term> may be subdued through atonement for Me. As it is written, "Seraphim <term>fiery angels</term> stood above Him." Regarding this, it is written "the atonement of atonements unto the Lord" <note>referring to the Yom Kippur ritual</note>. Unlike the assembly of Korah <note>a biblical rebel</note> who sought to stir up controversy, here the command "Bring an atonement for Me" is for the sake of five sons <note>likely referring to the five levels of the soul or five divine attributes</note>, so that judgment is subdued and removed, and the "brain" <term>Moach; the source of divine flow</term> does not dry up. In all of this, my tradition is not firmly established, and the entire matter of the word is not needed except for the following:

The lack and the "lessening of the moon" occurred on the fourth day because it represented the fourth leg of the Chariot <term>Merkavah; the divine throne-chariot</term>. Afterward, they were diminished in quantity to teach about this side and that side—those who spread out from the "upper frost" <note>or "crystal," referring to the firmament</note> that governs the day, and those who spread out from the "lower frost" that governs the night. These are like the stars, great and small, and the camps of angels hanging from them, which are beyond number. All of them are hung in the firmament of the heaven, which is the "Upper Firmament" that covers and prepares them. 

You should see them in the firmament of the heaven—this refers to the hidden firmament that includes them all, which is the container that receives the divine abundance. From there, everything was diminished and turned back to reflect a light that is not its own, but rather a nature of shifting upon the edge. This is hinted at in "the day and the night." For the first scripture establishes each in its time and rectification, as it is written: "the great luminary to rule the day and the lesser luminary to rule the night." Everything was contained within the dominion of the day and night. Regarding the soul, this verse comes to inform us that they rule by day and by night. In this, our Rabbis of blessed memory intended in their tradition to mention "day in the night" and "night in the day" <note>referring to the liturgy where day and night are mentioned in the same blessing</note> to indicate the "Unification" <term>Yichud</term>, showing that they are not separate. Rather, the "Great Luminary" <note>the Sun/the attribute of Mercy</note> is the essence of the day’s rule, and the "Lesser Luminary" <note>the Moon/the attribute of Kingship</note> is the essence of the night’s rule. Truly, this is to bless and praise, and from this, it says "to separate between the light and the darkness."

We have already been shown regarding day and night, as Rabbi Hullis <note>likely a scribal error or obscure sage</note> said: "If these guards are before Him, He has already prepared the Great Luminary for the rule of the day." Our sages of blessed memory also established "to rule by day and by night," meaning the divine attributes rule over that which was created for the day and that which was created for the night. This hints at what is said: "He who rules over man must be righteous, ruling in the fear of God." The one who rules over everything has the advantage; for the "Righteous One" <term>Tzaddik</term> is the master of the decree—God decrees, and the Righteous One annuls it. I have already written this.

Your wisdom is rectified behind you as the "King" <note>the Sun/the Divine</note> approaches, for the Lord has given power within him to merit light from the darkness. It is called "the word of the Lord is pure" <term>imrat Adonai tzerufah</term>, like a refined and purified vessel, free from dross. What I have written is the illness of its lack; the "fear of the Lord is pure" spreads out from it, acting as a shield against all types of destructive forces and punishments that roam and wander the world in times of darkness. But for all those who take refuge in Him, and those who are grasped and expert in the Hebrew letters, He is a shield to cover and protect. This is the secret of our God, which we intend to work with in this chapter.

### Chapter 9
->**"And God said, 'Let the waters swarm with swarms of living souls, and let birds fly above the earth across the firmament of the heavens.'"**<-

"Let them swarm" implies they shall multiply from above. The "waters" represent the seed of peace that descends from these heavenly beings until the ends of the world, and from there they are fulfilled. 

**"Swarms of living souls"** <term>Nefesh Chaya</term> refers to all the upper creatures that receive influence from the "dual-form" <term>Du-Partzufin; the original androgynous state</term> and the soul. **"And birds fly above the earth"** refers to the light and the influence that all of them inherit as a world-inheritance upon the "earth of the abyss" <note>the physical or lower spiritual realm</note>, reaching the face of the firmament of the heavens. This refers to the place between the two Cherubim <note>angelic figures atop the Ark of the Covenant</note>. The light has been hidden from the beginning of the world, but it shines completely upon the face of the heavens.

**"And birds fly above the earth"**—this means the bird shall return and circle and return again. This is the secret of the "Essence" <note>the divine flow</note> that hovers over the earth to bring it forth and sustain it to bear fruit. This is the source of all the stars, and from it comes the power of the "Great Ones" <note>the archangels</note>.

As it is said in the name of his son <note>referring to a lineage of sages</note>: **"And let birds fly..."** and so on. This refers to the matter of "flying" in the coming of our guilt-offering in holiness. This was established by the masters of the "Face" <term>Panim; the inner divine countenances</term>.

<column-break/>

**"Like a bird that flies"**—it shall return and fly and return again. The kingdom <term>Malchut</term> shall not be lacking for it, for it brings peace to the world for the children of men. In another vision, it is written **"flying above the earth."** For there are others that are not visible except in the spirit itself, meaning they are perceived only according to the smallness of human intellect. In their physical vision, they are hidden, as will be explained further in Chapter 28 of this part with divine assistance. Regarding the heavens, it is written according to its kind: **"and every winged bird according to its kind."** These are the ones who are derived from the species of the world. They are not seen except according to the limitation of the intellect. But others are seen in the likeness of a man. Of these, it is written "according to their kind" because they are derived from their own species. One should not ask: "Do they derive one from another?" For certainly, they do derive one from another, since these and those are fruitful, and it is written: "and from there they shall branch out."

In the *Genesis Rabbah* of our teacher, he said regarding the two "Great Taninim" <term>sea monsters/dragons</term> that they are the two angels of the left. This is what is written in the scripture: "He who walks upon the wings of the wind," and "He makes His angels spirits." Rabbi Hanina said they are the "Swarming Creatures." And "God created... every winged bird that flies," and it is written "with two wings he flies." According to all these words, the creation of the angels was intended for the work of the sun. But it is not written "and they were created," rather "the firmament established them."

Regarding the "waters," it is written **"Let the waters swarm."** It is known that the waters are drawn to every human soul. As it is said, "as water reflects the face to the face," so too are the faces of the angels seen by the children of men. For they were created by a different word <note>a different divine utterance</note>, appearing similar to one another in the speed of the work of each and every day.

**"And God created the great sea monsters"** <term>Taninim</term>—these are the four camps of the Shekhinah <term>Divine Presence</term>. Each one of them receives from one of the Divine Attributes <term>Middot</term>, as it is seen regarding them as "birds of the heaven." Their existence is established through them.

**Michael** is on the right of the Throne <note>the Chariot</note>. He is the High Priest because he hastens to atone for sin.
**Gabriel** is on the left, receiving from the attribute of Strength <term>Gevurah</term>. The mark of the letter *Tav* was placed upon him. Therefore, he is the prince of the power of the Lord. To hint at his priesthood, they said in the *Midrash Bereshit*: "Michael is at the beginning, Gabriel is as written..."
**Uriel** is in front, receiving from the attribute of Mercy <term>Rachamim</term>. From there comes light, and he is the one who gives light like the sun.
**Raphael** is above, receiving from them in order to heal the "dust of the earth" <note>humanity</note>.

The mnemonic for them is from our teacher: **"Argaman"** <note>an acronym for Uriel, Raphael, Gabriel, Michael, and Nuriel</note>. Thus, their secret is "Light-Healer-Strength-Who-is-like-God" <note>the meanings of their names: Uri-el, Rapha-el, Gabri-el, Micha-el</note>. The "Light of Lights" who rides upon them sustains them and is their "Right Hand."

**"And every living soul that creeps"**—this is the spirit that is within the "Sanctuary of Adam," the work of a master, which is life itself. **"Which the waters swarmed"**—from the foundation of everything, and all the powers that receive from them are prepared to receive, each one according to its nature and its work. **"And every winged bird according to its kind"**—this means the waters shall lead that which is light and easy.

Another matter: the "Great Cherubim" shall know the knowledge of God. These are **Leviathan** and its mate. Such is the opinion of Jonathan ben Uzziel in his translation <term>Targum</term>: "the great sea monsters" refers to Leviathan and its mate. "Leviathan" comes from the language of "attachment" <term>levayah</term>, meaning a connection, like "a wreath <term>livyat</term> of grace." This is to say that they are great. Look at what they said regarding the hidden "Great Fish" and the greatness of the light and its diminution here and there.

The author of the *Yeshivah* said: "Rabbi Yehuda said in the name of Rav: Everything that the Holy One, blessed be He, created in His world, He created male and female. Even Leviathan... He created male and female. But had they mated, they would have destroyed the entire world. What did the Holy One do? He castrated the male and killed the female, salting her away for the righteous in the world to come."

The theologians intended this "killing" to refer to what is explained to the masters of Kabbalah. Regarding the "Primordial Ones," they spoke in this language: to give a place for the words of the earlier masters of Kabbalah, of blessed memory, who explained by way of parable. There was one "Great Fish" that was as large as the sea itself, until the day of its fulfillment, and it was full of... <note>text continues to next page</note>

In this Sphere, in its fullness, the seven days exist in its reality in a "Tenth" <note>or "Tithe"</note>. The "Lower Elohim" created the "Upper Worlds" by the power of the Higher beings. And the "Wine of Judgment" <note>original: "Yayin HaDin"</note> shall not be mentioned by name, which is for the life of the "Neighbor" <note>original: "Shakhen"</note> so that he should not be made in his residence.

When the world was founded in his days, the attributes were "clothed." He associated the "Measure of Mercy" with the "Measure of Judgment" and created the world. And this inclusion is impossible to put first. And within the "Upper Days," which are the "Six Days of Building" <term>Yemei Ha-Binyan; the six Sefirot from Chesed to Yesod</term>, to bind within it the soul of the Heavens. "The Lord made the Heavens and the Earth," but it is not called "Complete" until the Six Days are with the "Making" of Heaven and Earth. In their revelation and their existence in their fullness, all the works shall be straightened. And in the "Oaths" <note>original: "shevu'ot"</note> from the Lord of Heaven and Earth. And these were created by Will, to take delight, not by His fullness. For He is the "Head of Completions." And behold, "your day" is from within it, for it shall go up from our Heavens. And I have already mentioned this. And in the "Measure" of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, peace be upon him: "The Sixth Day." This is the "Man" <note>original: "Ish"</note>. And after this, he associated the "Right" <note>The side of Mercy</note>. And at the beginning, the "Building" <term>Binyan</term>. These are the "Five" <note>original: "Heh"</note>. This is what is written: "Behold, the Foundation" which was made like the "First Thought." Like the "Right Hour" <note>original: "Sha'at Yamin"</note> in the "Daughter of the Palaces" <note>original: "Bat Ha-Heikhalot"</note>. And "Alas" <note>original: "Alai"</note> was the "Worlds." He called out "Princes" to satisfy his "Couch" upon the Great Lord: "The Greatness, the Might, the Beauty, the Victory, and the Majesty" <note>original: "Ha-Gedulah, Ha-Gevurah, Ha-Tiferet, Ha-Netzach, ve-ha-Hod"; the five Sefirot preceding Yesod</note>. For "all that is in the Heavens and Earth" <note>reference to 1 Chronicles 29:11</note>—these are the "Six Days." And this was in the calling of the sea. And if the beginning is "Ten," then it is "Thirty." Behold, it is one, and it is called "Day." And if the beginning is "Ten," and then "Thirty," and then "One," there is no "Day" there that can be called by name to awaken it. Therefore, the "Days" were not hinted at as corresponding to the "Divided Ones." And as we wrote: "And in all the days he made..." He was there to receive the "Beauty" <note>original: "Yofi"</note> through the "Year" <note>original: "Shanah"</note> and the "Time." And the "Seven" <note>Sabbath</note> is with the "Right" <note>Mercy</note> and its "Existence."

And indeed, the matter returns to the "Yesod" <term>Foundation</term>, the "Sixth Day." For he enters before the "Right Side." And he is the "Mercy of the Shekhinah." And in him, the "Building" is completed. And I have already written that he is the "Vav" <note>The letter Vav, representing the number 6 and the Sefirah of Tiferet/Yesod</note>. And my "Twin" <note>original: "te'omati"</note> is the investigation of the "One" and the "Support of the Sabbath." Let there be no "Glory" for him, for he is the "Glory of the Day." And why is it called "Sabbath"? "Sabbath" is another word. Is it not written: "Between Me and the Children of Israel"? And this was the "Sixth." It is written: "And behold, they were for a light upon the Foundation." And therefore, "on the Sixth Day God made..." And after that, the "Living Creatures of the Right" were in the "Measure of Mercy" supporting the "Right." And with this, the intention is completed.

### Chapter 11

I have already written that the "Lower Elohim" is the "Last" <note>The Shekhinah</note>. She created, acted, and made the Heavens and the lower things. And all was created in them by the power of "Beginning" <term>Bereshit</term>, for it is the "Ascent of the Higher Beings." "The Ascents of the Heavens and the Earth" are in levels. And in all my teachings, Rabbi Levi said: "In their creation" <note>original: "be-hibaram"</note>, which is "In Abraham" <note>A classic anagram used by the Sages to show the world was created for the sake of Abraham</note>. And the hint is regarding the "Last Point," which is the secret of "Leah" <note>The hidden aspect of the Divine Mother</note> and her skin, and she is the "Small Rachel" <note>The revealed aspect of the Divine Mother/Shekhinah</note>. And the word "Elohim" is by the power of the "Beginning" that was. And I will ask of him to explain. These are the "Lower Ones" created, and they were the "Simple Sabbath." And he shared in the "Lower Ones" all by the power of the "Beginning," as we wrote. And they were hinted at in their strength and their shade. The "Beginning" <note>original: "Bereshit"</note>—everything is "Two Beginnings" <note>original: "Beit Reshit; the letter Bet equals two"</note>. And because of his... already. And for the completion and the wisdom of the "Holy Service," his mark is as it is written: "The Reception of the Wise." All his sons. And after the "Lower Creation," the "Lesser" one, he said to him: "How much shall I mention the Heavens and the Earth?" They were as one in their strength. And his help was their end. Behold, these "Gods" shall reign... and all the light. And at the end of the days, they were in the "Covering" of the "First Cloud."

# Chapter 12 — Part of the Secrets of the Torah — Chapter 13 [Page 118]

And afterwards, the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil. And following this, as a choice for the one who engages with it, it is like the "face-to-face" <term>Panim be-Panim; a state of direct divine communion</term> because the inner parts are doubled. This and that are living beings... as it is above in sleep and in the "chariots" <term>Merkavot; the divine structures through which God interacts with the world</term> to take shelter in the shadow of the Lord. For everything comes from the Lord God, who has "faces" <term>Partzufim; divine personas or configurations of the Sefirot</term> and they are He and His Name. And the Tree of Life is in the midst of the garden, composed of the Divine Name <note>original: Yah</note> in its various kinds, rooted in the Divine above and below.

And the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil is the deputy of the secret of the Assembly of Israel <term>Knesset Yisrael; the spiritual collective of the Jewish people, often associated with the Shekhinah</term>. It contains the sides of Good and Evil joined together, for the good was still mixed with its "shell" <note>original: matrav; likely referring to the Kelipot or husks</note> and the good was not yet separated from the wicked. For this reason, it is called the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil, because it "nurses" from both sides and knows them, like one who nurses and tastes both sweet and bitter. Because it receives from both sides and knows them, and the "reed" <note>the central channel</note> is within it, it is named thus.

Regarding the matter, there is a hint here to the Higher Unity. "The Lord God caused to grow from the ground" (Genesis 2:9) refers to that which emerges below, the cause of the Fifty <note>referring to the Fifty Gates of Understanding</note>, the cause of Moses. He brought forth "every tree that is pleasant to the sight and good for food." Moses, in his vision, saw the Tree of Life in the midst of the garden and the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil, and this is explained. Afterwards, with the ease of the choice of the luck of the Unity and the ultimate end, "a river went out from Eden to water the [garden]" (Genesis 2:10). The river went out from there, even in that state of interruption, to water the garden. Everything is watered and unified, but in the "row of separation," the garment and the foundation are more than the life of the garden. For in its lowliness, it surrenders to the complete Unity, and further down it causes separation. "From there it divided and became four heads" (Genesis 2:10), which are the four camps of the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term>. 

"And the Lord God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden" (Genesis 2:15). In this matter, He planted the man there. Everything is a model, and the words are doubled, yet all is one. "To work it and to keep it" — the garden requires work, and its foundation is in Eden. It requires guarding so that no "strangers" <note>unauthorized or impure forces</note> approach the inner holiness, for the uncircumcised and the impure must dwell outside the camp. Man is appointed over all of this, for the body is like a garment, and he must work with his soul and guard his entrance. Already, the concepts of "working" and "keeping" are partitioned into the sacrifices. This is the secret of the sacrifices of animals and birds... as explained by the Sages. They hinted at this because just as the heights of clarity and the fruit of the vision of Unity are the ultimate power of the Creator, so too was this Unity and the body of man. The oversight within him was intended to bring him near... so that they would not be mixed with "wine" <note>symbolizing judgment or intoxication</note> and he would not be fit to offer the sin offering in the appointed time. For through the "mashing" <note>digestion/refinement</note>, the food is absorbed and its nutrients are released... the kings burn together and "sweeten the secret" <note>a phrase from Psalm 55:14, meaning intimate counsel</note> for themselves, and no stranger is among them. 

The interpretation was explained to him: "The Lord God commanded," etc. We have received a tradition that this refers to a "kiss" upon the nature of the blows and pains of this source. He completed the work and the "image" <term>Diyukan; the spiritual form or archetype</term> to indicate that the intention was to guard it from any higher place, so that it would be the place of the lower Shekhinah. The body must be very careful with it and guard it... In the Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai (Rashbi), may he rest in peace, Rabbi Yose said: That which we have learned, that he was commanded regarding "working and keeping"—how many people were there in the world that he needed this? Rather, it certainly refers to this Tree, for in it we see that he was "annulled" like the students... in the lower way that we see. The Tree of Life—we expound from it. Does it enter your mind that the *Lulav* <term>Palm branch used on Sukkot</term>, which is a requirement of Strength <term>Gevurah</term>, was what he was commanded about? Indeed, there was an interruption, and it is forbidden to the Altar below... except with her husband, so that it would not be "cut off" <note>meaning spiritually severed</note>. Regarding this, he was commanded concerning the taking of the *Lulav*, because anyone who does this makes it "thick" <note>substantial</note>. Rabbi Isaac said: Everything is like this, and it is forbidden below with the lower like a donkey, unless it is done as one. Thus far. And you should understand that the nature of "working and keeping" is hinted at in this Name, for the tree is forbidden... Similarly, one who neglects "immersion from the impurity" is like one who sheds blood. The Garden of Eden does not unify its name for man and does not provide for him except through an "invitation" <note>ritual preparation</note>, so that...

<column-break/>

...there should not be a sacrifice that separates him from the world. He also should not steal "his life and his life" <note>likely referring to spiritual and physical life</note> regarding the matter of "stealing from his father and his mother" (Proverbs 28:24). It says, "He who robs his father or his mother and says, 'It is no transgression,' is the companion of a destroyer." "Father" is none other than the Holy One, Blessed be He, and "Mother" is none other than the Assembly of Israel. For he is a "destroyer" even before the building is complete, as he prevents the light from his Father and his Mother; thus, he is a thief. The prohibition of "a limb from a living animal" <term>Ever Min HaChay; one of the Seven Noahide Laws</term> is clearly explained here. Those who are "empty" <note>spiritually hollow</note>—for the one who ruins the "watering" <note>the flow of divine bounty</note> is the blemish that leads to all other blemishes. "Blessing the Name" <note>a euphemism for cursing God's name</note> is related to the secret of "the voice of the Lord" and "a voice was heard in Ramah" (Jeremiah 31:15). This is a hidden secret. All of this is doubled, and everything depends on that final [level].

"From every tree of the garden you may surely eat" (Genesis 2:16)—He permitted everything to him. And in the Midrash of the Rashbi, may he rest in peace: This refers to the day when the Patriarchs—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—sustain everyone. All of them eat and live. But as for eating from the "fruit" <note>referring to the Tree of Knowledge</note>, one who is separate and alone, this is "death." As it is proven above, regarding this it says: "On the day you eat of it, you shall surely die" (Genesis 2:17). For the intention is that all existence is unified; one should not eat of it in isolation, nor provide for it or take it in a state of separation. Rather, on that day, even the "laws" <note>referring to legalistic or harsh judgments</note> were not eaten... Abraham, it is written of him, "Abraham saw from afar" (Genesis 22:4) and he ascended. It is written, "Abraham went from his place." Isaac, it is written of him, "Isaac went to Abimelech" etc., and "Isaac went from there" etc., and "he went up from there to Beersheba." Jacob, it is written of him, "Jacob went out from Beersheba and went toward Haran." These are all secrets of the "Husband" <note>the masculine divine principle, Zeir Anpin</note>. "You shall surely die," for that sin causes "her feet to go down to death" (Proverbs 5:5). It is like a "harvesting" afterwards, and "death in the other." This is the secret of the "End of Days" <note>original: Ketz Ha-Yamim</note>, which is full of honor and will arise. For if he separated, even in his "chariot" he would be separated. The "Nurser" <note>the one who provides spiritual influx</note> made it known that he appointed the Sabbath after it had nursed... sins. He will need "washing after washing" and "preparation after preparation." This is a hidden secret. I have already written the reason for "you shall surely die" in the second part, and it is all truth. This is the end of the matter for this chapter.

### Chapter 13

> And the Lord God said: It is not good for man to be alone; I will make him a helper fit for him. (Genesis 2:18)

This is the tenth Utterance <term>Ma'amar; one of the ten words through which the world was created</term>. All of man's creations were made with complete and precise intention, and this is a hidden secret. Why is it "not good"? Because "good" only exists in union. "Good" was not said on the second day [of creation]... because only in the second did "good" also come. And "it is not good for man to be alone" is difficult to understand regarding the "man" who possesses "faces" <term>Partzufim</term>. It is not good because in that state... man is not a "thing" and is not from this. As it is explained, the Name is in the "test." He is a body that will not be closed... and the "good" that comes is in the Utterance. For Understanding <term>Binah</term> in its requirement... he said this and he... and he created for her... It will be explained thus: that each one alone is not complete, and through the joining of their two aspects, they become one "good" and "complete" thing.

In the Midrash of the Rashbi, may he rest in peace: It was found in the "preciousness" on the side of the male... therefore his side was "split" and the lower part was strengthened with him. All those who are joined are seen as one body. Their movement is outward... it appears on the body, and thus the female. When they are joined, they are like one body. This is the secret of everything: every thing that is joined with intention becomes one body, and they rest... for all of them are from a complete body. Before the "Queen" <term>Matronita; the Shekhinah</term> went out... they were found as one body, and therefore they are praised. "And they shall be one flesh" (Genesis 2:24). The Holy One, Blessed be He... one who is not found with [a partner] is called "half a body." Therefore, blessing does not rest upon a "severed thing" or a "blemished thing," for blessing only rests on that which is complete, not on that which is blemished or partial. A partial thing does not endure forever... Thus far. These words are doubled, and the hint is toward the "Higher Union" <term>Zivug Elyon</term>. Everything is truth, and "Truth" is their seal.

# Part of the Secrets of the Torah — Chapter 12

His time was set before him, face to face <term>Panim be-Panim; a state of direct, unmediated divine connection</term>, for his honor and as a protection for him. This is the "awakening" that **rose from the earth and watered the entire face of the upper ground** (Genesis 2:6), representing the power of the **Divine Presence** <term>Shekhinah; the feminine aspect of God</term> as the **Queen** with the **King** face to face. Through this, perfection and the ultimate purpose were established. This is visible in both the upper and lower creations, completing the goal for which all of creation exists: **"These are the generations of heaven and earth..."** (Genesis 2:4). It has already been taught regarding the word **"when they were created"** <note>original Hebrew: *be-hibbar’am*</note> that it can be read as "through Abraham," hinting that they were created through his merit. This suggests what I have written: that to create them, they prepared peace, completion, and unity. It was Abraham who established this rectification and strove to complete this purpose. 

The secret of his "vineyard" is like the foundation of creation and its sovereignty, which is the ultimate goal and the fruit. This relates to what was said to Levi regarding the "weight" of heaven and earth. In the midrash of **Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai** <note>The traditional author of the Zohar</note>, it says that the weight of the entire world is contained in the verse "These are the generations of heaven and earth when they were created." This is because everything He prepared for the world to perform with strength was being enacted. All the "deficiencies" in the world were rectified by him <note>Abraham</note>; where others erred, he stood firm, and therefore he received the reward of them all.

As hinted by Rabbi Shimon, at the end of time it is written: **"And the Lord God formed..."** (Genesis 2:7). This describes a rectification within a rectification. There are two kinds: one for the **Ancient Holy One** <term>Atika Kadisha; the highest, most hidden aspect of the Divine</term> and one for the **Small Countenance** <term>Ze’ir Anpin; the emotional/active attributes of God</term>. The text mentions a "lamp of fire" <note>original Aramaic: *botzina de-nura*</note> which refers to this divine light. Everything was directed toward the ultimate goal, in the **Upper Image**, to include both the masculine and feminine. This was to "sow the field" and provide the refinement from both male and female. **"Dust from the earth"** (Genesis 2:7) refers to the impression of the divine seal. All of this was for the sake of completion and "sweetening" <term>Hamitakah; the process of tempering harsh judgment with mercy</term> until the very end. This is the meaning of the **"Breath of Life"** (Genesis 2:7). Just as the sea enters and fills places and they are sustained by it, so too **"man became a living soul."** This allowed him to be weighed and measured according to his rectification, to influence what is lacking, and to "sweeten" the degrees one by one until the very end, so that all parts become unified in His perfection. One who cuts off life from the world is like one who stops the voice of his father-in-law <note>A metaphor for breaking the divine flow</note>. All matters of creation are doubled, as I have mentioned, for the **Work of Creation** <term>Ma'aseh Bereshit; the mysteries of how the world was made</term> reflects the upper realms. 

The words of the holy author are very ancient and precious. All the hidden and sealed secrets of the *Work of Creation* are contained within them. The wise man will take from this to perform the "Holy Service," to understand the secret that the fruit of all creation and its generations is to unify the **Complete Name**. This is the secret of the decree of rectification. It is like the **Upper Bread** which includes male and female. The ultimate goal is the union and "sweetening" that moves from degree to degree, from beginning to end, to show that **He is everything and there is none beside Him.** This is the secret of the "Complete Unity," which is the goal of all. The reason for the "deficiency" was to allow for this rectification and unity. This is the "Whole Bread." Its taste establishes the "Spring of the Source of Life" to awaken the joy of the heart, which is the secret of the inner vitality. It flows from the secret of the **Garden** to provide merit to the **Bride** <note>The Shekhinah</note>. Wisdom carves its path within, sweetening the place. This is what was mentioned above in the verse: **"And the Lord planted a garden"** (Genesis 2:8). This is why "My Name is within him," for the hearing of the "Upper Unity" is the sweetness of the matter. The Lord mentioned "creating" twice because there are two "eyes" or "springs," the secret of the **Living God**, placing the Perfect One there in existence.

<column-break/>

And behold, after all this "change" we have mentioned—that all the details of nature and its parts are conducted according to the natural laws of heaven—their lack and their completion are achieved through the addition of the **Crown** <term>Keter; the highest Sefirah</term> from His Presence in the heart of every man of "secret." From there, everything in the natural day is conducted according to the "Grace of Nature." After their divisions and roles are tasted according to a person's reward and merit, we find the secret of: **"And God blessed the seventh day"** (Genesis 2:3). He opened the source of light and influenced it until it became a blessing, to water from there all those who bless, giving them their reward and sustaining them. **"And He sanctified it"** (Genesis 2:3) means He hid its primordial nature, as it is written regarding Israel's observance of the Sabbath. We have already explained that "rest" occurs within the "natural day." This is the secret of all the "opposites" that spread out. Every day that the Sabbath ends, the wicked and all individual husks <note>forces of impurity</note> are revealed. Each natural day provides them a place and time according to their kind. This is the meaning of "He left over" for each new month—a day of increase and the spreading of "separation" through the cycles of time. All this happens through the power of the natural day. This is the secret of why the **Shekhinah** was the "mouth" of all His work which God created **"to do"** (Genesis 2:3)—from that point forward, the work continues through the power of the initial thought. This is now clarified. With this, the matter of our order is completed for this chapter.

## Chapter 12

**"These are the generations of the heaven and the earth when they were created."** (Genesis 2:4).
The power of this verse is to hint at what the ultimate purpose of creation was. Since these things below are the "generations" and the "fruit" of creation, their purpose is the **Unity and Rectification of the Great Name** in its glory. For the upper realms require their sustenance and appointment to come from the "Beginning." Through the "awakening" that rises from below, the upper realm is awakened. This is the proper order. Since this arose in the Divine Thought, it was enacted quickly. **"On the day that the Lord God made earth and heaven"** (Genesis 2:4). The use of the name "Lord God" <note>Adonai Elohim</note> indicates the intent to act and to rectify. This is the unification of "Elohim" below to become one, like a single harp or a single unity. 

Until this point, the conduct was an awakening toward the heights through mercy. Because the abundance and everything flows from above, this order was set to inform us of the "Rectification." The completion of this work and its perfection were not yet established in their proper structure until the world arrived and was lacking. This is to teach us about the creation of the world and its rectification. Thus, the ultimate goal of the upper and lower beings—which is **Unity**—was the purpose of the "Bride." Everything is like the beginning; though the end of the action was lacking, the entire path is set, good, and beautiful. This is the secret of the "Great Changes" that gladden the heart. 

Before the "change" happened, the **Crown** <note>Keter</note> was not yet in its full rectification, and the **Chariot** was not in its perfection, because the **Shekhinah** had not yet returned "face to face." There was no perfection until that "Upper Lack" occurred, involving these Names which are "two countenances" <term>Du-Partzufin; a state where the masculine and feminine are back-to-back rather than face-to-face</term>. The "Torah of Kindness" was not yet complete. Therefore, in the Upper World, as long as they were not "face to face," there was no rectification and no perfection. To achieve this perfection and rectification, a "Rectifier" and "Completer" is needed from the outside to awaken the **Kingdom** <term>Malkhut</term> through the order of Divine Service and the performance of good deeds. Through this awakening, the impulse ascends from below, and then the impulse is awakened above. This is the secret of the sages' saying: **"Everything is in the hands of Heaven except the fear of Heaven."**

It is mandatory for the "mist" to rise from the earth. When it ascends, the Unity of "Lord God" with Man occurs. This is the secret of the "filling of the Names" and the perfection of this rectification. This was a "Great Torah" that was established. This is also the secret of everything sent to the **Temple** <term>Beit Ha-Mikdash</term>; it is called to its completion as a "sacrifice" above. As long as it is not complete above, there is no perfection below, for one depends on the other. Through the lack of being "face to face" below, the source above is affected.

It highlights the Sabbath as the source of blessing and the role of Abraham in harmonizing the world's spiritual deficiencies.</summary>

# Part of the Secrets of the Torah — Chapter 12 / Chapter 13

And it is the **Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil**. Afterward, it translates into "flesh" <note>This refers to the manifestation of spiritual concepts into the physical realm</note> through a process of heating, as it follows the pattern of the celestial ascents; thus, things are doubled, and this is the secret of living properly.
And this is the meaning of **"and it grew upward"** according to its custom and its paradigm, to know the "Life of the Lord." Therefore, the Name is all-encompassing, the Lord's loving-kindness toward the "two faces" <term>Du-Partzufin; a mystical concept where the male and female aspects of the Divine were originally created back-to-back as one entity</term>, which is the secret of the Name of 72 <note>The 72-letter name of God associated with Mercy</note> and so on. **The Tree of Life was in the midst of the garden**, abundant and mixed like wine, as it appears above and below.
The **Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil** is the secret of the "waste" <note>The *psol* or dross</note> regarding the Assembly of Israel. The "Good" remains established, while the "Evil" is removed. It is said that as long as the Good is mixed with the "bitter dates" <note>referring to the harsh judgments or the *Kelipot*</note>, the food has not yet been separated from the waste. For this reason, it is called the **Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil**, because the one who is separated may be harmed by it, yet he knows how to live as one who is refined—experiencing both the sweet and the bitter. Since he receives from the powers of the celestial spheres, he knows them through this mixture; hence the name.

In its inner meaning, it hints at the existence of the "Wellspring." **And the Lord God caused to grow from the ground** toward the "Jubilee" <note>The Sefirah of Binah, or Understanding</note> to suppress the cause of violence and to cause **every tree that is pleasant to the sight and good for food** to sprout. From there, the **Tree of Life in the midst of the garden** and the **Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil** receive their power, as is explained. Afterward, the secret of their existence and rectification is "translated into flesh" after the concise statement: **And He placed the man in the Garden of Eden to water it.** For this reason, the verse states **to water the garden**, for everything is supplied and unified.
Everything is a singular connection until the point of "interruption," and **from there it was parted and became four heads** (Genesis 2:10). Up to this point, their existence is within the Divine Name, but from there and below is the "World of Separation." From there **it was parted and became four heads**, representing the four camps of the Divine Chariot. **And the Lord God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden.** Regarding the phrase **"and He placed him there,"** it follows the paradigm of all things being doubled, and all of it is truth. **To work it and to keep it** (Genesis 2:15). The Garden requires "work"—providing it with sustenance and nourishment in Eden. And it requires "keeping" so that no **stranger** <note>Impure or external forces</note> shall approach the holy place. Because Eden provides the nourishment for the "river" within it, man must work and guard his own thoughts. These terms, **"to work it and to keep it,"** also refer to the **sacrifices** <term>Korbanot; literally "drawings near," refers to the Temple offerings</term>. This is the secret of animal sacrifices and their preparation.

Regarding the sacrifices, it is said: "You shall offer to God," for prayer is like the sacrifices that sustain the world. They are the ultimate purpose. It is written that we are commanded to offer to Him **"in its appointed time"** (Numbers 28:2), meaning "be careful and guard yourselves" so that the holy does not become mixed with the profane. This is why it is appropriate to offer the Passover at its time; if there is an interruption, the nourishment is delayed. This is like kings who gather together and find sweetness in eating with one another, where no stranger is among them.
The "keeping" refers to the Tree. It is meant to "inflame" <note>original: *le-halhiv*</note> the soul. We enter through the merit of the seven days of creation. The act of "guarding" <term>Shemirah</term> indicates the place of Judgment <term>Din</term>, which is the place where the "bones are dried." Therefore, one must be exceedingly careful to guard it and unify it, as the verse specifies.

In the **Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai** <note>The Zohar</note>, it is said: Rabbi Yose asked, did the Holy One, blessed be He, really need man for "work" and "guarding"? Does the Garden not grow on its own? It certainly does! But the "work" refers to the path of life and the nourishment for the one who receives it properly. Just as the rains descend to show the "sign," so too here. Until they were found in it and nourished by it. On this path depends the trust in the Mighty One. The "prayer" is for Him. It seems to me that "to work and to keep" is a metaphor for a bride waiting for her husband, to whom she is bound. This path is opened for her, and when she is properly prepared, she is no longer forbidden to him. Rabbi Yehuda says: A bride must be strengthened until her husband arrives. For they entered with seven blessings. This is the secret of the Garden, the secret of the Name. Know that the "planting" of the Tree is a holy plant. He who moves it from its roots turns life into blood. Until that life is with her "to work it," and one should not approach her except in a state of unity.

<column-break/>

This would make the Garden a source of "division" at the end of the world. It also means one should not "steal" the judgment and faith, as in the matter of **"one who robs his father or his mother and says, 'It is no transgression'"** (Proverbs 28:24). "His father" is the Holy One, blessed be He, and "his mother" is the Assembly of Israel. For such a person prevents the light from reaching his "father and mother," and he is thus a robber. This is the secret of the prohibition of the Tree.

**God commanded the man... of every tree of the garden you may freely eat** (Genesis 2:16-17). This was permitted to him. In the **Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai**, it is explained that "eating" here refers to the Patriarchs—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—who "ate" and were nourished by the Divine. But regarding **"this"** <note>the Tree of Knowledge</note>, the eating is from below, and it contains things that should only be taken in the proper way. Therefore: **"For on the day you eat of it, you shall surely die,"** because you cause a separation.
The intention was that he should not eat from it in a way that would bring these forces into his own body. He should not have "cut the shoots" <term>Katzetz ba-netiot; a metaphor for heresy or causing separation within the Divine Sefirot</term>. The Patriarchs all "ate" and were nourished, yet they remained attached to the Divine and were not lost. Of Abraham, it is written: **"And Abraham went down to Egypt"** and then **"And Abraham went up from Egypt."** Of Isaac: **"And Isaac went to Abimelech"** and then **"And he went up from there to Beer-sheba."** Of Jacob: **"And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba and went toward Haran,"** and afterward he returned in peace and did not separate himself. He said to Laban the Aramean, "everything is the secret of the Master."
**"You shall surely die"** (Genesis 2:17), for that Tree—"her feet go down to death" (Proverbs 5:5). One who becomes attached to its lower aspect experiences death. This "death" refers to the "waters of the sea" <note>the realm of instability or judgment</note>. By separating his "offering" <note>his spiritual contribution</note>, he causes a separation in the upper worlds. The doubling of the word "die" (*mot tamut*) indicates that he brings a "death blow" upon himself until he rectifies his sin. For this, he will need to undergo transformations—body after body, and will after will. This is a profound secret. I have written further on the reason for "surely die" in the second part, and it is all true. This is sufficient for this chapter.

### Chapter 13

->**And the Lord God said: "It is not good for the man to be alone"**<-
->**etc. And this is explained according to the secret of all creation**<-

With total intention and wisdom in its creation, and this is the revealed secret. The word "Good" is only used for that which is "One." Therefore, "Good" was not said on the second day of creation <note>because the second day introduced division</note>. We see that as long as the "second" exists, there is no "Good." **"It is not good for the man to be alone"** (Genesis 2:18)—this refers to the structure of the "two faces" (*du-partzufin*). It is not good when the "waste" <note>the *psol*</note> is present. Man and woman, when separated, are not called "one," nor are they a "pair." As it says, **"in his image,"** meaning a complete body. The "Good" and the "Blessing" only exist when the **Shekhinah** <term>Divine Presence</term> dwells in his house. This is what is meant by **"Male and female He created them, and He blessed them and called their name 'Man' (Adam)"** (Genesis 5:2). It is clear that while each is alone, they are not "Adam" and are not complete. In their union, the Name is present, and then they are "one," "good," and "complete."

In the **Midrash of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai**, it is taught: Blessing is only found where male and female are together. Because of the "accuser" <note>the *Sitra Achra* or the "Other Side"</note>, the woman was brought to be with him, even if it was "face to face" and so on. They became as one literal body. A man alone is only "half a body," and when they join together, they become "one literal body." So it was with the "doubled" creation: every male joined with a female is one body. When they are together, they are a "complete body." From this perfection, blessings are found. One who is not found as "male and female" is called "half a body," and blessings do not rest upon a deficient thing. Only where there is a "complete place" <note>a state of wholeness</note> do the blessings reside. A "half" never endures and is never blessed. These words are repeated to hint at the two types of union—the upper and the lower. Everything is true, and the one serves as a model for the other. **And the Lord God formed from the ground...**
