<meta>This page continues the discussion on the Garden of Eden, transitioning from the description of the Trees to the mystical significance of the Sabbath as the completion of creation, and then begins Chapter 12 which analyzes the creation of the heavens and earth through the merit of Abraham and the formation of Man.</meta>

And behold, the entire Work <note>The "Work of Creation"</note> awaits the Worker <note>The Divine Architect or the human performing the task</note> through the fulfillment of the commandments. And why is this so? To bring forth the completion on the seventh day. To those lacking counsel, it seemed incomplete; but when You, May You be Blessed, completed it with the rest of the Sabbath, You—as it were—rested and were refreshed. And it is written: **"And He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done."** After He completed His actions, His work became pleasant to Him. Here, it was arranged in its day, and this is the secret of **"And God blessed the seventh day"**: He opened the source of light and caused it to flow upon it until it became like a pool <note>The Hebrew word for "blessed" (vayevarek) is related to "pool" (berecha)</note> to water all the creatures He created, to sustain them and establish them from time to time. The holiness of the Sabbath was established because of Israel, to be written for the Sabbath. For on it He rested, as has been explained: **"And He rested on the seventh day."** 

Nothing was missing from all the actions; rather, on each day, there was an internal sustenance of the words of the commandment, and on the Sabbath, the completion of all the fruits was placed within it. He then divided the portion of every man according to the multitude of thoughts spread through the cycle <term>Gilgul; the transmigration of souls</term> and the permutation of His seal. This is the source of the taste, the answer, and the life-giving sustenance. All of this arises from the power of the fulfillment of the seventh day, making it established and continuous. From this spark, all were given on the seventh day. This is the secret of **"For on it He rested"**, and the sweetness was in the silence. It means: "and He desisted from all His work that God created to do" <note>Genesis 2:3</note>, making it established and continuous. Is there anything better than this word of words, the secret of receiving the blessings of the "Face" <note>Divine Countenance</note>? This is certain. And with this, we have completed what we intended to explain in this chapter.

# Chapter 12
# These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created

This is written to hint at the ultimate purpose of creation and to say that these things, even from matter, are the "generations" <note>the outcomes or products</note> of creation. The period of physicality shall begin and be renewed, and the "Great Flour" <note>likely a metaphor for the primordial matter or essence</note> shall be rectified in its glory. For the upper beings depend on their purity for their existence, and they are established upon the principle of "diminution." According to the "awakening" <term>Itaruta; the mystical concept that human action below triggers a divine response above</term> sent from below, so is the "Good" or "Proper" awakened above. 

Since this was established in thought, it was a necessity—just as in our own minds, thought precedes necessity—that **"on the day the Lord God made earth and heaven,"** God would establish them and take them to be made and rectified. **"The Lord God"** <note>YHVH Elohim</note> shall be and return to His hand to sustain them, to be one with the physical through His loving-kindness, as passed down in the mystery of Unity. Thus far is your construction, to let us hear the secret of the "Work of Creation," how it is structured. 

The two characteristics return to their essence to let us hear the conduct of the Sabbath. This was the reason: its perfection and rectification were not yet arranged until salvation comes and orders everything. This is to let us hear the "fleeing" of the elements and the rectification, through which the purpose of both upper and lower beings is completed—which is the Unity. This purpose is the necessity of everything, as we have prefaced. Its secret is to draw down loving-kindness in the order of the whole, as something good and beautiful. The secret of the external order is to say that there was a pause placed upon the established things before they were fully desired according to the Word in its rectification. It was blessed by His Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah</term>. These two Names <note>YHVH and Elohim</note> represent the "Faces" <term>Partzufim; Divine personifications or configurations</term> until they reach the "Upper Earth," for they were not yet "face to face." They began to form the image of the complete matter, though it was not yet in its fullness. Therefore, the work of the "Upper Completion" was not yet within it, for as long as they were not "face to face," there was no rectification and no perfection. The end of perfection and rectification is when the Rectifier completes them through the measure of these actions, through the hidden work and the reward of good deeds. This is the secret of the one who awakens below to the one above; this awakens the "Upper One." And this is the secret of **"And a mist went up from the earth"**: it does not say it "went up" as a burnt offering <note>original: 'olah'</note>, but rather it "went up" and returned. 

**"And the Lord God formed the man"** <note>Genesis 2:7</note>. This is the secret of the "Heavens" together with the "Generations," and the rectification of this rectification. This was the reason for the creation of man in a proper way as well. To say this: any fruit that did not have this order arranged for it was not in its fullness above. As long as it was not completed for the "sons" below, it returns to the "Above." And it goes up for the sake of the wicked...

<column-break/>

...and this is "corresponding to him," face to face, to awaken within him. And here, this awakening **"went up from the earth and watered the whole face of the upper ground."** This is the cessation of the work with the King, face to face, and through it, the rectification and the complete perfection are possible. This is how the upper and lower creation was finished and the purpose was completed. This is the fruit of all creation: **"These are the generations of the heavens and the earth,"** and so on. 

In the word **"when they were created"** <note>Hebrew: be-hibar'am</note>, it hints—as I have written—at the "merit of Abraham" <note>Hebrew: be-Avraham; an anagram of be-hibar'am</note>. For our father Abraham is the "Womb of the Chariot" <note>the foundation of the divine manifestation</note> and the sustainability of the world. He is the one who rectified the "Upper Rectification" and strove to complete this purpose. Therefore, they were created for the sake of the essence of creation and its completion, which is the purpose and the fruit. This was the intention in the "generations of the heavens and the earth," as we have written. 

In the interpretation of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai <note>Rashbi</note> regarding "when they were created": it includes the whole world, as it is written: **"These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created"**—through Abraham. The reason is that everything that was cast upon the world to lead, he would do. He filled all the deficiencies, and the whole world received its light through his light. He rectified what they had distorted, and therefore he received the reward of them all. 

And in the interpretation of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, peace be upon him, they said: At the end of it all, it is written: **"And the Lord God formed..."** with a double letter *Yod* <note>original: 'Vayitzer' written with two Yods</note>. This refers to the perfection of the rectifications. Why two *Yods*? One for the "Holy Ancient One" <term>Atika Kadisha; the highest, most hidden level of the Divine</term> and one for the "Small Face" <term>Zeir Anpin; the emotive attributes of the Divine</term>. The Lord is like a light within a light, a flame within a flame. This is the spirit and the secret of the Loving-kindness. It is a light within a light. Two ancient levels together with "The Lord God." This is the Spirit of the Ancient One, and this is for the sake of **"And He formed..."** as a garden of light—a rectification for the sake of the heavens. **"The Lord God"**—and it is written **"to cause them to inherit"** in the "Upper Image," which is not called "Man" <note>Adam</note> except when it includes everything and is settled. 

**"The dust from the ground"** refers to the extraction and the counting, and the spirit that comes out from there is called "settled." **"Dust from the ground"** refers to the gathering of the souls within him. And all this—why? In order to look and to contemplate the meaning of the "Hidden Things" until the end of all times. Everything is fixed in wisdom, in the "Breath of Life." At the time when the hidden and sealed things are suspended, they are sustained through Him. 

There is a parable about the "Water of the Mist": it returns and enters into the rectifications as a "protection" for her, to bring the deeds from level to level until the end of all levels. For it is squeezed from the "Hiddenness of Thought" in general, and spreads through everything, but is not perceived except by its hints. And whoever cuts off the end, his rectification is removed and he is removed from the "Breath of Life," and he is found in another engraving... <note>referring to a spiritual disconnection</note> until here.

All matters of creation are doubled. I have already written that the "Work of Creation" shall be as I wrote, hinting at the upper realms. The words of my holy wisdom are ancient and more precious than all faith. The secrets of the Torah and the mysteries of the Work of Creation are hidden and sealed within the Name "God" <note>Elohim</note>. They spread out and return to their essence, explained more than what is usually clarified. Take from it a "Name" to perform the holy service. We have explained a small part of its meaning: that the fruit of all creation, its generations and its purposes, is to say that the "Complete Man" is the secret of "light within light," included in the "Upper Image" which includes male and female. The purpose of everything is to return and contemplate the Name that is pulled from level to level, from the beginning to the end, to show that He is everything and there is none besides Him. He is the Perfect Unity, which is the ultimate purpose of all, the "Upper Will" in its simple order. 

**"And the Lord God planted a garden in Eden"**. This is the secret of the "Eighth Sustainability," called the "Garden of Eden." The Garden is like His sister, the Bride. And because of this, it is protected, punctuated, and tied to "Eden." For Wisdom <term>Chokhmah</term> is the source, and "Eden" is Wisdom, and the "Garden" is the Crown <term>Keter</term>. From every place where they enter, they are sucked out. There is a portion that separates above in its expansion. **"And He formed"** is mentioned in the Garden, also for its meaning—for my mother is called this. And this "Garden" is the "Upper Foundation." Here is the matter: Why did he mention "The Lord" here? Because he hinted at it as a portion, for the Garden is the "Foundation of Existence." And it says: **"And He put the man there."** The "Tree of Life" was in the midst of the Garden...

<meta>This page continues the exploration of the Garden of Eden, moving from the general concept of the Sabbath's completion into a deep mystical analysis of the Tree of Knowledge and the nature of the first sin. It bridges the transition from Chapter 13 to Chapter 14, focusing on the spiritual "separation" caused by Adam and the subsequent opening of his eyes to the physical world.</meta>

### Chapter 13: Part of the Secrets of the Torah ###
### Chapter 14 [Page] 119 ###

Into the end of the Crown, within peace and beauty <note>original: "shalom v'zin"</note>, for the portion that was drawn into the Garden of Eden. Regarding this, it is written: **"A garden locked is my sister, my bride"** <note>Song of Songs 4:12</note>. The intention here refers to the soul of the King <note>The masculine aspect of the Divine</note> and the Assembly of Israel <note>the Shekhinah, the feminine aspect</note>, for whom He is hidden. This is why she is called "My sister, my bride." And the fruit of the garden is the Tree of Life. However, the corruption occurred when he turned his face from the Garden to make for himself a fruit independent of it. After he ate the fruit, it is mentioned and clarified that this was the "Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil," and that they would be "like gods, knowing good and evil." In the Midrash of Rabbi [Simeon], peace be upon him <note>The text likely refers to the Zohar’s author</note>, it is explained: "Woe to them, for they sought to know good and evil!" And regarding the phrase **"and you shall be like gods,"** Rabbi Judah said: "If he had not sinned, he would have lived forever like the ministering angels." But because he sinned, death was decreed upon him and all his descendants. Therefore, it is written: **"For God knows that on the day you eat of it..."** <note>Genesis 3:5</note>, for He knew that if you had been wise, you would not have sinned.

And you should know that in the beginning of the creation of the world, there were these "Gleanings" and "Attachments" <note>Kabbalistic terms for the peripheral spiritual forces</note> in the creation. As has been explained regarding the sin of Adam, as mentioned previously, he was drawn after his desires. For the Tree was **"pleasant to the eyes"** and **"desirable to make one wise."** This refers to all the pleasures of this world and its varieties. "Pleasant to the eyes"—this refers to the inclination towards vanity. "And after your own eyes"—this is the sin of lust. "And the tree was desirable to make one wise"—this refers to the pride of the heart, which is the root of idolatry. Thus, they were drawn away from Him, and a great spirit of impurity was drawn after him.

And we learn later in this chapter: "Adam the first man was a heretic" <note>original: "min hayah"</note>. Rabbi Isaac said: "He pulled at his foreskin" <note>A Talmudic metaphor meaning he tried to remove the mark of his covenant with God to be like the uncircumcised/nations</note>. Rabbi Nachman said: "He denied the Root of Faith" <note>The unity of God</note>. Everyone who was drawn after that Tree from which he ate, and was drawn after its external shells, is considered a heretic, a sorcerer, and one who follows forbidden relations and denies the Root. This is the tradition. In the Midrash of Rabbi [Simeon], it says regarding the Tree: Rabbi Judah says that the first man "pulled at his foreskin." What does this mean? It means he separated the "Covenant of Holiness" <note>the sexual/spiritual sign of the covenant</note> from its place. He turned his back on the internal holiness and was drawn after the "foreskin" <term>Orlah; the spiritual "husk" that covers holiness</term>. This is why it says he was "drawn after his foreskin." He left the internal and followed the external. In the Midrash of Rabbi [Simeon], it is asked: why is it written "and they hid from Him"? It is because the holy names and the spiritual "corners" departed from them. They were left with only the physical, and they were drawn toward the "Other Side" <note>the Sitra Achra, or realm of evil</term>. Anyone who separates the unity of the Divine is like one who destroys the world. They were unable to withstand the holiness once they had been defiled by the filth of the Serpent.

And that Tree is "death" for those who follow it, for it brings down those who cling to it. It is a place of judgment and impurity. When a person is in the "Foundation" <term>Yesod; the sefirah of connection</term> of the Tree, they see the "Water of Bitterness" that separates. Between the "Water" and the "Wine" there is a separation between the holy and the profane. This is what is called "Measure for Measure." This is the secret of the "Spirit of Impurity" that dwells with the woman during her impurity. For when Pharaoh saw Sarah, the "Husks" <term>Kelipot</term> sought to feed, but the Divine protected her. This is all "Measure for Measure." And the secret of this entire matter is that man should not be drawn after that Tree, and should not be sustained by the "Evil" found within it. For the Tree of Knowledge was a mixture of Good and Evil. It was forbidden to eat from it until the Evil was separated from the Good. But by eating it prematurely, they caused the Evil to be stirred up. This is the "Husk" that precedes the fruit. He went to his place, which is the place of his ruin. If the Tree had been entirely Good, he would not have sinned. But since he did not wait for the proper time, he ate of the mixture. Thus, the "Evil" and "Good" were confused together.

<column-break/>

And the one who receives from it and eats of it does so without the "Holy Desire." Thus, in this eating, there was a flaw in thought, for they sought the fruit of death which is below. By fixing their intention on the lower rather than the higher, their thoughts became separated and detached from the Source. Then the "Evil" was strengthened within them, and the "Foreskin" <note>the barrier to holiness</note> took hold. This is the secret of all the destructions: they claimed there was no judge and no judgment. When the Tree is known and recognized as "Evil," the body itself is called the "Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil," as we have written. The intention was to be in the "Source," but we are now in a state of exile and darkness. Oh, how the holy ones of the Most High have fallen! Woe to that time! The Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil was a mixture, and he chose the "Evil" part. In that time, the place was called "Evil" because of his actions. And once he sinned, he could no longer recognize the "Place of the World" <note>a name for God</note>. He would no longer settle in it because of the "Evil" he had attached to himself. Only the "Good" should have remained. It is written: **"He will swallow up death forever"** <note>Isaiah 25:8</note>. This is the completion of what is written in this chapter.

## Chapter 14 ##
->**"And the eyes of both of them were opened"**<-
->**as they were before they sinned**<-
->**in the light of the understanding of this world and its vanities**<-

For Adam had not yet become a "soul of life" <note>in the higher sense</note>. When it says **"And the eyes of both of them were opened,"** it means they saw what they had not seen before. Through their sin, they gained "wisdom," but it was the wisdom of physical things. They saw the affairs of this world and the vanities that dwell within it. From this, their eyes were opened to the "Other Side" <note>Sitra Achra</note>. This is what our Sages meant when they said their eyes were opened to the "vanities of this world." They saw that the "Evil" had now come upon them, for that holy "Garment of Light" that had covered them was removed. Instead, they were left with "Garments of Skin" <note>the physical body</note>.

In the Midrash of Rabbi [Simeon], it is asked: What were the garments of the first man? They were garments of glory, for the "Cloud of Glory" covered him. Once he ate and was drawn after the lower world, the "Garments of Light" departed from him, and he saw himself as "naked." In his thought, he was now focused on the physical. This is the "separation" that occurred. They then **"sewed fig leaves together."** This refers to the "Husks" <term>Kelipot</term> that they tried to use to cover their shame. They tried to find a covering within the very system of the "Other Side" that they had now entered. They tried to separate the "Husks" from the "Holiness," but they were now caught between the two.

They went towards the "West." This means they moved towards the side of darkness. In the Midrash of Rabbi [Simeon], Rabbi Chiyya said: After their eyes were opened, they saw the "filth" of the world. Once they saw it, they understood that they were "naked." They had lost the "Holy Name" that had protected them. Because of this, they were afraid. They "sewed fig leaves" to protect themselves from the "Damagers" <term>Mazzikin; harmful spiritual entities</term> that now had power over them. Rabbi Yose said: Once they saw the world's vanities, they sought to cover themselves. They realized they were now subject to all the "kinds" of punishments in the world. They were like a king's son who was caught in a place of filth; he tries to cover himself so he won't be recognized in his shame.

And this is the secret of Cain and Abel. Cain brought an offering from the "fruit of the ground." This represents the "Husks" or the "Left Side." All his actions were drawn from that "Evil" side. This is why "it was at the end of days" <note>Genesis 4:3</note>—referring to the end of the "Holy Side" and the beginning of the "Side of Death." Cain was of the "filth" of the Serpent. He was the first to manifest the "Evil" that Adam had brought into the world.

<meta>This page transitions from the origins of Cain and Abel to the structure of the Divine Chariot (Merkavah). It explains how the biblical Patriarchs—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—along with King David, serve as the spiritual "legs" or foundations for God's presence in the world.</meta>

## Chapter 17
The **Patriarchs**, having completed this agreement and through the vitality of the Great Name, are the sign of the **Chariot** <term>Merkavah; the "Chariot" refers to the mystical structure of the divine realm as seen in Ezekiel's vision</term>. Regarding them, the Sages said: "The Patriarchs themselves are the Chariot," because each one of them was a vessel for a specific divine attribute throughout their lives. They were not merely three, but a foundation upon which the Divine Presence rested. This union of glory is found in Moses, who was attached to it. And "God ascended from above Abraham" <note>Genesis 17:22</note>—this teaches that the Patriarchs are the Chariot, for it says "God ascended from above Abraham" and "God ascended from upon him." Furthermore, "The Lord stood over him" <note>Genesis 28:13, referring to Jacob</note>. Regarding Isaac at the "Sanctuary of Flesh" <note>The Altar</note> and the foundations, it is understood that he ascended the altar and became a "burnt offering" to heaven; thus the language "ascended from upon him" is used. 

Because **Jacob** is the primary of the Patriarchs—for from him came the three—he is the staff that connects everything. He represents the attribute of **Truth**, through which everything is established and mended, sustaining both the upper and lower worlds. This is why the verse "The Lord stood over him" is written specifically about him and not his fathers, for he is the essence and perfection of the Chariot. In the chapter "One who Recites" <note>referring to a section of the Talmud, Berakhot 16b</note>, it says we only call three people "Patriarchs." The reason is that they draw forth the Chariot. **King David** was uniquely joined to the **Kingdom** <term>Malkhut; the tenth and final Sephirah, representing divine sovereignty</term> and became the fourth leg of the Chariot. The Sages said our father is called "Abba" (Father) because through his vision the decree is received. These are the secrets of the **Upper Chariot**, the Chariot of Chariots in the holy heavens, which include the seven **Living Creatures** <term>Chayot; the angelic beings described in Ezekiel 1</term> joined in unity.

The right and left sides ascend: **Abraham** (Right) and **Isaac** (Left). The "pillars of marble" are the two thighs, and the body between them is **Jacob**, who decides between the two sides and brings peace. This is the secret of "The Lord in the pillars"—one large and one small—making the three legs of the Chariot. When David arrived, the Chariot was completed, and he became the fourth leg alongside the Patriarchs in a single unity. Corresponding to them are the four faces of the Living Creatures in the Chariot:
*   **The Face of a Man**: Corresponds to Jacob, who reflects the likeness of the First Adam. He includes all faces because in him the upper form was perfected—the form of Man that includes all forms.
*   **The Face of a Lion**: On the right, corresponding to Abraham. Though one might think a lion (representing strength) belongs on the left, it is on the right to show the strength of Abraham, who overcame his natural inclination <note>The "Akedah" or Binding of Isaac</note> and went to sacrifice his only son.
*   **The Face of an Ox**: On the left, corresponding to Isaac. Though the ox is often associated with the right (sustenance), it is on the left because Isaac was the "bull" bound upon the altar, representing the power of Judgment.
*   **The Face of an Eagle**: Corresponds to David, showing his attribute of soaring and ascending like an eagle, sometimes hidden and sometimes revealed, according to the divine service.

I have seen that for the wise, these three are the language of "Return" (Repentance). They are holy and pure. But your question is very deep, and it is far off, as Solomon said: "I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me" <note>Ecclesiastes 7:23</note>.

<column-break/>

This refers to the secret of the **Red Heifer** <term>Parah Adumah; a biblical ritual used to purify those who come in contact with death</term> which returns to cleanse and atone for sins. It is the Wisdom heard from the side of the **Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil**. It is a "Heifer" from the side of Strength (*Gevurah*), an external heifer in the mystery of the Crown. Regarding the sun, it is said "the way of the eagle in the heavens," for the vision tests it. This is the secret of the "tower flying in the air." 

One cannot stand upon the depths of this matter, for it belongs to the secret of the "Primordial Thought," which is beyond human reach. Regarding this and the attribute of **Understanding** (*Binah*), it is said that they "resurrect the dead." Even our teacher Moses wanted to understand the paths of reward and punishment but could not fully grasp them. Do not think that God does not know this secret, but rather each person receives according to their capacity. 

Know that the "Husks" (*Kelipot*) <term>the spiritual shells that conceal divine light</term> draw sustenance from the left side. The right side always leans toward the **Mercy** (*Hesed*) of Abraham. All the "Burning Ones" <note>high-ranking angels</note> see the right side as a dwelling of holy pleasantness in the likeness of a Lion. If the "Burning Ones" fear him, it is because of the company of Isaac (Judgment). Abraham took the three and put them on the left, but for Moses they appeared in the likeness of a Lion that sits upon the Altar and consumes the sacrifice. In the end, it provides sustenance for all the "external" chariots. 

The **Eagle** in this context is called "flesh." This is the secret of the "Mirror that does not shine" <term>Ispaklaria she-eina me'irah; a prophetic vision that is clouded or indirect</term>, which has no face or fixed form. This was the level of the lower prophets. But the Eagle represents the holy Kingdom (*Malkhut*), appearing in the form of an eagle. All these constellations are called "flesh." If a person sins, the attributes of compassion move to judge and discipline the wicked. The **Face of a Man** remains the central pillar of the service. Its place is known, just as the places of the Lion and the Ox are known. This has been explained above.

And I have already written that because he saw and looked into the **Lower Chariot** <term>Merkavah Tachtonah; the manifestation of the divine throne as seen in the physical or lower spiritual realms</term>, he knew their peace according to his tradition and his wisdom which was explicitly in his hand, and according to the tradition of this chapter. And it is accepted that there is a power above the Throne and a Chariot above a Chariot, and a Rider above a Rider, and a Glory above a Glory. And in this way, all that he saw below, he knew there was a likeness of them above. And for this secret, one must interpret the scriptures based on the tradition, for they place them in the lower and hint to the upper. And just as His will is such, so it is also below, to receive the holy service.

### Chapter 18 &emsp; Part of the Secrets of the Torah &emsp; Chapter 18 ###

Regarding the wonders of the Chariot <term>Ma'aseh Merkavah; the "Work of the Chariot," referring to the earliest school of Jewish mysticism based on Ezekiel's vision</term>, the author of *Chesed L'Avraham* <note>original: "Kindness to Abraham," a 17th-century Kabbalistic work by Abraham Azulai</note> wrote in the fifth branch and in another place. 
He said: "These levels and below, etc., do not let it enter your mind that for a moment they are similar to such... like Ezekiel. Heaven forbid that they should see another god; for them, it is a spiritual chariot on my horses to gather before the Divine Presence <term>Shekhinah; the indwelling presence of God in the world</term>." Thus far his words.

The composition also bears visions, such as the appearance of a sapphire stone, and in the connection according to the secret of the "five" <note>likely a reference to the five levels of the soul or five worlds</note>. Above his loins and below his loins, it appeared like fire with a radiance around it. Like the appearance of the bow in the cloud, so was the appearance of the radiance surrounding the voice of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. The explanation of the matter is according to the tradition of the prophets and the secret of the holy ones: the place of His glory is the Throne of Glory <term>Kisse HaKavod; the divine throne</term> facing the *speculum* <term>aspaklaria; a prophetic lens or mirror through which a prophet perceives the divine</term>, intertwined with a covering that includes ten levels. 
It is called "the Throne of Measure," and each of the ten glories is given according to its power, for they all have a hue within them. All these mixtures are called *speculums* <note>original: "aspaklariat"</note>, and it is not white, but rather everything that is established within the ten spheres <term>galgalim; the celestial or emanated circles of existence</term> is depicted. 

For what the early ones understood—that which surrounds the *speculums*—is established against them and depicted in the radiant, separate sphere. And what is depicted in the radiant sphere is drawn from the throne and depicted in the second sphere, and so on through them until the end of the luminaries. It is then depicted in the sphere of the Moon <note>original: "Levanah"</note>. Each of these levels includes Living Creatures <term>Chayot; high-ranking angels</term>, Wheels <term>Ophanim</term>, Cherubim, and Electrum <term>Chashmalim</term>. 

The form is depicted in every firmament, and in every firmament is found the likeness of the Chariot, the Living Creatures, the Wheels, the Cherubim, and the Electrum upon the sphere of the Moon, which is called "Earth." The essence of the matter is that there are ten heavens. Thus, every likeness of the Throne of Glory and the angels is structured this way. Therefore, they said regarding the "Work of Creation" <term>Ma'aseh Bereshit</term> that the lower earth contains the Holy Living Creatures, the Wheels, and the Throne of Glory. The "Living Creatures" are the "feet" of the Holy One, who is in His house. This firmament is the "feet," and there is the Return <term>Teshuvah</term> in the inner part of this creation, in the way mentioned in the verses of Genesis, as is known to the masters of wisdom. 

There are no Living Creatures there—perhaps he alluded to the sphere of the Moon which is called "Living"—it is a likeness of the upper secret of the Moon. The body itself dominates the souls. There are those who say it is like matter in the influence of sustenance, which are the "weak vessels" in the sphere of the Moon above the level of the heavens. In every firmament, an image of its likeness is depicted. For this reason, they said the Prince of Wisdom divided the portions of the Chariots; that is to say, Ezekiel saw that "the chariots of God are twice ten thousand, thousands upon thousands" <note>Psalm 68:18</note>. 

The Seal of Glory, from within these "fruits" that are depicted from the quantity of the *speculums* and the sparks—he saw and attained the first level. It appeared to him according to his strength. Just as the levels reflected in the *speculum* appear black, this is the secret of "His appearance was darkened." This is why he explicitly called them "partial visions," for what he saw was from the power of the vision. Just as in his balanced gaze he saw the Living Creatures in their entirety, the preciousness of the Divine Presence was with him. Thus it is said that he wrote of a "vision from within fullness," the ultimate purpose being the preciousness of His Presence, not His essence, for he did not rule over the level of the "Vision of Glories." 

In the chapter "One Does Not Expound" <note>Talmud, Tractate Chagigah, Chapter 2</note>, it is taught: everything Ezekiel saw, Isaiah saw. To what is Ezekiel comparable? To a villager <note>original: "ben kefar"</note> who saw the King. To what is Isaiah comparable? To a city-dweller <note>original: "ben kerakh"</note> who saw the King. The meaning is not that Isaiah’s attainment was higher than Ezekiel's, for it is written of him: "And I saw the Lord." Rather, the King gave a portion to each level. From there, they see the preciousness of the Lord. The intention is that Ezekiel attained the "preciousness of the Divine Presence" with his intellect, whereas it is written in Isaiah that he saw the "preciousness of the Divine Presence" itself, which is the "Essence of Understanding" <term>Binah; the third Sefirah of the Kabbalistic tree</term>.

<column-break/>

Their shame is above the level of the wings. In Ezekiel, it mentions "the face of a man," which is explicitly stated regarding the Living Creatures. Ezekiel, who explicitly mentioned the "likeness of a man" upon the ice, is like the villager and is called "Son of Man" <term>Ben Adam</term>. Some of the sages of the generations expound upon this to his merit, saying the end of the language indicates the high level of Ezekiel the Prophet, who was called "Son of Man." Everywhere it is written, "And you, Son of Man." While in the eyes of the world this is not a position of importance, heaven forbid it should be so here; rather, it is from his high status and importance before the Place <term>HaMakom; a name for God</term> and before the creatures. 

They are the designated ones. And the way of Barzillai the Priest <note>possibly referring to a tradition involving Barzillai or a specific genealogical discussion</note>... regarding the conclusion of Abraham and the conclusion of Rav Chiyau. Ezekiel in the scripture was written as Barzillai the nickname, and it is written there: "Ezekiel the son of Buzi the Priest." Why was he called the "son of Buzi"? Because Buzi "despised" <note>a wordplay on "Buzi" and "buz," meaning to despise or be humble</note> himself before the Place; therefore he was called "dumb" <note>meaning silent or humble</note>. Because he was called by this name, he was of the "great conclusion," and the matter is deep and for those settled in knowledge.

Isaiah saw the Throne in Glory... and therefore he was brief in revealing what he saw, for there was no barrier preventing him. This is the secret of His glory. Therefore, the "city-dweller" is the language understood in the tractate, in the chapter "The Place," where the sages wrote that they were "blessing the Shema," meaning they were making it long. Like Isaiah, the Cherubim of Understanding were attached to him. He saw the "Sitting in Glory," as it is written: "I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up."

However, Ezekiel was occupied with the Glory to guide it and to travel and establish it... among the "Kofim" <note>unclear, possibly "monkeys" or "imitators," or a reference to a specific group</note>. For this reason, he is called a "villager" <note>ben kefar</note>. In the language of the sages, a "village" <note>kefar</note> relates to "denial" <note>kefirah</note>, but do not read it as "villages" <note>kefarim</note> but as "deniers" <note>kofirim</note>, for he saw according to the strength of those who deny the matter. Because it was the time of the Destruction <note>of the Temple</note>, he was forced to reveal everything he saw of the "Work of the Chariot."

The Sages of Truth said that Daniel and Ezekiel saw the same thing. What Ezekiel saw in likeness and imagination, Daniel says: "until the thrones were cast down." Ezekiel says: "the likeness of a throne." In Daniel, it says: "the hair of his head was like pure wool... a fiery stream issued." Ezekiel says: "I saw like the appearance of fire." Daniel says: "the Ancient of Days sat." Ezekiel says: "a likeness as the appearance of a man."

Truly, there are those who inquire: Daniel saw the "Glory of the Prophets," which is greater than Ezekiel’s, for he was in the house of the King amidst many laws. To resolve this doubt: the hour was pressing. Because Ezekiel was destined to reveal and explain what he saw in the writing set before you, he was shown it in "likeness" and not in "clarity." But Daniel, who was not destined to reveal and explain what he saw—for there was a "seal" on this—therefore the influence that came from him was in "clear matters." There is no doubt that Ezekiel was compared to him in the visions of prophecy.

However, the Most High... they are equal in the level of the "Beginning," which is the secret of Glory. It is possible to answer that perfection is according to the level of their wisdom. Since one might not reach the level of prophecy and the perfection required to reach the level of the "Inclusive Chariot" found in the prophecies of the great ones—for this is not a dream—it was possible for Daniel to reach the level of the Chariot like Ezekiel, even if he was not categorized as a "Prophet" <note>In Jewish tradition, Daniel's book is in the Writings (Ketuvim), not the Prophets (Nevi'im)</note>. The lack was not in him but from the deficiency of the generation. It is found that Daniel alone saw the vision, and the men who were with him did not see the vision, but a great trembling fell upon them. There is no reason to write further... Rabbi Marya bar Saba... he is better than him... he is superior in one aspect, and he is superior in another... they explained this based on the "Throne of the Name."

# Chapter 19 &emsp; Part of the Secrets of the Torah &emsp; Chapter 19 #

Israel was chosen to be "brothers and friends" <note>original: "achaim ve-re'im" — based on Psalm 122:8</note> in the secret of "for the sake of my brothers and friends" through wisdom. The intention of atonement and the "Will for the [Divine] Entry into Heaven" <note>original: "ratzon l'vi'ah she-ba-shamayim"</note> is achieved through those who perform His will. In them, the "water is cast into the holy" and it turns toward the Moon <note>symbolizing the Shekhinah, or Divine Presence</note>, becoming a covering. This is why Balaam <note>the biblical sorcerer</note> "builds and combs" <note>attempts to manipulate divine energies</note>. This is the secret of the phrase "on the fourth [month], on the fifth [day]" <note>Ezekiel 1:1</note>; the final letter *He* (ה) among them represents the "Living Creatures" of Israel, who are filled with Torah and commandments. Is not the story wrapped in the letter *Lamed* (ל)? The letter *He* (ה) represents the secret of 30 and 7 within the reading of the Name. It begins with "flesh and skin" and through the five [senses] it is called the "composition of the Menorah." This refers to their conduct during the time of perfection, both above and below. 

But now, due to the corruption of their deeds, the forms and the purity were no longer present. I remembered them, "even when I [am with them in the land of their enemies]" <note>original: "af chovi" — a wordplay on Leviticus 26:44 "Af gam zot," implying God's presence even in exile</note>. In the Midrash, our rabbis taught: they are the cause... as it is written "even when I." However, the Ministering Angel says, "I will chastise them." When Israel heard that she <note>the Divine Presence</note> guards His holiness, she seeks mercy for them. But "even when I" — the masculine aspect said to her: "Strengthen me, Master," for the heart is nothing but "even when I."

This was revealed in the scripture because in every place she prepares herself to mention the sign of Israel. If they were suppressed under subjugation and caused her and themselves exile among the "living ones" <note>nations</note>, she would empower herself to remember them in the secret of "even when I." When he [Ezekiel] responded concerning her land, she was empowered to remove it through servants and prophets—lowly and poor. But they did not listen and did not sense the obligation toward the Temple. By law, they had to go into exile. And the secret of the "Presence" <note>Chasah</note> would be erased with them. This is the secret of "And I was in the midst of the exile." 

What is the reason it happened "by the River Chebar" <note>Ezekiel 1:1</note>? It is based on the "River that goes out of Eden" to water the Garden. Its source had "already" <note>original: "k'var" — a pun on the river's name meaning "already"</note> ceased. It was understood that because of evil, the Righteous One was wrapped [in mourning]. This "hand" <note>prophetic power</note> was not understood in the Babylonian exile. "The heavens were opened" <note>Ezekiel 1:1</note> because what was closed, established, and unified in a complete union at first was now revealed, and the internal aspects went out to the exterior. Upon the arrival of the "Glory of the House of the Lord," seven loves were opened to all and revealed. After the "Fullness of God," whoever rejoices in the "fruitful vine in the inner parts of the house" <note>Psalm 128:3</note> in union... "On the fifth," it says, and so on. From here, it is the word of the "recounting of matters." The reason the scripture omitted the "recounting" of His will is only to show that what occurred was the "Word of the Lord." They received it as "The Word of the Lord came," not just a story. Our face was lacking the exile... what he saw and tasted... "The Word of the Lord came," and it was not merely good. For there, it was not "speech" <note>dibbur</note> but a "vision" <note>marei</note>. Upon waking, he repeated: "And the hand of the Lord was upon him there." Just as the "hand" descended with the children into the land of Chebar, it was a place of dwellings that prepared for their exile. Our Rabbis of blessed memory said: our Chariots are the "Chariots of the eyes of the Cherubim." Regarding the "River Chebar," which is the Temple, they said: that which was seen by the River Chebar... 

The Sages of Truth <note>Kabbalists</note>, may their memory be a blessing, said that the intention of mentioning the "River Chebar" was to indicate the status of the place that was designated in the land of Babylon. It matched the status of a high place in the heavens and was prepared for the Holy Spirit to move upon it. "And I saw..." because what he saw was only the "Minister" [of the Presence]. The image and its surroundings were departing, for in the end, this was revealed in secret. "The Lord is far from the wicked" <note>Proverbs 15:29</note>. This is the matter: for the secret of "trembling," which is the secret of the Holy Chariot, contains "husks" <note>kelipot</note> one inside the other. Death, which is the secret of the sun, and holiness are covered. These husks are the secret of the "channels" and the "spirit of impurity" intended to dwell among the wicked. In the secret of "for the wicked crowns the righteous," the "Greatness" was upon Man. The secret of the "Husk" was intended because it comes from the power of the "Evil Heart" that rules over the Tree of Knowledge. Therefore, it was a lowly and inferior level, for it came from the power of [human] thoughts. It was said that this level was appropriate for the prophet, for it comes from the power of the "Heart" as we have written. 

Furthermore, one must know that the thing equal in it is the trembling and faith of Israel... for it is the cause of the exile and the center. And then it goes around the exile... for there was a hint to Israel... when we wrote the verse "a time of favor for the entry into heaven." It caused them the exile, and because of it, the "difficult peace" was completed. The secret of "his eye is for the entry" in general...

<column-break/>

During the time of Israel's exile, a reminder is summoned to show that the "Voice is closed," etc. They are enslaved below and above. The secret is the "Cup" and the raising of the King of the Lord in a "flame of fire from the midst of the bush" <note>Exodus 3:2</note>. The "bush" <note>sneh</note> represents thorns in the mouth of the heart. In the foreign language <note>Aramaic or Greek</note>, it is understood as being led in holiness. It consists of three husks: the "Foreskin" <note>Orlah</note>, the "Shell" <note>Kelifah</note>, and the "Mouth." None of these are mentioned immediately. 

"And behold, a stormy wind" <note>Ezekiel 1:4; original: "ruach searah"</note>—this is the secret of the *Orlah* (Foreskin) that dwells on the outside. It is a very despicable husk. All that is "female" is known to spread a little, with the King of Impurity within it. The Sages of the Secret taught that its secret and nature are "male and female" as a foundation. They are separated from one another... and this is the secret of the "stormy wind," meaning male and female together. In the Midrash: "stormy wind"—when the Holy One, Blessed be He, was revealed to Job in that storm, as it is written: "out of the whirlwind" <note>Job 38:1</note>. It was not "in a whirlwind" but "from the whirlwind" to show that the "Male Spirit" was there. Therefore, it does not say "a wind of storm" but "stormy wind," for this is the secret of male and female taken together in its secret. For as soon as it is released, they immediately separate; in one moment they unite and in another they separate. This is the secret of the "way of an adulterous woman" <note>Proverbs 30:20</note>... and this is what [Ezekiel] meant when he said "it came." For every blow strikes them in a small way... and then they are swept away from the "tongue" <note>lashon</note>, which is known as the word of "fear." And the "opening of the Pharaoh" and the "bitterness of the night" in the deed of Lot. They are the secret of the "dove's mixture" from this tongue... the great pillar of Egypt. 

"A great cloud" <note>Ezekiel 1:4; original: "anan gadol"</note>—these are the husks that are one inside the other: the husk of the Cloud, the Darkness, and the Frost. Opposite it is the "Flashing Fire" <note>Ezekiel 1:4; original: "esh mitlakachat"</note>, which is their husk within... these are three husks, one inside the other. And behold, there is one thin husk which is the "hope" close to holiness. Furthermore, they said that this "bush" <note>sneh</note> does not refer to the female, but rather the male. The secret is that the "Living Creatures" of grace are over the female... while he is a worker for the "impurity of youth." He intends to win through evil circles... because he separates from her and lies around them. There is a portion of holiness there. 

The Sages of the Eye <note>mystics</note> said: while they were in the complete exile... they were "knocking on the cup." And it was called "shame." After its completion, he was "hollowed" <note>nevuva</note>, which is the "delicate dove" intended for the work of service. This is the secret of what they said: "A dog is hollowed." And in the end, it was the "Dove." This is the secret of "and a brightness [was] round about it" <note>Ezekiel 1:4; original: "ve-nogah lo saviv"</note>, meaning these were pure, for in their struggle their feet were not dried... on this, he said "and out of the midst thereof as the color of electrum" <note>Ezekiel 1:4; original: "hashmal"</note>. In this way, the husks are stripped away to show that in the end, the "Color of the Dove" is revealed with intent in the holiness that was like the *Chashmal*. 

The secret of *Chashmal* is "M-L" <note>the Hebrew letters Mem and Lamed</note>, which are the "speaking" and "silence" <note>original: "chash" (silence) and "mal" (speech)</note> joined together. The foundation is in the "knot" <note>connection</note> to understand correctly. The Sages of the Secrets received it with precision: they are the "M-L" and the internal male within them for a time, departing in an instant. It comes to the outside so that it is possible for it to stand before us—it is a brightness like a flame without a garment. This is the secret of "H-L M-L" <note>perhaps "Hallel" (praise) and "Mallel" (speech)</note> for a time. At one moment it departs... and it is said that "M-L" exists but no one can stand over it or know it. In the chapter "One may not expound" <note>Chagigah 11b</note>, it says: the "Chayot" (Living Creatures) are sometimes silent and sometimes they speak. They are silent when the "Word" comes from the mouth of the Holy One, Blessed be He, and they speak when He has finished speaking. 

This is the secret and its meaning: our Rabbis were correct in saying that "there are times of favor and times that are not favor." At the time when the "Suckling" <note>divine influx</note> comes from the mouth of the Holy One, Blessed be He, this is the secret of the "revolving contemplation." All that is from the "Mishrah" <note>rule</note> is the reception of the flow from this Source. A "Time of Favor" is the essence of the blessings for the Tabernacle, to give what they received for the sustenance of the worlds. Then all faces are relaxed and shining... and there are times that are not favor.

# Chapter 19 &emsp; Part of the Secrets &emsp; 123 #

After speaking according to his context—that they are shared participants in the attainments of all the upper qualities, which the enlightened <note>Hebrew: *Maskilim*</note> perceive—they participate in showing the portions of **Will and Goodness** in the "revealed face" near the "opening of the door" <note>An idiom for the threshold of divine perception</note>. This is directed toward the soul, which is characterized by **Will and Goodness**. For him, it turns toward the closeness of **Kindness** <note>Hebrew: *Chessed*, the Sefirah of expansive love</note> and the totality of the qualities, according to the kindness and the structure of the "beloved and close" appearance of the celestial constellation. Kindness rests upon the revealed and hidden womb <note>symbolizing the source of emanation</note>, and sometimes Kindness "rides" upon the entry. In that vision, they are revealed to the inner parts and hidden from others; sometimes they are revealed, yet who can stand before them or know the nature of the "wrath"? 

This is the **Voice of the Chashmal** <term>Chashmal: A mysterious celestial substance or angelic class in Ezekiel 1:4, often interpreted by Kabbalists as "Speaking Silence"</term> mentioned previously, and the hint toward the upper Kindness of the unique **Living Creatures** <term>Chayyot: The "Living Creatures" or angels that carry the Divine Throne</term>. They are called "fulfillers of the matter" <note>or "full of the material," possibly referring to their role in bridging the spiritual and physical</note> that were required at the beginning. 

The secret of these Living Creatures—called **Chashmal** in their appearance—is a secret known to those deep in Wisdom. It is called by the Name **Y-A-H-D-V-N-H-Y** <note>An interlacing of the Tetragrammaton (Y-H-V-H) and the Name of Lordship (A-D-N-Y), symbolizing the union of the Transcendent and the Immanent</note>. This is the secret of the upper Living Creatures hidden in the secret of **Kindness**. It is the general secret of the *Chashmal* within the Chariot. When the Glory is moved from its place, they are uniquely designated for Kindness, just as the Name **Y-H-V** is. He set them as Glory, and they exist for Him, for they are hidden and concealed. In their "livingness," when they are revealed—Heaven forbid—they are in the secret of other living creatures, lacking the secret of *Chashmal* within the secret of Kindness and its structure. When they are prompted by another force, their "livingness" is clothed in the unique Name. 

The secret of the Living Creatures is to reveal the **Yud-He-Vav-He** <note>The Tetragrammaton</note>, which is the general secret of the Living Creatures in His Divinity. This is the secret of the Living Creatures called **Chashmal**, which are contained within three names totaling the numerical value of **Mah** <note>45, the value of Adam (Man) and a specific spelling of the Divine Name associated with the world of Atziluth</note. They are the secret of the upper Chariot in the "unification of faces within faces." The Living Creatures within them, which are unique to Him, are a garment of this sort. This is the secret of the Unique One in "One Name." 

The **Voice of the Electrum** <note>Chashmal</note> consists of three unique names, like matter in the secret of matter, within the kindness of its structure. We have already hinted at this secret regarding their vitality. The **Four Living Creatures** represent the overturning of Kindness within Kindness. Therefore, there is a "small vision," for they are not visible to the physical eye. Thus, when the flame is established according to its nature and the rank of these "few lives," the flame is lacking according to the Kindness hinted at above in the strength of the "material name." For they hide the matter, and despite their greatness—Heaven forbid—they are "written." Therefore, they are the cause of the **Storm Wind** <note>referencing Ezekiel 1:4</note> in a small vision. 

According to the great rank of the upper Living Creatures and their ascent, "Will" is minimal, for no permission is granted to the eye to see or to gaze upon them. The Name... <note>The text here becomes highly cryptic, discussing the letters Lamed and He</note>. This is their hidden side, concealed within the concealment of the Name. Therein is "Good Taste" <note>spiritual logic</note> and correctness, for the **Voice of Understanding** <note>Binah</note> is the life for the **Four Directions of the World**. By the nature of Kindness, they are unique, elevated, and inherited by the Hebrew tradition to represent the "squaring of the face." 

Thus, there are **Four Faces**. The reasoning for this is that the Voice is bound by the majesty of the **Cherub**, meaning: 
- The Face of the Lion <note>representing South/Kindness</note>
- The Face of the Cherub <note>or Ox, representing North/Judgment</note> 
- The Face of the Secret <note>likely the Eagle, representing East/Beauty</note> 
- The Face of the Prince <note>likely the Man, representing West/Kingdom</note>

All the faces turn toward each other to receive from the Living Creatures, and the Living Creatures receive from the Name. When they approach the **East**, which is called "Heaven," they turn toward the Name to receive the influx from that place. When they approach the **South**, which is called "Kindness," they turn toward the Name to receive from the place of Kindness. When they approach the **North**, they turn toward the Name and receive from the secret of the "Holy Secret" <note>referring to Gevurah/Strength</note>. When they approach the **West**, which is called "The End," they turn toward that place and receive from there. 

For the "Faces" are prepared to receive in their vitality for the four directions; this is the meaning of **"Each had four faces"** <note>Ezekiel 1:6</note>. It does not say "two faces," for the faces are the cause of receiving. This is the secret of the Living Creature that "squares" the descent. These faces are the cause of the "Inner Face," the Chariot, and their reception from the Higher Level. This is the secret of "Myriads of thousands" <note>Psalm 68:18</note>... for it is the secret of the flame-face of the four, and they are the secret of the "Living Flesh"... and the reasoning is correct for those who know knowledge. 

### The Appearance of the Wheels and their Context ###
After explaining the secret of the upper Living Creatures and their ascent in Kindness, hinting at all the lacks of the "revealed matter," we turn to the secret of these Living Creatures as the Chariot of the **Wheels** <term>Ophanim: The angelic wheels within the Chariot vision</term>. The Throne is opposite them, and they are included in their forms for the Name below the Living Creatures. Sometimes they are from them and above them in the concealment of the wheel...

<column-break/>

# Torah &emsp; Chapter 19 &emsp; 124 #

...the order of the **Wheels** <note>Ophanim</note> is the secret of the matter, and the secret of the unique "Interlacing" <note>the Name Y-A-H-D-V-N-H-Y</note> intended to support the words with the Living Creatures of Kindness, upon which the entire world stands for its sustenance and its nature. It is the life of all the worlds. For those who stand [on high] are the secret, and the third support is the foundation of all. They are "riders" and "drawn" in the strengthening of their context and nature. 

The **First Living Creatures** that reveal the upper Kingdom <note>Malchut</note> are supported by these Wheels. For they are the "Sustainers of the Torah," the "Inviters of the Torah," and its "Bearers." They are included in the secret of the Living Creatures, and according to this, they are below them. However, the secret of the expanse of the Wheels is that they are "around the ten," for they are included [in the Sefirot]. They are "dwellers" like the crowns there. For these take from above to below, and those take from below to above, like the "upper model." They are the depth of the Wheels, their strength, and their profundity. 

Now I shall speak regarding each one of these Wheels and its depth: for since they have "Kindness" and "Expanse," they also have depth. This is the secret of the "Correctness" when the openings are made above, and the depth of the world is in the hand of the Table. They are hidden from the righteous so that they might stand only in these, as it says in the chapter *En Dorshin* <note>A famous chapter in the Talmud (Chagigah) dealing with forbidden mystical studies</note>. Therefore, it says "their depth," and "their world," and "their depth." 

It teaches that there is "a wheel within a wheel." That is to say, the doubling and the covering of these within each other, included one in the other and joined one to the other. This is like the matter of **Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob**. In Abraham, through the secret of the **Binding** <note>The Akedah</note>, he "covered" Isaac, as if he were upon the altar of sacrifice—becoming one. It was not permitted to weave or to slaughter Isaac his son, but Isaac was included and became a "hint." He was close to the truth of the matter, to sell himself for the Sanctification of the Name. Abraham his father brought him close, and in the "Peace of the Name" they were included and stood together: Abraham included in the attribute of Isaac, and Isaac included in the attribute of Abraham, interlaced one within the other. 

So too with the **Wheels**—the wheel was within the wheel, in the manner of the doubled and the elevated. It is proper in the depths of the world's hidden things. For the scriptures... from the selection of the Living Creatures to support it and the Wheel, to receive from these Wheels. For the Name is uniquely unified in the "thigh of the Chariot," "thigh within thigh." This is the action of the "elevated work" in these parts: there shall not be a wheel within a wheel except in the "elevated and full action." 

Regarding the "squaring of the matter" in the soul... as hinted above. Truly, the Wheels have four chariots, and they "dwell" upon the back in the "Glow" <note>Nogah</note>. In the "action of the ranks of the place," they are "squared"—meaning they are prepared to dwell in their place as the "riders of the chariots" who are gathered within them. These are the **Four Chariots of Below**, which were hinted at in the beginning. For all are portions, this within that, and that within this. They are certainly prepared for what we said, for they are the "Kings over the Wheels of the Chariot." They are known to them and "do not turn when they go," as we said regarding Strength <note>Gevurah</note>. 

Regarding **"And they had rims [backs]..."** <note>Ezekiel 1:18</note>: The "backs" come to show the rank of the chariots over the Wheels. For the secret of their chariots has "height and fear," because they are always "reigning" more than the "Fearful Ones." Therefore, they have "Fear." For you, the context of the Wheels is that they have "height," more than the upper qualities that are above them. And they have "Fear" because even though they have height from all their elevations, they are like a "hole in the surroundings" that no eye can know. Certainly, the "Constellation of Fear" is their state of mind, for the Lord is within it... leading to the elevation of the Light. 

**"And their rims were full of eyes..."** <note>Ezekiel 1:18</note>: This refers to their "vision." For from the side of the "Faces," they have height and fear. After explaining their "fear" in terms of the body, these are the **"Eyes of the Lord"** that roam through all the earth. For there are "hidden eyes" and "revealed eyes." This is known, for the selection of the chariots prepared for the "Eyes of the Lord" roam through all the earth. For the "Ancient Ones" stand from their elevation in the elevation of the Torah, and they are interlaced one with another. You already know what rank is left for the "Gates of Entry," which is called "Understanding" <note>Binah</note>.

<meta>This page continues the exposition of the Merkavah (Divine Chariot) vision. # Chapter 19 &emsp; Part of the Secrets of the Torah &emsp; Chapter 19 #

For every material aspect of His persona <note>Original: *Partzufo*, referring to the mystical "Face" or configuration of Divine emanations</note> is known to Him through wisdom and a known chariot. This is arranged one beneath the other, and this is the "riding" of one upon the other. This is the secret of the "Four-fold Chariot" <note>Hebrew: *Merkavat Reva’im*</note>, resting beneath the Chashmal <term>Chashmal: The "Speaking Silence" or "Electrum" seen in Ezekiel's vision</term>. The translation of "riding" <note>Original: *rechiv*</note> implies that each one surrounds the heat of his chariot as is appropriate. And, so to speak, their arrangement is according to what was explained above.

One must know that even though He, blessed be He, is called by the "heat of the chariot," we do not mean that these descriptions are scattered things here and there with no known place. Rather, each one is known in its proper preparation, as one who dresses in a garment. It is attached to Him like human clothing, but for the Man <note>referring to the "Human Form" upon the Throne</note>, every description and title is directed toward His face. The Unique Names go to bring His seal and to cling to the Name that is within Him.

However, according to the explanation of the Explicit Names <term>Explicit Names: *Shemot HaMeforashim*, the distinct, holy names of God like the Tetragrammaton</term>, they are clothed in the script of missing letters and missing words. This is because if they were entirely revealed, the "vessels" would be destroyed <note>A reference to the "Breaking of the Vessels," where the divine light is too intense for its containers</note>. We have already been awakened to this at the beginning through the secret of the "End and the Staff" <note>Original: *Acharon u-Matteh*</note>—how Moses approached the thick darkness where God was. If this is so for external matters, how much more so for the inner matters, for one cannot approach them without a "garment."

The proof of this is that in our current state, we do not pronounce the secret of the Name **YHVH** <note>The Tetragrammaton, the four-letter Name of God</note> except through its "clothing," the letters **ADNY** <note>Adonai, meaning "My Lord"</note>. All the garments are joined with their signs and are known to those who write them, like a man over his banner with his signs. They should not, in their going, think of the inner secret through other garments that are not theirs, but only those known and seen by them.

Similarly, the Name **YHVH** clothes itself in the secret of the Name **Elohim**. The garment indicates its fortune and its character; while the inner Name is **Mercy** <note>Hebrew: *Rachamim*</note>, the Name **Elohim** which serves as its clothing is **Judgment** <note>Hebrew: *Din*</note>. And even though the Name **Elohim** is related to the names of the celestial spheres <note>Hebrew: *Galgalim*</note> and is called the "Face of the Garment," it only understands those letters that are "Faces within Faces" <note>an image of deep, nested complexity</note>. For it is a shared name with many faces and matters known to those who bear them and the descriptions and titles, as we have said.

One must understand our warning: "He who pronounces the Name according to its letters" <note>referring to the prohibition against vocalizing the Tetragrammaton as written</note>—his heat <note>anger/sin</note> captures the Name through its signs, and he has no share in the World to Come. This is because he enters into its radiance like a fly, and in his blindness, he consumes and buys the Name through its stripped letters without any other garment. Therefore, he has no portion in the Kingdom.

**And the matter** is as said: "From my flesh I shall see God." "And the likeness of their faces was the **Face of a Man**"—those faces are the spiritual matters in the secret of "more than the written word," the Crown <note>Keter</note> and Man. And the **Face of a Lion** are the matters covered in the secret of being clothed in their garment, like a person who is hidden and clothed in the garment appropriate for him.

**And the secret** of the **Ox**... the letters of **YHYH** <note>A variation of the divine name</note> are the faces, the **Face of a Man**. They are the likeness of Man riding upon the Name; this is a spiritual secret, the radiance of the inner included faces. For the "clothing" of these letters, which are the "Radiance of the Faces," clothes itself in the secret of the "Circle of Limbs." The Lion, the Face of the Ox, and the Face of the Eagle are three matters of birth and character used to clothe the inner faces.

Know that the letters **YHYH** are the secret of "Man" from within. There are names that, even though they are garments, are included in the category of "Faces" which serve as clothing. Behold, the Lion is a king, the Ox is a king, and the Eagle is a king. They are the clothing for these inner matters. When you count their mouths <note>their speech/expression</note>, it is "The King," and within the category of the "Faces" is the "Likeness," for it is a garment. It is a garment to be worn by the innermost "Mind." The Lion is a king among the faces, a garment to be worn by the even more internal "Mind," and through this, you can know the secret of these matters.

**"And their faces and their wings** were separated from above." Know that the secret of the inner essence and the true radiance—the Face of the Lion, the Ox, and the Eagle—they and their wings are the secret of their "covering" with which they are covered. They are "separated from the level of above." They are like the level of the Mercy Seat <note>Hebrew: *Kapporet*, the golden lid of the Ark of the Covenant</note> below, and they begin with the letters in the secret of the connection of the Chariots. The secret of the Upper Chariot is copied in its likeness above. And even though...

<column-break/>

Everything is bound in a supreme bond, above and below. In the state of Exile, everything is separated and divided. Therefore, "their faces and their wings were separated" from the source above. This is like the Crown <note>Keter</note> being divided among all the camps, yet its head remains tied to the flow of its life-force. When it is divided, the faces and wings are "from above"—meaning they are joined and unified in the secret of "Above" as one at the beginning.

**"To each** two were joined to a man." Apply this matter to what we said: that in the state of Exile and the "Center," everything is separated and diminished. At first, there were four faces and four wings, in the secret of the perfection of the "Whole." But the "Living Creature" was diminished... and as the Exile continues, everything is diminished. Perfection is not found in the secret of the Name, nor in the secret of the Throne. Only two letters of the Name remain, and two letters of the Throne <note>A famous midrashic idea that God's Name and Throne are incomplete as long as evil/Amalek exists</note>.

And these are the "two joined to a man," for everything is separated. Regarding "their faces and their wings were separated," this refers to the Name of the Holy One when it is in perfection and unity. But these [in exile] consist of only two letters: **YH** <note>Yod and Heh</note>. Thus is the Throne, which is covered/hidden except for two letters, as it is said: "For a hand is upon the throne <note>Hebrew: *Kes*, a shortened form of *Kisseh* (Throne)</note> of **Yah** <note>YH</note>." Regarding "To each, two were joined to a man," it is because they are covered by only two letters.

**"And each** one went straight forward." Toward whichever side the "Face" was, they would go. This is because they are "Fire, and Cloud, and Gloom," and the radiance of the "Ownerless" <note>or "Infinite"</note> brilliance of the letters is never received to be stood upon, looked at, or investigated by any human mind or knowledge.

**"She"** <note>Original: *Hi*, referring to the Chayah/Living Creature</note> connects between the Living Creatures. The secret of the "Living Creatures" is that she is placed between the North and the South, between the Right and the Back. This "She" <note>The Divine Presence/Shekhinah</note> is the "Point" that is the "Likeness of the God of Israel," and she was opposite the prophetic Torah. This is the secret of the "King" who stays in the center while his servants and troops surround him to be built up by him. We have already said that there are five "Living Creatures," and these matters are a "Likeness of the Living Creatures." Of all of them, it is written: "She moved between the Living Creatures," and it is not written "between the *likeness* of the Living Creatures." For the secret of the "Point" is that it attains here or there, and its intent is more internal. This is the power from which "She moved between the Living Creatures," for she is placed between the North and the South, and therefore creates and receives from them light and radiance. This creates for the lower Living Creatures a power of the "Likeness of the Living Creatures." From that power, the pure light emerges, and a "lightning bolt" goes forth to all sides of the heavens, which is the path of its movement. For the Heavens of these matters are set in their place, and the secret of the "Faces" is seen.

**"And the Living Creatures ran** **and returned"** <note>Hebrew: *Ratzo v'Shov*</note>, as the verse says. From here we learn the secret of the Upper Chariot, the brilliant and shining radiance found there, which is not grasped by the sight of the eye. For it is like something sweet and deep, like the secret of radiance and starlight when one looks at the spheres. Like the sweetness of the eye in the sphere...

# Chapter 21 &emsp; Part of the Secrets of the Torah &emsp; Chapter 21 &emsp; 126 #

For we have learned that before the King came, the world was in brilliance for the decree to merit and to give to whoever approaches and repairs. Once the world arrived, he made it her merit and to settle the inhabitants of the world. It stands for repair and for perfection. He who contemplated His wisdom is holy; this "poor one" is King David, as he appeared when he labored in wisdom like King David of old. And this is the secret of "And David made a name" <note>2 Samuel 8:13</note>—the repair of the Glory which is called "The Name of the Lord" <note>original: *Shem YHVH*</note> by the powers of the Nest. He was already constantly awakened toward His face in his value and his actions, being according to the many blessings to the Lord—mercy upon the portions.
